quiz.q: What does Frieda call out to Klamm through the door?
quiz.why_uz: «Men yer o'lchovchining yonidaman!» — shu bilan u Klammni tark etadi.

quiz.q: What does K. want to do before the wedding?
quiz.why_uz: U Klamm bilan gaplashishni talab qiladi.

quiz.q: How does the landlady describe K.?
o: As nothing — a stranger in everyone's way
quiz.why_uz: «Siz Qasrdan ham, qishloqdan ham emassiz, siz hech kimsiz.»

chapters.title: 5. At the mayor's
chapters.recap_uz: Beka K.ni Klamm bilan gaplashmaslikka yolvoradi; K. rad etadi. Oqsoqol podagradan to'shakda yotib, K.ga yoqimsiz haqiqatni aytadi: qishloqqa yer o'lchovchi kerak emas. U yillar oldingi farmon, adashib ketgan hujjat jildi, A va B bo'limlari va vijdonli amaldor Sordini haqida uzun hikoya qiladi. Idorada «xato bo'lmaydi», faqat nazorat idoralari bor. Shkafdan hujjatlar to'kilib, xonani qoplaydi.

paras.en: 'The scoundrels!' cried the landlady. 'The cunning scoundrels! At Barnabas's! Do you hear —' and she turned towards the corner; but the assistants had long since come out and were standing arm in arm behind the landlady, who now, as though she needed something to hold on to, seized the hand of one of them — 'do you hear where the gentleman hangs about? With the Barnabas family! Of course he'd get a bed there — oh, if only he'd had it there rather than at the Herrenhof. But where were you two?'
paras.uz: — Yaramaslar! — deb qichqirdi beka. — Ayyor yaramaslar! Barnabasnikida! Eshityapsizlarmi… — va u burchak tomonga o'girildi, lekin yordamchilar allaqachon chiqib kelib, bekaning orqasida qo'ltiqlashib turishardi; beka endi, go'yo tayanch kerakdek, ulardan birining qo'lini ushladi, — eshityapsizlarmi, janob qayerlarda sanqib yuradi — Barnabasning oilasida! Albatta, u yerda unga tunash joyi topiladi, oh, qaniydi u «Herrenhof»da emas, o'sha yerda tunagan bo'lsa. Lekin sizlar qayerda edingizlar?

paras.en: 'Frau Landlady,' said K., before the assistants could answer, 'these are my assistants, but you treat them as though they were your assistants and my guards. In everything else I am ready most politely to at least discuss your opinions, but not as regards my assistants, for here the matter is surely too clear. I therefore ask you not to speak to my assistants, and if my request should not be enough, I forbid my assistants to answer you.'
paras.uz: — Bekam, — dedi K. yordamchilar javob berishidan oldin, — bular mening yordamchilarim, siz esa ularga go'yo ular sizning yordamchilaringiz, mening esa qo'riqchilarim bo'lgandek munosabatda bo'lyapsiz. Boshqa hamma narsada men sizning fikrlaringizni hech bo'lmaganda eng xushmuomalalik bilan muhokama qilishga tayyorman, lekin yordamchilarim borasida emas, chunki bu yerda ish juda aniq! Shuning uchun sizdan yordamchilarim bilan gaplashmaslikni so'rayman, agar iltimosim yetarli bo'lmasa, yordamchilarimga sizga javob berishni taqiqlayman.

paras.en: 'So I may not speak to you,' said the landlady, and all three laughed — the landlady mockingly, but much more gently than K. had expected; the assistants in their usual way, which meant much and nothing and declined all responsibility.
paras.uz: — Demak, men sizlar bilan gaplasha olmas ekanman, — dedi beka va uchovi ham kulishdi — beka masxaraomuz, lekin K. kutganidan ancha muloyimroq, yordamchilar esa o'zlarining odatdagi, ko'p narsa va hech narsa anglatmaydigan, har qanday mas'uliyatni rad etuvchi tarzida.

paras.en: 'Don't be angry,' said Frieda, 'you must understand our agitation properly. In a way, it is only thanks to Barnabas that we now belong to each other. When I saw you for the first time in the bar — you came in on Olga's arm — I knew a few things about you already, but on the whole you were completely indifferent to me. Well, not only you; almost everything, almost everything was indifferent to me then. I was discontented with a great deal at that time too, and a lot annoyed me, but what sort of discontent was that, what sort of annoyance! One of the guests in the bar would insult me, for instance — they were always after me; you saw the fellows there, but much worse ones came too; Klamm's servants weren't the worst — so one would insult me, and what did it mean to me? It was as though it had happened many years before, or hadn't happened to me at all, or as though I had only heard it told, or had already forgotten it myself. But I can't describe it; I can't even imagine it any more, everything has changed so much since Klamm left me.'
paras.uz: — Faqat jahling chiqmasin, — dedi Frida, — bizning hayajonimizni to'g'ri tushunishing kerak. Agar xohlasang, biz bir-birimizga tegishli bo'lganimiz uchun faqat Barnabasdan qarzdormiz. Seni bufetda birinchi marta ko'rganimda — sen Olganing qo'lidan ushlab kirib kelding — men sen haqingda ba'zi narsalarni bilardim, lekin umuman olganda sen menga butunlay befarq eding. Faqat sen emas, deyarli hamma narsa, deyarli hamma narsa menga befarq edi. O'shanda men ko'p narsadan norozi edim, ko'p narsa jahlimni chiqarardi, lekin bu qanday norozilik va qanday jahl edi! Masalan, bufetdagi mehmonlardan biri meni haqorat qilardi — ular doim ortimdan yurishardi, u yerdagi yigitlarni ko'rding, lekin ulardan ham yomonroqlari kelardi, Klammning xizmatkorlari eng yomoni emas edi — xullas, biri meni haqorat qilardi, bu men uchun nima ahamiyatga ega edi? Go'yo bu ko'p yillar oldin sodir bo'lgandek, yoki umuman men bilan sodir bo'lmagandek, yoki men buni faqat eshitgandek, yoki o'zim allaqachon unutgandek edi. Lekin men buni tasvirlay olmayman, hatto endi tasavvur ham qila olmayman — Klamm meni tashlab ketganidan beri hammasi shunchalik o'zgardi.

paras.en: And Frieda broke off her story; sadly she lowered her head and held her hands folded in her lap.
paras.uz: Va Frida hikoyasini to'xtatdi, g'amgin boshini egdi, qo'llarini tizzasida qovushtirib turdi.

paras.en: 'You see,' cried the landlady, and she did it as though she were not speaking herself but only lending Frieda her voice; she moved closer too and now sat right beside Frieda. 'Now you see, land surveyor, the consequences of your actions — and your assistants, to whom I may not speak, may watch too, for their instruction! You have torn Frieda out of the happiest state that was ever granted her, and you managed it chiefly because Frieda, with her childishly exaggerated pity, could not bear to see you hanging on Olga's arm and so apparently delivered up to the Barnabas family. She saved you and sacrificed herself in doing so. And now that it has happened, and Frieda has exchanged everything she had for the happiness of sitting on your knee, now you come along and play it as your great trump that you once had the chance to spend the night at Barnabas's. With that you mean to prove, I suppose, that you are independent of me. Certainly, if you really had spent the night at Barnabas's, you would be so independent of me that you would have to leave my house in a flash — at the very fastest.'
paras.uz: — Ko'ryapsizmi, — qichqirdi beka va buni go'yo o'zi gapirmayotgandek, faqat Fridaga ovozini qarz berayotgandek qildi; u yaqinroq surilib, endi Fridaning shundoqqina yonida o'tirardi, — endi ko'ryapsizmi, janob yer o'lchovchi, qilmishlaringizning oqibatlarini, men gaplasha olmaydigan yordamchilaringiz ham ibrat olish uchun qarab tursin! Siz Fridani uning nasibasiga tushgan eng baxtli holatdan yulib oldingiz va buni asosan Frida o'zining bolalarcha mubolag'ali rahmdilligi bilan sizning Olganing qo'lida osilib, go'yo Barnabaslar oilasiga topshirilgandek bo'lganingizga chiday olmagani uchun uddaladingiz. U sizni qutqardi va bunda o'zini qurbon qildi. Endi esa, bu sodir bo'lib, Frida bor-budini sizning tizzangizda o'tirish baxtiga almashtirgach, siz kelib, bir vaqtlar Barnabasnikida tunash imkoniyatingiz bo'lganini katta kozir sifatida o'ynayapsiz. Bu bilan, ehtimol, mendan mustaqil ekaningizni isbotlamoqchisiz. Albatta, agar siz haqiqatan Barnabasnikida tunaganingizda, mendan shunchalik mustaqil bo'lardingizki, uyimni bir zumda, eng tez fursatda tark etishingizga to'g'ri kelardi.

paras.en: 'I don't know the sins of the Barnabas family,' said K., as he carefully lifted Frieda, who was as if lifeless, slowly sat her on the bed and stood up himself. 'Perhaps you are right about that; but I was certainly right when I asked you to leave our affairs, Frieda's and mine, to the two of us alone. You mentioned something about love and concern then, but I haven't noticed much of that since — all the more, though, of hatred and scorn and threats to turn me out. If you set out to turn Frieda away from me, or me away from Frieda, it was skilfully done; but I don't think you will succeed, and if you should succeed, you will — allow me too a dark threat for once — bitterly regret it. As for the lodging you grant me — you can only mean this loathsome hole — it is by no means certain that you do it of your own free will; rather, there seems to be an instruction from the Count's authorities about it. I shall now report there that I have been given notice here, and if they then assign me another lodging, you will no doubt breathe a sigh of relief — but I a deeper one. And now I am going to the mayor's about this and other matters. Please at least look after Frieda, whom you have treated badly enough with your so-called motherly speeches.'
paras.uz: — Barnabaslar oilasining gunohlarini bilmayman, — dedi K. jonsizdek bo'lgan Fridani ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'tarib, asta karavotga o'tqazib, o'zi o'rnidan turarkan, — balki bunda haqdirsiz, lekin sizdan bizning ishlarimizni — Fridaniki va menikini — faqat ikkovimizga qoldirishingizni so'raganimda, men albatta haq edim. O'shanda siz muhabbat va g'amxo'rlik haqida nimadir dedingiz, lekin keyin buni ko'p sezmadim, aksincha, nafrat, masxara va uydan haydash haqida ko'proq sezdim. Agar maqsadingiz Fridani mendan yoki meni Fridadan ayirish bo'lsa, bu ancha mohirona qilindi; lekin menimcha, bunga erisha olmaysiz, agar erishsangiz, — menga ham bir marta qorong'i tahdidga ruxsat bering — achchiq pushaymon bo'lasiz. Menga bergan uy-joyingizga kelsak — siz faqat mana shu jirkanch tuynukni nazarda tutishingiz mumkin — buni o'z xohishingiz bilan qilayotganingiz mutlaqo aniq emas, aksincha, bu haqda graflik idorasining ko'rsatmasi borga o'xshaydi. Endi u yerga bu yerdan menga ketishni aytishganini xabar qilaman, agar keyin menga boshqa uy-joy ajratishsa, siz, ehtimol, yengil nafas olasiz, men esa yanada chuqurroq. Endi esa shu va boshqa ishlar yuzasidan qishloq oqsoqolining oldiga boraman; iltimos, hech bo'lmaganda Fridaga qarab turing, siz uni o'zingizning, ta'bir joiz bo'lsa, onalik nutqlaringiz bilan yetarlicha yomon ahvolga solib qo'ydingiz.

paras.en: Then he turned to the assistants. 'Come!' he said, took Klamm's letter from the hook and made to leave. The landlady had watched him in silence; only when he already had his hand on the door handle did she say: 'Land surveyor, I'll give you one more thing to take with you; for whatever speeches you may make and however you may want to insult me, an old woman, you are still Frieda's future husband. It is only for that reason that I tell you that you are terribly ignorant about the conditions here. One's head spins listening to you and comparing in one's mind what you say and think with the real situation. This ignorance cannot be cured all at once, perhaps not at all; but much can get better if only you believe me a little and always keep this ignorance before your eyes. Then you will, for instance, at once become fairer towards me and begin to suspect what a fright I have been through — and the effects of the fright are still with me — when I realized that my dearest little one had in a sense left the eagle to join the slow-worm; but the real relationship is much worse still, and I have to keep trying to forget it, otherwise I couldn't speak a calm word to you. Oh, now you're angry again. No, don't go yet; just hear this one request: wherever you go, remain aware that here you are the most ignorant of all, and be careful. Here with us, where Frieda's presence protects you from harm, you may chatter your heart out; here you can show us, for instance, how you intend to speak to Klamm; only in reality, only in reality — please, please, don't do it!'
paras.uz: Keyin u yordamchilarga o'girildi. «Yuringlar!» dedi u, Klammning maktubini ilgichdan oldi va chiqib ketmoqchi bo'ldi. Beka uni jimgina kuzatib turdi, faqat u qo'lini eshik tutqichiga qo'yganidagina dedi: «Janob yer o'lchovchi, yo'lingizga yana bir narsani beraman, chunki qanday gaplar gapirmang va meni — kampirni qanchalik haqorat qilmoqchi bo'lmang, siz baribir Fridaning bo'lajak erisiz. Faqat shuning uchun sizga aytaman: siz bu yerdagi ahvol borasida dahshatli darajada johilsiz, sizni tinglaganda va aytgan va o'ylagan narsangizni xayolan haqiqiy ahvol bilan solishtirganda boshing aylanib ketadi. Bu johillikni birdaniga tuzatib bo'lmaydi, balki umuman tuzatib bo'lmas; lekin agar menga ozgina ishonsangiz va bu johillikni doim ko'z oldingizda tutsangiz, ko'p narsa yaxshilanishi mumkin. Unda, masalan, siz darhol menga nisbatan adolatliroq bo'lasiz va mening eng aziz kichkinam, ta'bir joiz bo'lsa, burgutni tashlab, kalta ilon bilan bog'langanini anglaganimda qanday dahshatni boshdan kechirganimni — dahshatning oqibatlari hali ham davom etmoqda — sezishni boshlaysiz; lekin haqiqiy munosabat bundan ham yomonroq va men uni doimo unutishga urinishim kerak, aks holda siz bilan bitta xotirjam so'z ham gaplasha olmasdim. Eh, endi yana jahlingiz chiqdi. Yo'q, hali ketmang, faqat bu iltimosni eshiting: qayerga bormang, bu yerda eng johil odam siz ekaningizni yodda tuting va ehtiyot bo'ling; bu yerda, bizda, Fridaning borligi sizni zarardan himoya qiladigan joyda, yuragingizni bo'shatib vaysashingiz mumkin, bu yerda, masalan, Klamm bilan qanday gaplashmoqchi ekaningizni bizga ko'rsatishingiz mumkin; faqat haqiqatda, faqat haqiqatda, iltimos, iltimos, buni qilmang!»

paras.en: She stood up, swaying a little with agitation, went over to K., took his hand and looked at him imploringly. 'Frau Landlady,' said K., 'I don't understand why you should lower yourself to plead with me over such a thing. If, as you say, it is impossible for me to speak to Klamm, then I simply shan't manage it, whether I'm begged or not. But if it should be possible after all, why shouldn't I do it — especially since then, with your main objection gone, your further fears too become very doubtful. Of course I am ignorant; that truth stands in any case, and it is very sad for me; but it also has the advantage that the ignorant man dares more, and so I am glad to bear ignorance and its no doubt bad consequences for a while longer, as long as my strength lasts. But these consequences essentially affect only me, and that above all is why I don't understand why you are pleading. You will surely always look after Frieda, and if I disappear entirely from Frieda's sight, that can, in your view, only mean good fortune. So what are you afraid of? You aren't afraid — to the ignorant everything seems possible' — here K. already opened the door — 'you aren't afraid for Klamm, are you?' The landlady watched him in silence as he hurried down the stairs, the assistants following him.
paras.uz: U hayajondan biroz chayqalib o'rnidan turdi, K.ning oldiga bordi, qo'lini ushlab, unga iltijo bilan qaradi. «Bekam, — dedi K., — nega bunday narsa uchun menga iltijo qilishga o'zingizni past tushirayotganingizni tushunmayman. Agar siz aytganingizdek, men uchun Klamm bilan gaplashish imkonsiz bo'lsa, meni so'rashsa ham, so'rashmasa ham, men bunga erisha olmayman. Agar baribir mumkin bo'lsa, nega uni qilmasligim kerak, ayniqsa unda sizning asosiy e'tirozingiz yo'qolishi bilan boshqa qo'rquvlaringiz ham juda shubhali bo'lib qoladi. Albatta, men johilman, bu haqiqat har holda qoladi va bu men uchun juda achinarli; lekin buning ham afzalligi bor — johil ko'proq jur'at qiladi, shuning uchun men johillikni va uning, albatta, yomon oqibatlarini kuchim yetguncha yana bir oz bajonidil ko'taraman. Lekin bu oqibatlar asosan faqat menga tegadi, shuning uchun ham, avvalo, nega iltijo qilayotganingizni tushunmayman. Siz Fridaga doim g'amxo'rlik qilasiz-ku, agar men Fridaning ko'z o'ngidan butunlay yo'qolsam, bu sizning nazaringizda faqat baxt bo'lishi mumkin. Unda nimadan qo'rqyapsiz? Siz qo'rqmayapsizmi — johilga hamma narsa mumkindek tuyuladi, — shu yerda K. allaqachon eshikni ochdi, — siz Klamm uchun qo'rqmayapsizmi?» Beka uning zinadan shoshib tushayotganini va yordamchilar uning ortidan borayotganini jim kuzatib qoldi.

paras.en: The meeting with the mayor caused K. little worry, almost to his own surprise. He tried to explain this to himself by the fact that, from his experience so far, official dealings with the Count's authorities had been very simple for him. This was partly because, as regards the handling of his case, a definite principle — outwardly very favourable to him — had evidently been laid down once and for all; and partly because of the admirable uniformity of the service, which one sensed to be especially perfect precisely where it seemed not to exist. When K. sometimes thought only of these things, he was not far from finding his position satisfactory, although after such fits of comfort he always quickly told himself that precisely there lay the danger.
paras.uz: Oqsoqol bilan uchrashuv K.ni deyarli o'zining hayratiga kam tashvishlantirdi. U buni hozirgacha bo'lgan tajribasiga ko'ra graflik idoralari bilan rasmiy muloqot uning uchun juda oddiy bo'lgani bilan tushuntirishga urindi. Bu bir tomondan, uning ishini ko'rib chiqishda, aftidan, bir marta va butunlay muayyan, tashqi jihatdan unga juda qulay tamoyil belgilangani bilan, ikkinchi tomondan esa xizmatning hayratlanarli bir xilligi bilan bog'liq edi — uni ayniqsa u yo'qdek ko'ringan joyda ayniqsa mukammal deb sezish mumkin edi. K. ba'zan faqat shu narsalar haqida o'ylaganda, o'z ahvolini qoniqarli deb topishdan uzoq emas edi, garchi bunday rohat xurujlaridan keyin doim tezda o'ziga xavf aynan shunda ekanini aytsa ham.

paras.en: Direct dealings with the authorities were not too difficult, for however well organized the authorities might be, they had only ever to defend remote, invisible things in the name of remote, invisible masters, whereas K. was fighting for something most vividly close — for himself; moreover, at least in the very first period, of his own free will, for he was the attacker; and not only was he fighting for himself, but evidently other forces too, which he did not know but in which, judging by the authorities' measures, he could believe. But because the authorities met K. a long way from the outset in unimportant matters — and so far nothing more had been at stake — they took from him the chance of small, easy victories, and with that chance also the satisfaction that goes with them and the well-founded confidence for further, bigger battles that results from it. Instead they let K. slip through wherever he wanted — only within the village, of course — and thereby spoiled and weakened him, eliminated any fight here altogether and moved it instead into unofficial life, which was completely confusing, murky and strange.
paras.uz: Idoralar bilan bevosita muloqot unchalik qiyin emas edi, chunki idoralar qanchalik yaxshi tashkil etilgan bo'lmasin, doim faqat uzoq, ko'rinmas janoblar nomidan uzoq, ko'rinmas narsalarni himoya qilishlari kerak edi, K. esa eng jonli yaqin narsa — o'zi uchun kurashardi; buning ustiga, hech bo'lmaganda eng dastlabki paytda, o'z xohishi bilan, chunki hujumchi u edi; va u uchun nafaqat o'zi kurashardi, balki, aftidan, u bilmagan, lekin idoralarning choralariga qarab ishonishi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa kuchlar ham kurashardi. Lekin idoralar boshidanoq K.ga muhim bo'lmagan narsalarda — hozirgacha gap bundan ortiq narsada emas edi — ancha yon bosgani uchun, undan kichik, oson g'alabalar imkoniyatini, bu imkoniyat bilan birga unga tegishli qoniqishni va undan kelib chiqadigan, keyingi kattaroq kurashlar uchun asosli ishonchni ham tortib olishardi. Buning o'rniga ular K.ga, albatta, faqat qishloq ichida, xohlagan joyida sirg'alib o'tishga imkon berishar, shu bilan uni erkalab, zaiflashtirishar, bu yerda har qanday kurashni butunlay yo'q qilib, uni rasmiy bo'lmagan, butunlay chalkash, xira, begona hayotga ko'chirishardi.

paras.en: In this way, if he was not always on his guard, it might well happen that one day, despite all the authorities' kindness and despite fulfilling completely all his so exaggeratedly easy official obligations, deceived by the apparent favour shown him, he would conduct the rest of his life so carelessly that he would collapse there, and the authorities, still gentle and friendly, as if against their will, but in the name of some public order unknown to him, would have to come and clear him out of the way. And what was it here, really, that other life? Nowhere had K. yet seen office and life so intertwined as here — so intertwined that it could sometimes seem that office and life had changed places. What, for example, did the so far merely formal power that Klamm exercised over K.'s service mean, compared with the power Klamm in all reality had in K.'s bedroom? So it came about that here a somewhat more careless procedure, a certain relaxation, was appropriate only in direct dealings with the authorities, while everywhere else great caution was always necessary — a looking round on all sides before every step.
paras.uz: Shu tarzda, agar u doim hushyor bo'lmasa, bir kun idoralarning barcha xushmuomalaligiga va shunchalik mubolag'ali oson rasmiy majburiyatlarning to'liq bajarilishiga qaramay, unga ko'rsatilgan zohiriy marhamatdan aldanib, boshqa hayotini shunchalik ehtiyotsiz o'tkazishi mumkin ediki, u yerda qulab tushardi va idora hamon muloyim va do'stona, go'yo o'z xohishiga qarshi, lekin unga noma'lum qandaydir jamoat tartibi nomidan kelib, uni yo'ldan olib tashlashi kerak bo'lardi. Bu yerda o'sha boshqa hayot aslida nima edi? K. hali hech qayerda idora va hayotni bu yerdagidek bir-biriga chirmashib ketganini ko'rmagan edi — shunchalik chirmashganki, ba'zan idora va hayot o'rin almashgandek tuyulishi mumkin edi. Masalan, Klammning K.ning xizmati ustidan hozircha faqat rasmiy bo'lgan hokimiyati Klammning K.ning yotoqxonasida haqiqatda ega bo'lgan hokimiyatiga nisbatan nima ahamiyatga ega edi? Shunday qilib, bu yerda biroz yengiltakroq yo'l tutish, qandaydir bo'shashish faqat idoralarga bevosita munosabatda o'rinli edi, boshqa joylarda esa doim katta ehtiyotkorlik, har bir qadam oldidan har tomonga qarash zarur edi.

paras.en: At first K. found his view of the authorities here strongly confirmed at the mayor's. The mayor, a friendly, fat, clean-shaven man, was ill — he had a bad attack of gout — and received K. in bed. 'So this is our land surveyor,' he said, and wanted to sit up to greet him, but could not manage it and, pointing apologetically at his legs, threw himself back on the pillows. A quiet woman, almost shadowy in the half-light of the small-windowed room, darkened further by curtains, brought K. a chair and set it by the bed. 'Sit down, sit down, land surveyor,' said the mayor, 'and tell me your wishes.' K. read out Klamm's letter and added a few remarks. Again he had the feeling of the extraordinary ease of dealing with the authorities. They positively bore every burden; one could load everything onto them and remain untouched and free oneself. As though the mayor felt this too in his own way, he turned uncomfortably in bed. At last he said: 'Land surveyor, as you have noticed, I knew about the whole matter. That I have done nothing about it myself yet is due, firstly, to my illness, and then to the fact that you didn't come for so long; I was beginning to think you had given the matter up. But now that you are so kind as to come and see me yourself, I must of course tell you the full, unpleasant truth. You have been taken on as land surveyor, as you say; but unfortunately we don't need a land surveyor.
paras.uz: Bu yerdagi idoralar haqidagi tasavvuri avvaliga oqsoqolnikida juda tasdiqlandi. Oqsoqol — mehribon, semiz, soqoli silliq olingan odam — kasal edi, uni og'ir podagra xuruji tutgan edi va K.ni to'shakda qabul qildi. «Demak, bu bizning janob yer o'lchovchimiz», dedi u va salomlashish uchun ko'tarilmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin uddalay olmadi va uzr so'ragandek oyoqlarini ko'rsatib, yana yostiqlarga yiqildi. Kichik derazali, pardalar bilan yanada qorong'ilashtirilgan xonaning g'ira-shirasida deyarli soyadek ko'rinadigan sokin bir ayol K.ga kreslo olib kelib, uni karavot yoniga qo'ydi. «O'tiring, o'tiring, janob yer o'lchovchi, — dedi oqsoqol, — va istaklaringizni ayting.» K. Klammning maktubini o'qib berdi va unga bir necha izoh qo'shdi. Yana u idoralar bilan muloqotning g'ayrioddiy osonligini his qildi. Ular rosmana har qanday yukni ko'tarishardi, hamma narsani ularga yuklash mumkin edi, o'zing esa tegilmagan va erkin qolarding. Go'yo buni oqsoqol ham o'ziga xos tarzda his qilgandek, to'shakda noqulay aylandi. Nihoyat dedi: «Janob yer o'lchovchi, payqaganingizdek, men butun ishdan xabardor edim. O'zim hali hech narsa qilmaganimning sababi, birinchidan, kasalligimda, keyin esa siz shunchalik uzoq kelmaganingizda — men allaqachon siz bu ishdan voz kechgansiz, deb o'ylagan edim. Lekin endi, o'zingiz mening oldimga kelishdek iltifot ko'rsatganingizdan keyin, sizga, albatta, to'liq, noxush haqiqatni aytishim kerak. Siz aytganingizdek, yer o'lchovchi sifatida qabul qilingansiz; lekin afsuski, bizga yer o'lchovchi kerak emas.

paras.en: There would not be the slightest work for him. The boundaries of our little farms are marked out; everything is properly registered. Changes of ownership hardly ever happen, and small boundary disputes we settle ourselves. So what do we want with a land surveyor?' In his heart of hearts — though he had not, it is true, thought about it before — K. was convinced he had expected some such message. That was precisely why he could say at once: 'That surprises me very much. It upsets all my calculations. I can only hope there is a misunderstanding.' — 'Unfortunately not,' said the mayor, 'it is as I say.' — 'But how is that possible!' cried K. 'I didn't make this endless journey only to be sent back again!' — 'That is another question,' said the mayor, 'which it is not for me to decide. But how that misunderstanding was possible I can certainly explain to you. In an authority as large as the Count's it can happen now and then that one department orders this and another that, neither knows of the other; the supervisory control is extremely precise, it's true, but by its nature it comes too late, and so a little confusion can arise all the same. Of course it is always only the tiniest trifles, like your case, for example. In big things I have never known a mistake, but the trifles are often embarrassing enough.
paras.uz: Uning uchun zarracha ish bo'lmasdi. Kichik xo'jaliklarimizning chegaralari belgilangan, hammasi tartib bilan ro'yxatga olingan. Mulk egasi almashishi deyarli bo'lmaydi, kichik chegara nizolarini esa o'zimiz hal qilamiz. Bizga yer o'lchovchi nima kerak?» K. ichida — garchi ilgari bu haqda o'ylamagan bo'lsa ham — shunga o'xshash xabarni kutganiga amin edi. Aynan shuning uchun darhol ayta oldi: «Bu meni juda hayratga solyapti. Bu mening barcha hisob-kitoblarimni ostin-ustun qiladi. Faqat biror anglashilmovchilik bor, deb umid qilishim mumkin.» — «Afsuski, yo'q, — dedi oqsoqol, — men aytganimdek.» — «Lekin bu qanday mumkin! — qichqirdi K. — Men bu cheksiz safarni endi orqaga qaytarib yuborilish uchun qilmaganman-ku!» — «Bu boshqa masala, — dedi oqsoqol, — uni hal qilish menga tegishli emas, lekin o'sha anglashilmovchilik qanday mumkin bo'lganini sizga, albatta, tushuntirib bera olaman. Graflik idorasidek katta idorada bir bo'lim buni, boshqasi uni buyurishi, hech biri ikkinchisi haqida bilmasligi bo'lib turadi; yuqori nazorat, to'g'ri, nihoyatda aniq, lekin tabiatiga ko'ra kech keladi va shuning uchun baribir kichik bir chalkashlik yuzaga kelishi mumkin. Albatta, bular doim faqat eng mayda arzimas narsalar, masalan, sizning holatingizdek. Katta ishlarda menga hali biror xato ma'lum bo'lmagan, lekin mayda narsalar ham ko'pincha yetarlicha noqulay.

paras.en: As for your case, I will tell you openly how it came about, without making official secrets of it — I'm not enough of an official for that; I'm a peasant and that's how it stays. A long time ago, when I had been mayor for only a few months, a decree came — I no longer remember from which department — informing us, in the categorical manner peculiar to the gentlemen there, that a land surveyor was to be engaged, and instructing the community to have ready all the plans and records necessary for his work. This decree cannot, of course, have concerned you, for that was many years ago, and I would not have remembered it if I were not ill now and had enough time in bed to think about the most ridiculous things.' — 'Mizzi,' he said, suddenly breaking off his account, to the woman who was still flitting about the room in some incomprehensible activity, 'please look in that cupboard; perhaps you'll find the decree.' — 'It's from my early days, you see,' he said to K. by way of explanation; 'I still kept everything then.' The woman at once opened the cupboard; K. and the mayor watched. The cupboard was crammed with papers. As it opened, two large bundles of files rolled out, tied round as one ties firewood, and the woman jumped aside in fright. 'It should be at the bottom, at the bottom,' said the mayor, directing from the bed.
paras.uz: Sizning ishingizga kelsak, men sizga voqea qanday bo'lganini rasmiy sir qilmasdan ochiq aytib beraman — buning uchun men yetarlicha amaldor emasman, men dehqonman va shunday qolaman. Uzoq vaqt oldin, men hali bir necha oydan beri oqsoqol bo'lganimda, bir farmon keldi — qaysi bo'limdan ekanini endi eslamayman — unda u yerdagi janoblarga xos qat'iy uslubda yer o'lchovchi chaqirilishi kerakligi ma'lum qilingan va jamoaga uning ishlari uchun zarur bo'lgan barcha rejalar va yozuvlarni tayyorlab qo'yish topshirilgan edi. Bu farmon, albatta, sizga tegishli bo'lishi mumkin emas, chunki bu ko'p yillar oldin bo'lgan, agar hozir kasal bo'lmaganimda va to'shakda eng kulgili narsalar haqida o'ylashga yetarlicha vaqtim bo'lmaganida, uni eslamagan bo'lardim. — Mitsi, — dedi u birdan hikoyasini to'xtatib, hamon tushunib bo'lmas bir ish bilan xona bo'ylab sirpanib yurgan ayolga, — iltimos, ana u shkafga qarab ko'r, balki farmonni toparsan. — Bu, — dedi u K.ga tushuntirib, — mening dastlabki davrimdan, o'shanda men hali hamma narsani saqlardim. — Ayol darhol shkafni ochdi, K. va oqsoqol qarab turishdi. Shkaf qog'ozlarga tiqilib ketgan edi. Ochilganda o'tin bog'lagandek dumaloq bog'langan ikki katta hujjatlar dastasi yumalab chiqdi, ayol qo'rqib chetga sakradi. «Pastda bo'lsa kerak, pastda», dedi oqsoqol to'shakdan boshqarib.

paras.en: Obediently the woman, gathering up the files in both arms, threw everything out of the cupboard to get at the papers at the bottom. The papers already covered half the room. 'A lot of work has been done,' said the mayor, nodding, 'and that is only a small part. I've kept the bulk in the barn, and most of it has been lost, of course. Who can keep all that together! But there's still a great deal in the barn.' — 'Will you be able to find the decree?' he turned to his wife again. 'You must look for a file on which the word "land surveyor" is underlined in blue.' — 'It's too dark here,' said the woman, 'I'll fetch a candle,' and she went out of the room, stepping over the papers. 'My wife is a great support to me,' said the mayor, 'in this heavy official work, which after all has to be done only on the side. True, I have another helper for the written work, the teacher, but even so it's impossible to get finished; a great deal always remains undone — it's collected over there in that chest,' and he pointed to another cupboard. 'And now that I'm ill it's getting out of hand,' he said, and lay back tired but proud too. 'Couldn't I,' said K., when the woman had come back with the candle and was kneeling in front of the chest looking for the decree, 'help your wife search?'
paras.uz: Ayol itoatkorona hujjatlarni ikki qo'llab quchoqlab, pastdagi qog'ozlarga yetish uchun shkafdagi hamma narsani tashqariga uloqtirdi. Qog'ozlar allaqachon xonaning yarmini qoplagan edi. «Ko'p ish qilingan, — dedi oqsoqol bosh irg'ab, — bu esa faqat kichik bir qismi. Asosiy qismini omborxonada saqlayman, ko'p qismi, albatta, yo'qolib ketgan. Bularning hammasini kim saqlab qola oladi! Lekin omborxonada hali juda ko'p.» — «Farmonni topa olasanmi?» — deb yana xotiniga o'girildi u. «Ustida «yer o'lchovchi» so'zi ko'k rang bilan tagiga chizilgan hujjatni izlashing kerak.» — «Bu yer juda qorong'i, — dedi ayol, — sham olib kelaman», va qog'ozlar ustidan oshib xonadan chiqdi. «Xotinim menga katta tayanch, — dedi oqsoqol, — faqat qo'shimcha ravishda bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan bu og'ir rasmiy ishda. To'g'ri, yozma ishlar uchun yana bir yordamchim — o'qituvchi bor, lekin shunga qaramay ishni tugatib bo'lmaydi, doim ko'p narsa bajarilmay qoladi, u mana anavi qutida to'plangan», — va u boshqa shkafni ko'rsatdi. «Ayniqsa hozir kasal bo'lganimda, u haddan oshib ketyapti», dedi u va charchagan, lekin baribir mag'rur holda orqaga yotdi. «Xotiningizga izlashda yordam bersam bo'lmaydimi?» — dedi K., ayol sham bilan qaytib kelib, quti oldida tiz cho'kib farmonni izlayotganida.

paras.en: The mayor shook his head with a smile: 'As I said, I have no official secrets from you; but to let you search the files yourself — I really can't go that far.' The room was quiet now; only the rustling of papers could be heard; perhaps the mayor even dozed a little. A soft knock at the door made K. turn round. It was the assistants, of course. At least they had been trained a little: they did not storm into the room at once but first whispered through the slightly opened door: 'It's too cold for us outside.' — 'Who is it?' asked the mayor, starting up. 'It's only my assistants,' said K. 'I don't know where to have them wait for me; it's too cold outside, and in here they're a nuisance.' — 'They don't bother me,' said the mayor kindly. 'Let them come in. Besides, I know them. Old acquaintances.' — 'But they bother me,' said K. frankly, letting his gaze wander from the assistants to the mayor and back to the assistants, and finding the smiles of all three indistinguishably alike. 'But since you're here now,' he then said tentatively, 'stay and help the mayor's wife look for a file on which the word "land surveyor" is underlined in blue.' The mayor raised no objection.
paras.uz: Oqsoqol jilmayib boshini chayqadi: «Aytganimdek, men sizdan rasmiy sirlarni yashirmayman; lekin hujjatlarni o'zingizga qidirtirish — bunchalik uzoqqa bora olmayman.» Endi xonada jimlik cho'kdi, faqat qog'ozlarning shitirlashi eshitilardi, oqsoqol balki hatto biroz mudrab ham qoldi. Eshikdagi sekin taqillash K.ni o'girilishga majbur qildi. Bular, albatta, yordamchilar edi. Har holda ular biroz tarbiyalangan edilar: xonaga darhol bostirib kirishmadi, avval biroz ochilgan eshikdan pichirlashdi: «Tashqarida bizga juda sovuq.» — «Kim u?» — so'radi oqsoqol cho'chib tushib. «Faqat mening yordamchilarim, — dedi K., — ularni qayerda meni kutishga qo'yishni bilmayman, tashqarida juda sovuq, bu yerda esa ular xalaqit beradi.» — «Menga xalaqit bermaydi, — dedi oqsoqol mehribonlik bilan. — Kirishsin. Aytgancha, men ularni taniyman. Eski tanishlar.» — «Lekin menga xalaqit beradi», dedi K. ochiqchasiga, nigohini yordamchilardan oqsoqolga va yana yordamchilarga yurgizdi va uchovining jilmayishini farqlab bo'lmas darajada bir xil deb topdi. «Lekin endi shu yerda ekansizlar, — dedi u keyin sinab ko'rgandek, — qolinglar va oqsoqolning xotiniga ustida «yer o'lchovchi» so'zi ko'k rang bilan tagiga chizilgan hujjatni izlashda yordam beringlar.» Oqsoqol e'tiroz bildirmadi.

paras.en: What K. was not allowed to do, the assistants were. They threw themselves on the papers at once, but they rummaged in the heaps rather than searched, and whenever one of them was spelling out a document, the other would snatch it out of his hand. The woman, on the other hand, knelt before the empty chest; she seemed not to be searching any more at all; at any rate the candle stood very far from her. 'The assistants,' said the mayor with a self-satisfied smile, as though everything went back to his orders but nobody could so much as guess it, 'so they're a nuisance to you — but they are your own assistants.' — 'No,' said K. coolly, 'they only ran up to me here.' — 'What do you mean, ran up?' said the mayor. 'Were assigned to you, I suppose you mean.' — 'Well, then, were assigned,' said K. 'But they might just as well have fallen from the sky with the snow, so thoughtless was this assignment.' — 'Nothing happens thoughtlessly here,' said the mayor, even forgetting the pain in his foot and sitting up. 'Nothing,' said K., 'and what about my appointment?' — 'Your appointment too was certainly considered,' said the mayor; 'only side circumstances have intervened confusingly; I'll prove it to you from the files.' — 'The files won't be found,' said K. 'Not found?' cried the mayor. 'Mizzi, please, search a little faster! But I can tell you the story without the files first.
paras.uz: K.ga mumkin bo'lmagan narsa yordamchilarga mumkin edi; ular darhol qog'ozlarga tashlanishdi, lekin izlashdan ko'ra ko'proq uyumlarni titkilashardi, biri biror hujjatni harflab o'qiyotganda, ikkinchisi doim uni qo'lidan yulib olardi. Ayol esa bo'sh quti oldida tiz cho'kib turardi, u endi umuman izlamayotgandek edi, har holda sham undan juda uzoqda turardi. «Yordamchilar, — dedi oqsoqol o'zidan mamnun jilmayish bilan, go'yo hamma narsa uning buyruqlariga borib taqaladi-yu, lekin hech kim buni hatto taxmin ham qila olmaydigandek, — demak, ular sizga xalaqit beradi, lekin ular axir sizning o'z yordamchilaringiz.» — «Yo'q, — dedi K. sovuqqina, — ular menga shu yerda yopishib olishgan.» — «Qanday yopishib olishgan, — dedi oqsoqol, — biriktirilgan, demoqchisiz shekilli.» — «Mayli, biriktirilgan, — dedi K. — Lekin ular xuddi qor bilan osmondan tushgandek ham bo'lishi mumkin edi — bu biriktirish shunchalik o'ylamasdan qilingan.» — «Bu yerda hech narsa o'ylamasdan qilinmaydi», dedi oqsoqol va hatto oyog'idagi og'riqni ham unutib, to'g'rilanib o'tirdi. «Hech narsa, — dedi K., — mening chaqirilishim-chi?» — «Sizning chaqirilishingiz ham, albatta, o'ylab ko'rilgan, — dedi oqsoqol, — faqat qo'shimcha holatlar chalkashlik bilan aralashgan, men buni sizga hujjatlar asosida isbotlab beraman.» — «Hujjatlar topilmaydi-ku», dedi K. «Topilmaydimi? — qichqirdi oqsoqol. — Mitsi, iltimos, biroz tezroq izla! Lekin avval sizga voqeani hujjatlarsiz ham aytib berishim mumkin.

paras.en: We answered the decree I mentioned, with thanks, by saying that we did not need a land surveyor. But this answer seems not to have got back to the original department — I'll call it A — but by mistake to another department, B. So department A was left without an answer; but unfortunately B did not get our whole answer either. Whether the contents of the file stayed behind with us or got lost on the way — certainly not in the department itself, I'll vouch for that — in any case only a file cover arrived at department B, on which nothing was noted except that the enclosed file, which in reality was unfortunately missing, concerned the engagement of a land surveyor. Department A, meanwhile, was waiting for our answer. It had notes on the matter, but, as understandably happens fairly often and may happen given the precision of all business, the official in charge relied on our answering, and on then either engaging the land surveyor or corresponding further with us about the matter as needed. As a result he neglected his notes, and the whole thing was forgotten in his office. In department B, however, the file cover came to an official famous for his conscientiousness — Sordini is his name, an Italian; it is incomprehensible even to me, an insider, why a man of his abilities is left in an almost subordinate position. This Sordini naturally sent the empty file cover back to us to be completed.
paras.uz: Men aytgan o'sha farmonga biz minnatdorchilik bildirib, bizga yer o'lchovchi kerak emas, deb javob berdik. Lekin bu javob, aftidan, asl bo'limga — uni A deb atay — qaytib bormagan, balki xato bilan boshqa bir B bo'limiga borgan. Demak, A bo'limi javobsiz qoldi, lekin afsuski, B ham bizning to'liq javobimizni olmadi; xoh hujjat mazmuni bizda qolib ketgan bo'lsin, xoh yo'lda yo'qolgan bo'lsin — bo'limning o'zida, albatta, emas, bunga men kafolat beraman — har holda B bo'limiga ham faqat hujjat jildi yetib keldi, unda faqat ichidagi, lekin afsuski, aslida yo'q bo'lgan hujjat yer o'lchovchini chaqirish haqida ekani qayd etilgan edi. A bo'limi esa bu orada bizning javobimizni kutardi, unda bu ish bo'yicha qaydlar bor edi, lekin tushunarli tarzda tez-tez bo'lib turadiganidek va barcha ishlarning aniqligi sharoitida bo'lishi mumkin bo'lganidek, mas'ul amaldor biz javob beramiz, keyin u yo yer o'lchovchini chaqiradi, yo ehtiyojga qarab biz bilan bu ish bo'yicha yozishishni davom ettiradi, deb ishondi. Natijada u qaydlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirdi va butun ish uning qo'lida unutilib ketdi. B bo'limida esa hujjat jildi vijdonliligi bilan mashhur bo'lgan bir amaldorga — uning ismi Sordini, italiyalik — tushdi; hatto men — ichkaridagi odam uchun ham uning qobiliyatlaridagi odam nega deyarli quyi lavozimda qoldirilayotgani tushunarsiz. Bu Sordini, albatta, bizga bo'sh hujjat jildini to'ldirish uchun qaytarib yubordi.

paras.en: But by now many months, if not years, had passed since that first letter from department A. Understandably so, for when a file goes the right way, as is the rule, it reaches its department within a day at the latest and is dealt with the same day; but if it once misses its way — and given the excellence of the organization it must positively seek out the wrong way with zeal, otherwise it won't find it — then, then of course it takes a very long time. So when we got Sordini's note, we could remember the matter only very vaguely. At that time there were only two of us for the work, Mizzi and I; the teacher had not yet been assigned to me; we kept copies only in the most important matters; in short, we could only answer very vaguely that we knew nothing of any such appointment and that we had no need of a land surveyor.'
paras.uz: Lekin A bo'limining o'sha birinchi maktubidan beri ko'p oylar, balki yillar o'tib ketgan edi; bu tushunarli, chunki agar hujjat, qoidaga ko'ra, to'g'ri yo'ldan borsa, u o'z bo'limiga ko'pi bilan bir kunda yetib boradi va o'sha kuniyoq hal qilinadi; lekin agar u bir marta yo'ldan adashsa — tashkilotning mukammalligi sharoitida u noto'g'ri yo'lni rosmana g'ayrat bilan izlashi kerak, aks holda uni topa olmaydi — unda, unda, albatta, juda uzoq davom etadi. Shuning uchun Sordinining xatini olganimizda, ishni juda noaniq eslay oldik; o'shanda ish uchun faqat ikkimiz edik — Mitsi va men, o'qituvchi hali menga biriktirilmagan edi, nusxalarni faqat eng muhim ishlarda saqlardik, qisqasi, biz faqat juda noaniq javob bera oldik: bunday chaqiruv haqida hech narsa bilmaymiz va bizda yer o'lchovchiga ehtiyoj yo'q.»

paras.en: 'But,' the mayor interrupted himself here, as though in the eagerness of his story he had gone too far, or as though it were at least possible that he had, 'doesn't the story bore you?'
paras.uz: — Lekin, — deb oqsoqol shu yerda o'z gapini bo'ldi, go'yo hikoya qilish g'ayratida haddan oshib ketgandek yoki hech bo'lmaganda oshib ketgan bo'lishi mumkindek, — hikoya sizni zeriktirmayaptimi?

paras.en: 'No,' said K. 'It amuses me.'
paras.uz: — Yo'q, — dedi K. — U meni qiziqtiryapti.

paras.en: To which the mayor said: 'I'm not telling it to amuse you.'
paras.uz: Bunga oqsoqol: — Men buni sizni qiziqtirish uchun aytayotganim yo'q.

paras.en: 'It amuses me only,' said K., 'because I am getting a glimpse into the ridiculous tangle which may, under certain circumstances, decide a man's existence.'
paras.uz: — U meni faqat shu bilan qiziqtiryapti, — dedi K., — ma'lum sharoitlarda insonning mavjudligini hal qiladigan kulgili chalkashlikka bir nazar tashlashga imkon beryapti.

paras.en: 'You haven't had a glimpse yet,' said the mayor seriously, 'and I can tell you more. Naturally a man like Sordini was not satisfied with our answer. I admire the man, although he is a torment to me. You see, he mistrusts everyone; even if, for instance, he has come to know someone on countless occasions as the most trustworthy person, he mistrusts him on the next occasion as if he did not know him at all — or rather, as if he knew him to be a scoundrel. I consider that right; an official must proceed like that. Unfortunately, by my nature I cannot follow this principle; you see how I lay everything openly before you, a stranger; I just can't do otherwise. Sordini, on the other hand, at once conceived a mistrust of our answer. A great correspondence now developed.
paras.uz: — Siz hali hech qanday nazar tashlaganingiz yo'q, — dedi oqsoqol jiddiy, — men sizga davomini aytib bera olaman. Bizning javobimiz, albatta, Sordini kabi odamni qoniqtirmadi. Men bu odamga qoyil qolaman, garchi u men uchun azob bo'lsa ham. Gap shundaki, u hammaga ishonmaydi; masalan, biror kishini son-sanoqsiz holatlarda eng ishonchli odam sifatida bilgan bo'lsa ham, keyingi safar unga go'yo uni umuman tanimaydigandek, aniqrog'i, uni yaramas deb biladigandek ishonmaydi. Men buni to'g'ri deb hisoblayman, amaldor shunday yo'l tutishi kerak; afsuski, men tabiatimga ko'ra bu tamoyilga amal qila olmayman, ko'ryapsizki, men sizga — begonaga hamma narsani ochiq aytayapman, boshqacha qila olmayman. Sordini esa bizning javobimizga darhol shubha bilan qaradi. Endi katta yozishmalar boshlandi.

paras.en: Sordini asked why it had suddenly occurred to me that no land surveyor should be engaged. With the help of Mizzi's excellent memory I answered that the first suggestion had come from the authorities after all — that a different department was involved we had naturally long forgotten. Sordini: why did I mention this official letter only now? I in turn: because I had only now remembered it. Sordini: that was very strange. I: it was not strange at all in a matter dragging on so long. Sordini: it was strange all the same, for the letter I remembered did not exist. I: of course it didn't exist, because the whole file had been lost. Sordini: but there must be a note regarding that first letter, and there was none. There I stopped, for I dared neither to claim nor to believe that a mistake had occurred in Sordini's department. Perhaps, land surveyor, you are reproaching Sordini in your mind for not having been moved, out of regard for my assertion, at least to enquire about the matter in other departments. But that very thing would have been wrong — I don't want a stain to remain on that man even in your thoughts. It is a working principle of the authorities that the possibility of error is not reckoned with at all. This principle is justified by the excellent organization of the whole, and it is necessary if the utmost speed of business is to be achieved.
paras.uz: Sordini nega birdan yer o'lchovchi chaqirilmasligi kerakligi xayolimga kelganini so'radi; men Mitsining ajoyib xotirasi yordamida birinchi taklif axir rasmiy tomondan kelgan-ku, deb javob berdim (bu boshqa bo'lim ekanini biz, albatta, allaqachon unutgan edik); Sordini esa: nega men bu rasmiy xatni faqat endi eslayapman; men yana: chunki uni faqat endi esladim; Sordini: bu juda g'alati; men: shunchalik cho'zilib ketgan ishda bu umuman g'alati emas; Sordini: baribir g'alati, chunki men eslagan xat mavjud emas; men: albatta, u mavjud emas, chunki butun hujjat yo'qolgan; Sordini: lekin o'sha birinchi xat haqida qandaydir qayd bo'lishi kerak edi, lekin u yo'q. Shu yerda men to'xtab qoldim, chunki Sordinining bo'limida xato yuz bergan, deb da'vo qilishga ham, ishonishga ham jur'at etmasdim. Balki siz, janob yer o'lchovchi, xayolan Sordinini mening da'voimni hisobga olib, hech bo'lmaganda boshqa bo'limlardan bu ish haqida surishtirishi kerak edi, deb ayblayotgandirsiz. Lekin aynan bu noto'g'ri bo'lardi, men bu odamga hatto sizning xayolingizda ham dog' qolishini istamayman. Xato ehtimoli umuman hisobga olinmasligi — idoraning ish tamoyili. Bu tamoyil butun tizimning ajoyib tashkil etilgani bilan oqlanadi va agar ishni eng tez hal qilishga erishish kerak bo'lsa, u zarur.

paras.en: So Sordini was not allowed to enquire in other departments at all; besides, those departments would not have answered him, because they would have noticed at once that it was a matter of investigating a possible error.'
paras.uz: Demak, Sordini boshqa bo'limlardan umuman surishtira olmasdi; aytgancha, bu bo'limlar unga umuman javob bermagan bo'lardi, chunki darhol gap xato ehtimolini tekshirish haqida ekanini payqagan bo'lardilar.

paras.en: 'Allow me to interrupt you with a question, mayor,' said K. 'Didn't you mention earlier a control authority? According to your account, the management is such that one feels sick at the idea that the control might fail.'
paras.uz: — Ruxsat bering, janob oqsoqol, sizni bir savol bilan to'xtatay, — dedi K., — siz avvalroq qandaydir nazorat idorasini eslatmaganmidingiz? Sizning ta'rifingizga ko'ra, xo'jalik shundayki, nazorat bo'lmasligi mumkinligini tasavvur qilganda ko'ngil ayniydi.

paras.en: 'You are very strict,' said the mayor. 'But multiply your strictness a thousandfold, and it will still be nothing compared with the strictness the authorities apply to themselves. Only a complete stranger could ask your question. Are there control authorities? There are only control authorities. Of course, they are not meant to find errors in the crude sense of the word, for errors don't occur; and even if an error does occur once, as in your case, who may say conclusively that it is an error?'
paras.uz: — Siz juda qattiqqo'lsiz, — dedi oqsoqol. — Lekin qattiqqo'lligingizni ming baravar oshiring, u baribir idora o'ziga nisbatan qo'llaydigan qattiqqo'llik oldida hech narsa bo'lmaydi. Sizning savolingizni faqat butunlay begona odam bera oladi. Nazorat idoralari bormi? Faqat nazorat idoralari bor. Albatta, ular qo'pol ma'nodagi xatolarni topish uchun mo'ljallanmagan, chunki xatolar bo'lmaydi, hatto bir marta xato bo'lsa ham, sizning holatingizdagidek, kim buni uzil-kesil xato deb ayta oladi?

paras.en: 'That would be something completely new!' cried K.
paras.uz: — Bu mutlaqo yangi narsa bo'lardi! — qichqirdi K.

paras.en: 'To me it's something very old,' said the mayor. 'I am not much less convinced than you yourself that an error has occurred, and Sordini has fallen seriously ill from despair over it, and the first control offices, to whom we owe the discovery of the source of the error, recognize the error here too. But who may claim that the second control offices will judge likewise, and the third, and the others after them?'
paras.uz: — Men uchun bu juda eski narsa, — dedi oqsoqol. — Men ham sizdan unchalik farq qilmagan holda xato yuz berganiga ishonaman, Sordini esa bundan umidsizlikka tushib, og'ir kasal bo'lib qoldi, xato manbasini topganimiz uchun minnatdor bo'lgan birinchi nazorat idoralari ham bu yerda xatoni tan oladi. Lekin ikkinchi nazorat idoralari ham, uchinchilari ham, keyingi boshqalari ham xuddi shunday hukm chiqaradi, deb kim da'vo qila oladi?

paras.en: 'That may be,' said K., 'but I'd rather not meddle in such considerations; besides, I'm hearing of these control offices for the first time and naturally can't understand them yet. Only I think two things must be distinguished here: first, what goes on inside the offices and can then in turn be officially interpreted this way or that; and second, my real person — I, who stand outside the offices and am threatened by the offices with an injury so senseless that I still cannot believe the danger is serious. To the first, what you are telling me, mayor, with such astonishing, extraordinary expertise, probably applies; but then I should also like to hear a word about myself.'
paras.uz: — Bo'lishi mumkin, — dedi K., — lekin bunday mulohazalarga aralashmaganim ma'qul; buning ustiga, men bu nazorat idoralari haqida birinchi marta eshityapman va ularni, albatta, hali tushuna olmayman. Faqat menimcha, bu yerda ikki narsani farqlash kerak: birinchidan, idoralar ichida sodir bo'ladigan va keyin rasmiy ravishda u yoki bu tarzda tushunilishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa, ikkinchidan, mening haqiqiy shaxsim — idoralardan tashqarida turgan va idoralar tomonidan shunchalik bema'ni zarar bilan tahdid qilinayotgan menki, hali ham xavfning jiddiyligiga ishona olmayman. Birinchisiga, ehtimol, siz, janob oqsoqol, shunchalik hayratlanarli, g'ayrioddiy bilimdonlik bilan aytib berayotgan narsa tegishlidir, lekin keyin men o'zim haqimda ham bir so'z eshitmoqchiman.

paras.en: 'I'm coming to that,' said the mayor, 'but you couldn't understand it unless I told you a few more things first. Even mentioning the control offices just now was premature. So I'll go back to the disagreements with Sordini. As I said, my resistance gradually weakened. But if Sordini holds even the slightest advantage over anyone, he has already won, for then his attention, energy and presence of mind increase still more; and for the person attacked he is a terrible sight, for that person's enemies a splendid one. It is only because I have experienced the latter too, in other cases, that I can speak of him as I do. Incidentally, I have never yet managed to set eyes on him; he cannot come down, he is too overloaded with work. His room has been described to me: all the walls are hidden by columns of great bundles of files stacked on top of one another — and those are only the files Sordini happens to be working on — and since files are constantly being taken out of the bundles and put back, and everything happens in great haste, these columns keep collapsing, and precisely this constant crashing, in quick succession, has become characteristic of Sordini's office. Well, Sordini is a worker, and he devotes the same care to the smallest case as to the biggest.' 'You keep calling my case one of the smallest, mayor,' said K., 'and yet it has kept many officials very busy, and even if it was perhaps very small at first, it has been made into a big case by the zeal of officials of Herr Sordini's kind. Unfortunately, and very much against my will — for my ambition is not to cause great columns of files about me to rise and crash down, but to work quietly as a small land surveyor at a small drawing table.
paras.uz: — Bunga ham kelaman, — dedi oqsoqol, — lekin agar avval yana ba'zi narsalarni aytmasam, buni tushuna olmaysiz. Hozir nazorat idoralarini eslatganim ham erta edi. Shuning uchun Sordini bilan kelishmovchiliklarga qaytaman. Aytganimdek, mening himoyam asta-sekin zaiflashdi. Lekin agar Sordini kimgadir nisbatan eng kichik ustunlikka ega bo'lsa, u allaqachon g'alaba qozongan, chunki endi uning diqqati, g'ayrati, hozirjavobligi yanada oshadi; u hujumga uchragan odam uchun dahshatli, hujumga uchragan odamning dushmanlari uchun esa ajoyib manzara. Faqat boshqa holatlarda bu keyingisini ham boshdan kechirganim uchun u haqida shunday gapira olaman. Aytgancha, men uni hali hech qachon o'z ko'zim bilan ko'ra olmaganman, u pastga tusha olmaydi, ishga haddan tashqari ko'milgan; menga uning xonasini shunday tasvirlab berishganki, barcha devorlar bir-birining ustiga taxlangan katta hujjat dastalaridan iborat ustunlar bilan to'silgan, bular faqat Sordini hozir ustida ishlayotgan hujjatlar, dastalardan doim hujjatlar olinib, qo'yilib turgani va hammasi katta shoshilinchlikda sodir bo'lgani uchun, bu ustunlar doim qulab turadi va aynan bu tinimsiz, ketma-ket gumburlash Sordinining ish xonasiga xos bo'lib qolgan. Xullas, Sordini — ishchi odam, u eng kichik ishga ham eng kattasiga bergan g'amxo'rligini beradi. — Siz, janob oqsoqol, — dedi K., — mening ishimni doim eng kichiklaridan biri deb atayapsiz, lekin u ko'p amaldorlarni juda band qilgan va agar boshida juda kichik bo'lgan bo'lsa ham, janob Sordini kabi amaldorlarning g'ayrati bilan katta ishga aylangan. Afsuski, va mening irodamga juda zid ravishda, chunki mening orzuim men haqimdagi katta hujjat ustunlari paydo bo'lishi va qulashi emas, balki kichik yer o'lchovchi sifatida kichik chizmachilik stoli yonida tinch ishlashdir.

chapters.title: 6. The telephone and the keepsakes
chapters.recap_uz: Oqsoqol Brunsvik va qishloq kengashi haqida, idoraning «o'z-o'zidan» chiqaradigan qarorlari haqida gapiradi. Uning fikricha, Klammning maktubi rasmiy emas, shaxsiy maktub; Qasrdan keladigan telefon javoblari esa ko'pincha charchagan amaldorlarning hazili. K. o'z huquqini talab qiladi. Mehmonxonaga qaytgach, beka Gardena unga xabarchi yigitning surati, ro'mol va qalpoqchani — yigirma yildan ortiq saqlab kelgan Klamm yodgorliklarini ko'rsatadi.

paras.en: 'No,' said the mayor, 'it is not a big case. In that respect you have no reason to complain; it is one of the smallest among the small. The amount of work does not determine the rank of a case; you are still far from understanding the authorities if you think so. But even if the amount of work were what counted, your case would be one of the least; ordinary cases, that is, those without so-called errors, give much more work, and of course much more fruitful work. Besides, you know nothing yet of the real work your case caused; that is what I am about to tell you. At first Sordini left me out of it, but his officials came, and every day formal interrogations of respected members of the community took place at the Herrenhof. Most of them stood by me; only a few became suspicious. The question of land surveying touches a peasant closely; they scented some secret agreements and injustices, found a leader into the bargain, and Sordini was bound to conclude from their statements that if I had put the question before the village council, not everyone would have been against engaging a land surveyor. So something self-evident — namely, that no land surveyor is needed — was made at least questionable. A certain Brunswick distinguished himself especially in this — you probably don't know him. He is perhaps not bad, but stupid and full of fancies; he is a brother-in-law of Lasemann's.'
paras.uz: — Yo'q, — dedi oqsoqol, — bu katta ish emas. Bu jihatdan nolishga asosingiz yo'q, bu kichiklar orasidagi eng kichik ishlardan biri. Ishning hajmi ishning darajasini belgilamaydi, agar shunday deb o'ylasangiz, idorani tushunishdan hali juda uzoqsiz. Lekin hatto ish hajmi muhim bo'lganida ham, sizning ishingiz eng kichiklaridan biri bo'lardi; oddiy ishlar, ya'ni xato deb ataladigan narsasiz ishlar ancha ko'p va, albatta, ancha samaraliroq ish beradi. Aytgancha, siz hali ishingiz keltirib chiqargan haqiqiy ish haqida hech narsa bilmaysiz, men hozir shu haqda aytib bermoqchiman. Avvaliga Sordini meni chetda qoldirdi, lekin uning amaldorlari kelishdi, har kuni «Herrenhof»da jamoaning obro'li a'zolarini bayonnomali so'roq qilish bo'lardi. Ularning aksariyati meni qo'llab-quvvatladi, faqat ba'zilari shubhaga tushdi; yer o'lchash masalasi dehqonga yaqin, ular qandaydir yashirin kelishuvlar va adolatsizliklarni hidlashdi, buning ustiga o'zlariga boshliq topishdi va Sordini ularning ko'rsatmalaridan, agar men masalani qishloq kengashiga qo'yganimda, hamma ham yer o'lchovchi chaqirilishiga qarshi bo'lmas edi, degan ishonchga kelishi kerak edi. Shunday qilib, o'z-o'zidan ayon bo'lgan narsa — ya'ni yer o'lchovchi kerak emasligi — hech bo'lmaganda shubhali qilib qo'yildi. Bunda ayniqsa qandaydir Brunsvik ajralib turdi — siz uni tanimasangiz kerak — u balki yomon odam emasdir, lekin ahmoq va xayolparast, u Lazemanning bajasi.

paras.en: 'The master tanner?' asked K., and described the full-bearded man he had seen at Lasemann's.
paras.uz: — Ko'nchi ustaningmi? — so'radi K. va Lazemannikida ko'rgan to'la soqolli odamni tasvirlab berdi.

paras.en: 'Yes, that's him,' said the mayor.
paras.uz: — Ha, aynan o'sha, — dedi oqsoqol.

paras.en: 'I know his wife too,' said K., a little at random.
paras.uz: — Uning xotinini ham taniyman, — dedi K. biroz tavakkal qilib.

paras.en: 'That's possible,' said the mayor, and fell silent.
paras.uz: — Bo'lishi mumkin, — dedi oqsoqol va jim bo'lib qoldi.

paras.en: 'She is beautiful,' said K., 'but a little pale and sickly. She comes from the Castle, I suppose?' This was said half as a question.
paras.uz: — U chiroyli, — dedi K., — lekin biroz rangpar va kasalmand. U Qasrdan kelgan bo'lsa kerak? — Bu yarim so'roq tarzida aytildi.

paras.en: The mayor looked at the clock, poured medicine onto a spoon and swallowed it hastily.
paras.uz: Oqsoqol soatga qaradi, qoshiqqa dori quyib, uni shoshib yutdi.

paras.en: 'I suppose all you know of the Castle is the office furniture?' asked K. rudely.
paras.uz: — Siz Qasrda faqat idora jihozlarini bilsangiz kerak? — so'radi K. qo'pollik bilan.

paras.en: 'Yes,' said the mayor with an ironic and yet grateful smile. 'That is also the most important thing. And as for Brunswick: if we could exclude him from the community, almost all of us would be happy, and Lasemann not least. But at that time Brunswick gained some influence; he's no orator, but he's a shouter, and that is enough for some. And so it came about that I was forced to put the matter before the village council — Brunswick's only success at first, by the way, for naturally the council, by a large majority, would have nothing to do with a land surveyor. That too was years ago now, but all that time the matter has never come to rest — partly because of the conscientiousness of Sordini, who tried by the most careful enquiries to discover the motives of both the majority and the opposition, partly because of the stupidity and ambition of Brunswick, who has various personal connections with the authorities and kept setting them in motion with ever new inventions of his fancy. Sordini, of course, did not let himself be deceived by Brunswick — how could Brunswick deceive Sordini? But precisely in order not to be deceived, new enquiries were necessary, and before they were finished Brunswick had already thought up something new; he is very nimble, it belongs to his stupidity. And now I come to a special characteristic of our official apparatus. In keeping with its precision, it is also extremely sensitive.
paras.uz: — Ha, — dedi oqsoqol kinoyali, lekin minnatdor jilmayish bilan. — Ular eng muhim narsa ham. Brunsvikka kelsak: agar uni jamoadan chiqarib yubora olsak, deyarli hammamiz baxtli bo'lardik, Lazeman ham eng kam emas. Lekin o'shanda Brunsvik qandaydir ta'sirga ega bo'ldi, u notiq emas, lekin baqiroq, ba'zilarga bu ham yetadi. Shunday qilib, men masalani qishloq kengashiga qo'yishga majbur bo'ldim, aytgancha, bu avvaliga Brunsvikning yagona muvaffaqiyati edi, chunki kengash, albatta, katta ko'pchilik bilan yer o'lchovchi haqida hech narsa bilishni istamadi. Bu ham allaqachon yillar oldin bo'lgan, lekin butun vaqt davomida ish tinchimadi — qisman ko'pchilikning ham, muxolifatning ham sabablarini eng sinchkov tekshiruvlar bilan o'rganishga urinadigan Sordinining vijdonliligi tufayli, qisman idoralar bilan turli shaxsiy aloqalari bo'lgan va ularni xayolining tobora yangi to'qimalari bilan harakatga keltirib turgan Brunsvikning ahmoqligi va shuhratparastligi tufayli. Sordini, albatta, Brunsvikka aldanmadi — Brunsvik Sordinini qanday aldasin? Lekin aynan aldanmaslik uchun yangi tekshiruvlar kerak edi va ular tugamasdanoq Brunsvik allaqachon yana yangi narsa o'ylab topgan edi; u juda serharakat, bu uning ahmoqligiga tegishli. Endi esa idora apparatimizning alohida bir xususiyati haqida gapiraman. O'zining aniqligiga mos ravishda u nihoyatda sezgir ham.

paras.en: When a matter has been considered for a very long time, it can happen, even before the considerations are finished, that suddenly, like lightning, at some unforeseeable point that cannot be found later either, a decision emerges which settles the matter — very rightly, as a rule, but arbitrarily all the same. It is as though the official apparatus could no longer bear the tension, the years of irritation by the same matter, perhaps trivial in itself, and had made the decision out of itself, without the officials' help. Of course no miracle has happened, and some official has certainly written the decision or made an unwritten one; but in any case it cannot be established, at least not by us, from here, nor even from the office, which official decided in this case and for what reasons. Only the control offices establish that, much later; but we never learn of it, and by then it would hardly interest anyone any more. Now, as I said, these very decisions are mostly excellent; the only disturbing thing about them is that, as is usually the way, one learns of them too late and so goes on passionately debating matters that were decided long ago.
paras.uz: Agar bir ish juda uzoq vaqt o'ylab ko'rilgan bo'lsa, mulohazalar hali tugamagan bo'lsa ham, birdan chaqmoqdek, oldindan ko'rib bo'lmaydigan va keyin ham topib bo'lmaydigan bir joyda ishni — ko'pincha juda to'g'ri bo'lsa ham, baribir o'zboshimchalik bilan — yakunlaydigan bir qaror paydo bo'lishi mumkin. Go'yo idora apparati o'sha bir xil, ehtimol o'z-o'zidan arzimas bo'lgan ish tufayli yillar davom etgan zo'riqish va qo'zg'atishga endi chiday olmay, amaldorlarning yordamisiz, o'zidan qaror chiqargandek. Albatta, hech qanday mo'jiza sodir bo'lmagan, qandaydir amaldor qarorni yozgan yoki yozilmagan qaror qabul qilgan, lekin har holda qaysi amaldor bu holatda qaror qilganini va qanday sabablarga ko'ra ekanini hech bo'lmaganda biz tomondan, bu yerdan, hatto idoradan ham aniqlab bo'lmaydi. Buni faqat nazorat idoralari ancha keyin aniqlaydi; lekin biz buni endi bilmaymiz, aytgancha, o'shanda bu hech kimni qiziqtirmaydi ham. Aytganimdek, aynan bu qarorlar ko'pincha ajoyib bo'ladi, ulardagi xalaqit beradigan yagona narsa — odatda bo'lganidek, bu qarorlar haqida juda kech bilasiz va shuning uchun bu orada allaqachon hal qilingan ishlar ustida hamon ehtiros bilan maslahatlashasiz.

paras.en: I don't know whether such a decision was made in your case — some things speak for it, some against. But if it had been, the summons would have been sent to you, and you would have made the long journey here; much time would have passed in the meantime, and all the while Sordini would still have been working himself to exhaustion over the same matter, Brunswick intriguing, and I tormented by both. I only hint at this possibility; but this much I know for certain: a control office meanwhile discovered that many years ago an enquiry about a land surveyor had gone out from department A to the community, without any answer having come so far. They asked me again, and now of course the whole matter was cleared up: department A was satisfied with my answer that no land surveyor was needed, and Sordini had to recognize that he had not been competent in this case and had done — through no fault of his own, of course — so much useless, nerve-shattering work. If new work had not pressed in from all sides as always, and if your case had not after all been only a very small case — one might almost say the smallest among the small — we would all have breathed again, I believe even Sordini himself. Only Brunswick sulked, but that was merely ridiculous.
paras.uz: Sizning ishingizda shunday qaror chiqarilganmi, bilmayman — ba'zi narsalar buni tasdiqlaydi, ba'zilari rad etadi; lekin agar shunday bo'lgan bo'lsa, sizga chaqiruv yuborilgan bo'lardi va siz bu yerga katta safar qilgan bo'lardingiz, bunda ko'p vaqt o'tardi va bu orada Sordini hamon shu yerda o'sha ish ustida holdan toyguncha ishlagan, Brunsvik fitna qilgan, men esa ikkovi tomonidan qiynalgan bo'lardim. Bu imkoniyatga faqat ishora qilaman, lekin quyidagini aniq bilaman: bu orada bir nazorat idorasi A bo'limidan ko'p yillar oldin jamoaga yer o'lchovchi haqida so'rov yuborilgani, lekin hozirgacha javob kelmaganini aniqladi. Mendan yana so'rashdi va endi, albatta, butun ish oydinlashdi: A bo'limi mening yer o'lchovchi kerak emas, degan javobim bilan qanoatlandi, Sordini esa bu ishda vakolatli bo'lmaganini va, albatta, aybsiz ravishda, shuncha keraksiz, asabni buzadigan ish qilganini tan olishi kerak bo'ldi. Agar har doimgidek har tomondan yangi ish yopirilib kelmaganida va sizning ishingiz baribir juda kichik ish — deyish mumkinki, kichiklar orasidagi eng kichigi — bo'lmaganida, hammamiz yengil nafas olgan bo'lardik, menimcha, hatto Sordinining o'zi ham. Faqat Brunsvik g'ashlandi, lekin bu shunchaki kulgili edi.

paras.en: And now imagine my disappointment, land surveyor, when now, after the whole affair had been happily concluded — and a long time has passed since then as well — you suddenly turn up, and it begins to look as though the matter were to start all over again. You will understand that I am firmly resolved not to allow that on any account, as far as it lies with me?'
paras.uz: Endi tasavvur qiling, janob yer o'lchovchi, butun ish baxtli yakunlangandan keyin — undan beri ham yana ko'p vaqt o'tdi — birdan siz paydo bo'lib, ish yana boshidan boshlanadigandek tuyulganida, mening ko'nglim qanchalik qoldi. Men bunga, qo'limdan kelguncha, hech qanday holatda yo'l qo'ymaslikka qat'iy qaror qilganimni tushunasiz, shundaymi?

paras.en: 'Certainly,' said K., 'but I understand even better that a terrible abuse is being practised here on me — perhaps even on the laws. As for me, I shall know how to defend myself.'
paras.uz: — Albatta, — dedi K., — lekin bundan ham yaxshiroq tushunamanki, bu yerda men bilan, balki hatto qonunlar bilan ham dahshatli suiiste'mol qilinmoqda. O'zim uchun bunga qarshi himoyalanishni bilaman.

paras.en: 'How do you intend to do that?' asked the mayor.
paras.uz: — Buni qanday qilmoqchisiz? — so'radi oqsoqol.

paras.en: 'I can't reveal that,' said K.
paras.uz: — Buni oshkor qila olmayman, — dedi K.

paras.en: 'I don't want to force myself on you,' said the mayor, 'only I would ask you to bear in mind that you have in me — I won't say a friend, for we are complete strangers — but in a sense a business friend. The one thing I won't allow is that you be taken on as land surveyor; otherwise you can always turn to me with confidence — within the limits of my power, of course, which is not great.'
paras.uz: — Men o'zimni majburlab tiqishtirmoqchi emasman, — dedi oqsoqol, — faqat o'ylab ko'rishingizni so'rayman: menda sizning — do'stingiz demayman, chunki biz butunlay begonamiz — lekin qaysidir ma'noda ish bo'yicha do'stingiz bor. Faqat sizning yer o'lchovchi sifatida qabul qilinishingizga yo'l qo'ymayman; boshqa hollarda menga doim ishonch bilan murojaat qilishingiz mumkin — albatta, katta bo'lmagan hokimiyatim chegarasida.

paras.en: 'You keep talking about my being taken on as land surveyor,' said K., 'but I have already been taken on. Here is Klamm's letter.'
paras.uz: — Siz doim, — dedi K., — men yer o'lchovchi sifatida qabul qilinishim kerak, deb gapirasiz, lekin men allaqachon qabul qilinganman. Mana Klammning maktubi.

paras.en: 'Klamm's letter,' said the mayor. 'It is valuable and venerable because of Klamm's signature, which seems to be genuine; otherwise, however — but I don't dare give an opinion on it alone. Mizzi!' he called, and then: 'But what are you doing?'
paras.uz: — Klammning maktubi, — dedi oqsoqol. — U Klammning haqiqiy ko'rinadigan imzosi tufayli qimmatli va muhtaram, lekin boshqa jihatdan… lekin bu haqda yolg'iz fikr bildirishga jur'at etmayman. Mitsi! — chaqirdi u va keyin: — Sizlar nima qilyapsizlar?

paras.en: The assistants and Mizzi, unnoticed for so long, had evidently not found the file they were looking for, and had then wanted to shut everything back in the cupboard, but had not managed it because of the disordered superabundance of files. Then the assistants had hit on the idea they were now carrying out. They had laid the cupboard on its back on the floor, stuffed all the files into it, then sat down with Mizzi on the cupboard door and were now trying in this way to press it slowly shut.
paras.uz: Shuncha vaqt e'tibordan chetda qolgan yordamchilar va Mitsi, aftidan, izlangan hujjatni topa olmagan, keyin hamma narsani yana shkafga qamab qo'ymoqchi bo'lishgan, lekin hujjatlarning tartibsiz ko'pligi tufayli buni uddalay olishmagan edi. Shunda yordamchilarning xayoliga hozir amalga oshirayotgan fikr kelgan bo'lsa kerak. Ular shkafni polga yotqizib, barcha hujjatlarni unga tiqishgan, keyin Mitsi bilan shkaf eshigi ustiga o'tirib, shu tarzda uni sekin bosib yopishga urinishardi.

paras.en: 'So the file hasn't been found,' said the mayor. 'A pity; but you know the story already, so we don't really need the file any more; besides, it will certainly turn up yet; it's probably at the teacher's, where there are a great many files. But now come here with your candle, Mizzi, and read me this letter.'
paras.uz: — Demak, hujjat topilmadi, — dedi oqsoqol. — Afsus, lekin voqeani siz allaqachon bilasiz, aslida bizga hujjat endi kerak emas, aytgancha, u albatta hali topiladi, u, ehtimol, o'qituvchida, unda hali juda ko'p hujjatlar bor. Lekin endi shaming bilan bu yoqqa kel, Mitsi, va menga bu maktubni o'qib ber.

paras.en: Mizzi came, and looked even greyer and more insignificant as she sat on the edge of the bed and pressed herself against the strong, vigorous man who held her round the waist. Only her little face stood out now in the candlelight, with clear, severe lines softened only by the decline of age. Hardly had she glanced at the letter when she lightly folded her hands. 'From Klamm,' she said. They then read the letter together, whispered a little with each other, and finally, just as the assistants shouted 'Hurrah!' — for they had at last pressed the cupboard door shut, and Mizzi looked over at them with quiet gratitude — the mayor said:
paras.uz: Mitsi keldi va karavot chetida o'tirib, uni belidan quchoqlab turgan kuchli, hayotga to'la erkakka suyanganida yanada kulrang va ko'rimsizroq ko'rindi. Endi sham yorug'ida faqat uning kichkina yuzi — aniq, qattiq, faqat yoshning so'nishi bilan yumshagan chiziqlari bilan — ko'zga tashlanardi. Maktubga qarashi bilanoq u qo'llarini yengil qovushtirdi. «Klammdan», dedi u. Keyin ular maktubni birga o'qishdi, bir-biri bilan biroz pichirlashdi va nihoyat, yordamchilar aynan «Hurra!» deb qichqirganlarida — chunki ular nihoyat shkaf eshigini bosib yopishgan edi, Mitsi esa ularga jim minnatdorlik bilan qaradi — oqsoqol dedi:

paras.en: 'Mizzi is completely of my opinion, and now I think I may venture to say it. This letter is not an official communication at all, but a private letter. That is clearly recognizable from the very salutation: "Dear Sir". Moreover, it does not say in a single word that you have been taken on as land surveyor; rather, it speaks only in general of the Count's service, and even that is not stated as binding: you have only been taken on "as you know" — that is, the burden of proof that you have been taken on is placed on you. Finally, in official matters you are referred exclusively to me, the mayor, as your immediate superior, who is to tell you everything further — which for the most part has already been done. To anyone who knows how to read official communications, and consequently reads unofficial letters even better, all this is more than plain. That you, a stranger, don't see it does not surprise me. On the whole, the letter means nothing more than that Klamm personally intends to look after you in case you are taken into the Count's service.'
paras.uz: — Mitsi mening fikrimga butunlay qo'shiladi, endi buni aytishga jur'at qilsam bo'ladi. Bu maktub umuman rasmiy xat emas, balki shaxsiy maktub. Buni murojaatning o'zidan — «Hurmatli janob!» — aniq bilish mumkin. Bundan tashqari, unda siz yer o'lchovchi sifatida qabul qilinganingiz haqida bir og'iz ham so'z yo'q, aksincha, umuman graflik xizmati haqida gap boradi, bu ham majburiy tarzda aytilmagan, siz faqat «o'zingiz bilganingizdek» qabul qilingansiz, ya'ni qabul qilinganingizni isbotlash yuki sizning zimmangizga yuklangan. Nihoyat, rasmiy jihatdan siz faqat menga — oqsoqolga bevosita boshlig'ingiz sifatida yo'naltirilgansiz, men sizga barcha batafsil ma'lumotlarni berishim kerak, bu esa katta qismi allaqachon bajarildi. Rasmiy xatlarni o'qishni biladigan va shuning uchun norasmiy maktublarni yanada yaxshiroq o'qiydigan odam uchun bularning hammasi haddan tashqari aniq. Sizning — begonaning buni tushunmasligingiz meni hayron qoldirmaydi. Umuman olganda, maktub faqat bir narsani anglatadi: agar siz graflik xizmatiga qabul qilinsangiz, Klamm shaxsan siz bilan qiziqishni niyat qilgan.

paras.en: 'You interpret the letter so well, mayor,' said K., 'that in the end nothing remains but a signature on a blank sheet of paper. Don't you notice how you are belittling Klamm's name, which you pretend to respect?'
paras.uz: — Siz, janob oqsoqol, — dedi K., — maktubni shunchalik yaxshi talqin qilyapsizki, oxir-oqibat bo'sh qog'oz varag'idagi imzodan boshqa hech narsa qolmaydi. Hurmat qilgandek ko'rinayotgan Klammning ismini bu bilan qanchalik kamsitayotganingizni payqamayapsizmi?

paras.en: 'That is a misunderstanding,' said the mayor. 'I don't fail to recognize the significance of the letter; I don't belittle it by my interpretation — on the contrary. A private letter from Klamm naturally has much more significance than an official communication; only it does not have the significance you attach to it.'
paras.uz: — Bu anglashilmovchilik, — dedi oqsoqol. — Men maktubning ahamiyatini inkor etmayman, talqinim bilan uni kamsitmayman, aksincha. Klammning shaxsiy maktubi, albatta, rasmiy xatdan ancha ko'proq ahamiyatga ega; faqat aynan siz unga bergan ahamiyatga ega emas.

paras.en: 'Do you know Schwarzer?' asked K.
paras.uz: — Shvartserni taniysizmi? — so'radi K.

paras.en: 'No,' said the mayor. 'Do you, Mizzi? No, neither. No, we don't know him.'
paras.uz: — Yo'q, — dedi oqsoqol, — sen-chi, Mitsi? Sen ham yo'q. Yo'q, biz uni tanimaymiz.

paras.en: 'That's strange,' said K. 'He's the son of an under-steward.'
paras.uz: — G'alati, — dedi K., — u kastelyan o'rinbosarining o'g'li.

paras.en: 'My dear land surveyor,' said the mayor, 'how am I supposed to know all the sons of all the under-stewards?'
paras.uz: — Aziz janob yer o'lchovchi, — dedi oqsoqol, — barcha kastelyan o'rinbosarlarining barcha o'g'illarini qanday tanishim kerak?

paras.en: 'Very well,' said K., 'then you'll have to believe me that he is. I had an unpleasant scene with this Schwarzer on the very day I arrived. He then enquired by telephone of the under-steward called Fritz and was told that I had been taken on as land surveyor. How do you explain that, mayor?'
paras.uz: — Yaxshi, — dedi K., — unda uning shu ekaniga menga ishonishingizga to'g'ri keladi. Kelgan kunimdayoq bu Shvartser bilan noxush bir voqea bo'lgan edi. Keyin u Frits ismli kastelyan o'rinbosaridan telefon orqali surishtirdi va men yer o'lchovchi sifatida qabul qilinganim haqida ma'lumot oldi. Buni qanday tushuntirasiz, janob oqsoqol?

paras.en: 'Very simply,' said the mayor. 'You have simply never yet come into contact with our authorities. All these contacts are only apparent, but in your ignorance of the circumstances you take them for real. And as for the telephone: you see, I, who certainly have enough to do with the authorities, have no telephone. In taprooms and the like it may do good service — rather like a mechanical music box — but it is no more than that. Have you ever telephoned here? Yes? Well then, perhaps you will understand me.
