U bunday ishlardan hech narsa tushunmasligidan tashqari, maktab binosida faqat ikkita katta sinf xonasi bor, yordamchi xonalar yo'q, demak, qorovul oilasi bilan sinflardan birida yashashi, uxlashi, balki hatto ovqat pishirishi kerak, bu esa, albatta, tozalikni oshira olmaydi. Lekin janob oqsoqol bu lavozim siz uchun muhtojlikdan qutulish bo'lishini va shuning uchun uni yaxshi bajarish uchun bor kuchingiz bilan harakat qilishingizni ta'kidladi; yana janob oqsoqol, siz bilan birga xotiningiz va yordamchilaringizning kuchini ham qo'lga kiritamiz, shuning uchun nafaqat maktab, balki maktab bog'i ham namunali tartibda saqlanishi mumkin, deb hisobladi. Bularning hammasini men osonlik bilan rad etdim.

paras.en: Finally the mayor could bring forward nothing more in your favour; he laughed and only said that you were a land surveyor after all and would therefore be able to lay out the beds in the school garden especially beautifully straight. Well, there is no arguing with jokes, and so I came to you with the message.' 'You are worrying needlessly, teacher,' said K. 'It doesn't occur to me to accept the post.' — 'Excellent,' said the teacher, 'excellent; you decline quite without reservation,' and he took his hat, bowed and left.
paras.uz: Oxir-oqibat janob oqsoqol sizning foydangizga boshqa hech narsa ayta olmadi, kuldi va faqat siz axir yer o'lchovchisiz-ku, shuning uchun maktab bog'idagi pollarni ayniqsa chiroyli tekis chiza olasiz, dedi. Xo'sh, hazillarga e'tiroz yo'q, shuning uchun men topshiriq bilan sizning oldingizga keldim.» «Siz behuda tashvishlanyapsiz, janob o'qituvchi, — dedi K. — Lavozimni qabul qilish xayolimga ham kelmaydi.» — «Ajoyib, — dedi o'qituvchi, — ajoyib, siz hech qanday shartsiz rad etyapsiz», va u shlyapasini olib, ta'zim qildi va chiqib ketdi.

paras.en: Immediately afterwards Frieda came up with a distraught face; she brought the shirt unironed and did not answer questions. To distract her, K. told her about the teacher and the offer; hardly had she heard it when she threw the shirt on the bed and ran off again. She soon came back, but with the teacher, who looked sullen and did not greet anyone. Frieda asked him for a little patience — evidently she had already done so several times on the way here — then drew K. through a side door he had not even known about into the neighbouring loft, and there finally told him, agitated and out of breath, what had happened to her. The landlady, indignant at having lowered herself before K. to confessions and — what was worse still — to giving way about an interview between Klamm and K., and at having gained nothing by it but, as she said, a cold and moreover insincere rebuff, was determined not to tolerate K. in her house any longer. If he had connections with the Castle, let him make use of them quickly, for today, this very moment, he must leave the house, and only at the direct order and compulsion of the authorities would she take him in again; but she hoped it would not come to that, for she too had connections with the Castle and would know how to bring them to bear.
paras.uz: Shundan keyinoq Frida xavotirli yuz bilan yuqoriga chiqdi, ko'ylakni dazmollamagan holda olib keldi, savollarga javob bermadi; uni chalg'itish uchun K. unga o'qituvchi va taklif haqida aytib berdi; buni eshitishi bilanoq u ko'ylakni to'shakka tashladi va yana yugurib chiqib ketdi. U tez orada qaytib keldi, lekin qovog'i solingan va umuman salom bermagan o'qituvchi bilan. Frida undan biroz sabr qilishni so'radi — aftidan, bu yerga kelayotib buni bir necha marta qilgan edi — keyin K.ni u umuman bilmagan yon eshik orqali qo'shni chordoqqa tortib olib chiqdi va u yerda nihoyat hayajonlanib, nafasi qaytib, o'ziga nima bo'lganini aytib berdi. Beka K. oldida e'tiroflarga va, bundan ham yomonrog'i, Klammning K. bilan uchrashuvi borasida yon berishga o'zini past tushirgani va bundan, uning aytishicha, sovuq va buning ustiga nosamimiy raddan boshqa hech narsaga erishmaganidan g'azablanib, K.ni endi uyida saqlamaslikka qaror qilgan ekan; agar uning Qasr bilan aloqalari bo'lsa, ulardan tezroq foydalansin, chunki bugunoq, hozirning o'zida u uyni tark etishi kerak, va faqat idoraning bevosita buyrug'i va majburlashi bilan u uni yana qabul qiladi; lekin u bunga yetib bormaydi, deb umid qiladi, chunki uning ham Qasr bilan aloqalari bor va ulardan foydalanishni biladi.

paras.en: Besides, he had come to the inn only through the landlord's carelessness, and was in no need otherwise, for only this morning he had boasted of a bed waiting for him. Frieda, of course, was to stay; if Frieda moved out with K., she, the landlady, would be deeply unhappy — down in the kitchen she had already collapsed in tears beside the stove at the mere thought, the poor woman with her heart trouble! But how could she act otherwise, now that it was — in her mind at least — a matter of the very honour of Klamm's memory? That was how things stood with the landlady. Frieda, of course, would follow him, K., wherever he wished, through snow and ice — there was naturally no need to waste another word on that — but their situation was very bad in any case, and so she had greeted the mayor's offer with great joy. Even if it was not a suitable post for K., it was, as had been expressly stressed, only provisional; they would gain time and would easily find other possibilities, even if the final decision should turn out unfavourable. 'If need be,' cried Frieda at last, already at K.'s neck, 'we'll emigrate — what keeps us here in the village? But for now, darling, we'll accept the offer, won't we? I've brought the teacher back; you just say "Accepted" to him, nothing more, and we'll move into the school.'
paras.uz: Aytgancha, u mehmonxonaga faqat mehmonxona egasining beparvoligi tufayli kelgan va boshqa jihatdan umuman muhtoj emas, chunki bugun ertalab u o'zi uchun tayyor turgan tunash joyi bilan maqtangan edi. Frida, albatta, qolishi kerak; agar Frida K. bilan ko'chib ketsa, u — beka chuqur baxtsiz bo'ladi, pastda, oshxonada u buni o'ylashning o'zidan pechka yonida yig'lab yiqilib tushgan — bechora, yurak kasali ayol! Lekin endi, hech bo'lmaganda uning tasavvurida, gap rosmana Klamm xotirasining sharafi haqida ketayotganda, u qanday boshqacha harakat qila olardi! Beka bilan ish shunday edi. Frida, albatta, uning, K.ning ortidan qayerga xohlasa — qor va muz ichiga ham boradi, bu haqda, albatta, boshqa so'z sarflashga hojat yo'q, lekin har holda ularning ahvoli juda yomon, shuning uchun u oqsoqolning taklifini katta quvonch bilan kutib olgan ekan; garchi bu K.ga mos lavozim bo'lmasa ham, u, alohida ta'kidlanganidek, faqat vaqtinchalik, vaqt yutiladi va hatto yakuniy qaror noqulay bo'lsa ham, boshqa imkoniyatlar osongina topiladi. «Kerak bo'lsa, — deb qichqirdi nihoyat Frida allaqachon K.ning bo'yniga osilib, — boshqa yurtga ketamiz, bizni bu qishloqda nima ushlab turibdi? Lekin hozircha, to'g'rimi, jonim, taklifni qabul qilamiz. Men o'qituvchini qaytarib olib keldim, sen unga faqat «Qabul qildim» deysan, boshqa hech narsa, va biz maktabga ko'chib o'tamiz.»

quiz.q: How did the landlady come to own the inn?
o: Hans's uncle leased it to them cheaply, and later they bought it
quiz.why_uz: Hansning amakisi uni arzon ijaraga berdi, keyin ular sotib olishdi.

quiz.q: What does the mayor offer K. through the teacher?
quiz.why_uz: Vaqtincha maktab qorovuli lavozimi.

quiz.q: Why does Frieda want K. to accept the offer?
o: The landlady has thrown K. out and their situation is bad
quiz.why_uz: Beka K.ni uydan haydagan; ularga boshpana kerak.

chapters.title: 8. Waiting for Klamm
chapters.recap_uz: K. Herrenhofga qaytib keladi. Bufetda endi Fridaning o'rniga yosh Pepi ishlaydi. K. Klamm hovlida, chanasi tayyor turganini bilib, hovliga chiqadi va uni kutib qoladi. Aravakash unga chanadagi konyakni taklif qiladi; K. iliq chanaga kirib o'tirib qoladi. Chiroqlar yonadi, ammo uydan Klamm emas, yosh bir janob chiqadi. U K.ni ketishga chaqiradi, K. qaysarlik bilan kutishda davom etadi. Shunda janob otlarni chiqarishni buyuradi va K. hovlida yolg'iz qoladi.

paras.en: 'That's bad,' said K., though without meaning it quite seriously, for the lodging mattered little to him; besides, he was freezing in his underclothes up here in the loft, which had no wall or window on two sides and was sharply swept by cold air. 'Now you've made the room so nice, and we're to move out! I'd be very reluctant to accept the post; even the momentary humiliation before this little teacher is painful to me, and now he's even to become my superior. If only one could stay here a little longer; perhaps my position will change this very afternoon. If at least you stayed here, we could wait and give the teacher only a vague answer. For myself I can always find a bed if I must — really, at Bar…' Frieda closed his mouth with her hand. 'Not that,' she said anxiously, 'please don't say that again. Otherwise I'll follow you in everything. If you wish, I'll stay here alone, however sad it would be for me. If you wish, we'll refuse the offer, however wrong that would be in my opinion. For look: if you find another possibility, even this afternoon, it goes without saying that we'll give up the post at the school at once; nobody will stop us.
paras.uz: — Bu yomon, — dedi K., lekin buni unchalik jiddiy aytmadi, chunki turar joy uni kam tashvishlantirardi, buning ustiga u ikki tomoni devor va derazasiz bo'lib, sovuq havo keskin esib turgan bu chordoqda ichki kiyimida juda sovqotayotgan edi, — xonani shunchalik chiroyli qilib qo'yding, endi esa ko'chib ketishimiz kerak! Lavozimni juda istamaygina qabul qilardim, hatto bu kichkina o'qituvchi oldidagi hozirgi xo'rlanishning o'zi menga noqulay, endi esa u hatto mening boshlig'im bo'lishi kerak. Qaniydi yana biroz shu yerda qolish mumkin bo'lsa, balki ahvolim bugun tushdan keyin o'zgarar. Hech bo'lmaganda sen shu yerda qolsang, kutib, o'qituvchiga faqat noaniq javob berish mumkin edi. O'zim uchun, kerak bo'lsa, doim tunash joyi topaman, haqiqatan ham Bar… — Frida qo'li bilan uning og'zini yopdi. — Bunisi emas, — dedi u xavotir bilan, — iltimos, buni boshqa aytma. Aks holda hamma narsada senga ergashaman. Agar xohlasang, men uchun qanchalik g'amgin bo'lmasin, shu yerda yolg'iz qolaman. Agar xohlasang, mening fikrimcha qanchalik noto'g'ri bo'lmasin, taklifni rad etamiz. Chunki qara, agar sen boshqa imkoniyat topsang, hatto bugun tushdan keyin topsang, maktabdagi lavozimni darhol tashlashimiz o'z-o'zidan tushunarli, hech kim bizga to'sqinlik qilmaydi.

paras.en: And as for the humiliation before the teacher, let me see to it that it isn't one. I'll talk to him myself; you'll only stand by silently, and later it won't be any different. You'll never have to speak to him yourself if you don't want to; in reality I alone shall be his subordinate — and not even I, for I know his weaknesses. So nothing is lost if we accept the post, but much if we refuse it. Above all, unless you achieve something at the Castle today, you really wouldn't find a bed anywhere in the village even for yourself alone — a bed, that is, that I as your future wife wouldn't have to be ashamed of. And if you get no bed, do you mean to ask me to sleep here in a warm room while I know you're wandering about outside in the night and the cold?' K., who all the while had his arms crossed over his chest and was beating his back with his hands to warm himself a little, said: 'Then there's nothing for it but to accept. Come!'
paras.uz: O'qituvchi oldidagi xo'rlanishga kelsak, bu xo'rlanish bo'lmasligini menga qo'yib ber; u bilan o'zim gaplashaman, sen faqat jim turasan, keyin ham boshqacha bo'lmaydi; agar xohlamasang, hech qachon u bilan o'zing gaplashishing shart bo'lmaydi; aslida faqat men uning qo'l ostida bo'laman, hatto men ham bo'lmayman, chunki uning zaif tomonlarini bilaman. Demak, lavozimni qabul qilsak, hech narsa yo'qotmaymiz, rad etsak esa ko'p narsa yo'qotamiz; avvalo, agar bugun Qasrdan biror narsaga erishmasang, haqiqatan ham qishloqning hech bir joyida hatto yolg'iz o'zing uchun ham tunash joyi topa olmaysan — ya'ni men bo'lajak xotining sifatida uyalmasligim kerak bo'lgan tunash joyi. Agar tunash joyi topa olmasang, men bu yerda, iliq xonada uxlashimni, sening tashqarida tun va sovuqda sanqib yurganingni bilgan holda talab qilmoqchimisan? — Butun vaqt davomida biroz isinish uchun qo'llarini ko'kragida chalishtirib, qo'llari bilan orqasiga urib turgan K. dedi: — Unda qabul qilishdan boshqa iloj qolmaydi. Yur!

paras.en: In the room he hurried straight to the stove; he paid no attention to the teacher, who was sitting at the table, drew out his watch and said: 'It's grown late.' — 'But now we're completely agreed, teacher,' said Frieda. 'We accept the post.' 'Good,' said the teacher, 'but the post was offered to the land surveyor. He must give his answer himself.' Frieda came to K.'s aid. 'Of course,' she said, 'he accepts the post — don't you, K.?' So K. could limit his declaration to a simple 'yes', which was not even addressed to the teacher but to Frieda. 'Then,' said the teacher, 'it only remains for me to set out your duties, so that we are agreed on them once and for all. Every day, land surveyor, you have to clean and heat both classrooms, carry out minor repairs in the building and to the school and gymnastics equipment yourself, keep the path through the garden clear of snow, run errands for me and the schoolmistress, and in the warmer season see to all the garden work. In return you have the right to live in one of the classrooms, as you choose; but if lessons are not being given in both rooms at the same time and you happen to be living in the room where they are being given, you must of course move into the other room. You may not cook in the school; instead you and your family will be fed here at the inn at the community's expense.
paras.uz: Xonada u darhol pechka tomon shoshildi; o'qituvchiga e'tibor bermadi; u stol yonida o'tirib, soatini chiqardi va dedi: «Kech bo'lib qoldi.» — «Lekin endi biz butunlay kelishib oldik, janob o'qituvchi, — dedi Frida. — Lavozimni qabul qilamiz.» «Yaxshi, — dedi o'qituvchi, — lekin lavozim janob yer o'lchovchiga taklif qilingan. U o'zi javob berishi kerak.» Frida K.ga yordamga keldi. «Albatta, — dedi u, — u lavozimni qabul qiladi, to'g'rimi, K.?» Shunday qilib K. o'z bayonotini oddiy «ha» bilan cheklashi mumkin edi, u hatto o'qituvchiga emas, Fridaga qaratilgan edi. «Unda, — dedi o'qituvchi, — menga faqat sizga xizmat vazifalaringizni aytish qoladi, toki bu borada bir marta va butunlay kelishib olaylik; siz, janob yer o'lchovchi, har kuni ikkala sinf xonasini tozalashingiz va isitishingiz, binoda, shuningdek, maktab va gimnastika anjomlarida kichik ta'mirlarni o'zingiz bajarishingiz, bog' orqali yo'lni qordan tozalab turishingiz, men va o'qituvchi xonim uchun topshiriqlarni bajarib yurishingiz va iliqroq faslda bog'dagi barcha ishlarni qilishingiz kerak. Buning evaziga siz o'z tanlovingizga ko'ra sinf xonalaridan birida yashash huquqiga egasiz; lekin agar ikkala xonada bir vaqtda dars o'tilmayotgan bo'lsa va siz aynan dars o'tilayotgan xonada yashayotgan bo'lsangiz, albatta, boshqa xonaga ko'chishingiz kerak. Maktabda ovqat pishirishingiz mumkin emas, buning o'rniga siz va oilangiz jamoa hisobidan shu yerda, mehmonxonada ovqatlanasiz.

paras.en: That you must conduct yourself in keeping with the dignity of the school, and that the children in particular, especially during lessons, must never witness unpleasant scenes of your domestic life, I mention only in passing, for as an educated man you must know that. In connection with this I would also remark that we must insist on your legitimizing your relations with Fräulein Frieda as soon as possible. A contract of service will be drawn up about all this and a few other small matters, which you must sign as soon as you move into the schoolhouse.' All this seemed unimportant to K., as though it did not concern him, or at any rate did not bind him; only the teacher's self-importance irritated him, and he said lightly: 'Well, yes, the usual duties.' To smooth over this remark a little, Frieda asked about the salary. 'Whether a salary will be paid,' said the teacher, 'will be considered only after a month's probation.' — 'But that's hard on us,' said Frieda. 'We're to marry almost without money, to create our household out of nothing. Couldn't we, teacher, petition the community for a small salary right away? Would you advise it?' — 'No,' said the teacher, who always addressed his words to K. 'Such a petition would be granted only if I recommended it, and I would not.
paras.uz: Maktabning obro'siga mos ravishda o'zingizni tutishingiz kerakligi va ayniqsa bolalar, xususan dars paytida, hech qachon uyingizdagi noxush sahnalarning guvohi bo'lmasligi kerakligini faqat yo'l-yo'lakay eslatib o'taman, chunki o'qimishli odam sifatida buni bilishingiz kerak. Shu munosabat bilan yana ta'kidlaymanki, Frida xonim bilan munosabatlaringizni imkon qadar tezroq qonuniylashtirishingizni talab qilishimiz kerak. Bularning hammasi va yana bir nechta mayda narsalar haqida xizmat shartnomasi tuziladi, uni maktab binosiga ko'chib kirishingiz bilanoq imzolashingiz kerak.» K.ga bularning hammasi ahamiyatsiz tuyuldi, go'yo bu unga tegishli emasdek yoki har holda uni bog'lamaydigandek; faqat o'qituvchining kerilishi uning jahlini chiqardi va u yengilgina dedi: «Xo'sh, ha, bular odatdagi majburiyatlar.» Bu gapni biroz yumshatish uchun Frida maosh haqida so'radi. «Maosh to'lanadimi-yo'qmi, — dedi o'qituvchi, — bu faqat bir oylik sinov xizmatidan keyin ko'rib chiqiladi.» — «Lekin bu biz uchun og'ir, — dedi Frida. — Biz deyarli pulsiz turmush qurishimiz, ro'zg'orimizni yo'qdan yaratishimiz kerak. Janob o'qituvchi, jamoaga ariza berib, darhol kichik maosh so'ray olmaymizmi? Bunga maslahat berarmidingiz?» — «Yo'q, — dedi so'zlarini doim K.ga qaratgan o'qituvchi. — Bunday ariza faqat men tavsiya qilsam qanoatlantiriladi, men esa tavsiya qilmayman.

paras.en: The granting of the post is only a favour to you, after all, and favours must not be carried too far if one remains aware of one's public responsibility.' Now K. did intervene after all, almost against his will. 'As for the favour, teacher,' he said, 'I think you are mistaken. This favour is perhaps rather on my side.' — 'No,' said the teacher, smiling; now he had made K. speak after all. 'I am precisely informed about that. We need the caretaker about as urgently as the land surveyor. Caretaker or land surveyor — it's a burden round our necks. It will cost me a great deal of thought how to justify the expenses before the community. The best and most truthful thing would be simply to throw the demand on the table without justifying it at all.' — 'That's just what I mean,' said K. 'You must take me on against your will. Although it causes you hard thinking, you must take me on. Now if someone is forced to take another on, and this other lets himself be taken on, then surely it is he who is doing the favour.' — 'Strange,' said the teacher. 'What should force us to take you on? The mayor's good, over-good heart forces us. You will have to give up many fancies, land surveyor, I can see that very well, before you become a useful caretaker. And remarks of that kind naturally do little to create a mood for granting any eventual salary.
paras.uz: Lavozim berilishi axir sizga ko'rsatilgan iltifot xolos, ijtimoiy mas'uliyatini his qiladigan odam esa iltifotni haddan oshirmasligi kerak.» Endi K. baribir, deyarli o'z irodasiga qarshi, gapga aralashdi. «Iltifotga kelsak, janob o'qituvchi, — dedi u, — menimcha, siz adashyapsiz. Bu iltifot, balki, ko'proq men tomonimdandir.» — «Yo'q, — dedi o'qituvchi jilmayib; endi u baribir K.ni gapirishga majbur qilgan edi. — Bu haqda menga aniq ma'lumot berilgan. Bizga maktab qorovuli taxminan yer o'lchovchi kabi zarur. Maktab qorovulimi, yer o'lchovchimi — bu bizning bo'ynimizdagi yuk. Xarajatlarni jamoa oldida qanday oqlashimni hali ko'p o'ylashimga to'g'ri keladi. Eng yaxshisi va eng to'g'risi talabni shunchaki stolga tashlash va umuman oqlamaslik bo'lardi.» — «Men ham shuni nazarda tutyapman-da, — dedi K., — siz meni o'z irodangizga qarshi qabul qilishingiz kerak. Bu sizga og'ir o'ylashga sabab bo'lsa ham, meni qabul qilishingiz kerak. Agar kimdir boshqasini qabul qilishga majbur bo'lsa va bu boshqasi qabul qilinishga ko'nsa, iltifot qilayotgan o'sha-ku.» — «G'alati, — dedi o'qituvchi, — bizni sizni qabul qilishga nima majbur qilishi kerak? Janob oqsoqolning yaxshi, haddan tashqari yaxshi yuragi majbur qiladi. Siz, janob yer o'lchovchi, ko'rib turibmanki, foydali maktab qorovuli bo'lishdan oldin ko'p xayollardan voz kechishingiz kerak bo'ladi. Va bunday gaplar, albatta, ehtimoliy maoshni berishga kayfiyat tug'dirmaydi.

paras.en: I also notice, unfortunately, that your behaviour will give me a lot of trouble yet. The whole time you have been negotiating with me — I keep looking at it and can hardly believe it — in your shirt and underpants.' — 'Yes,' cried K., laughing and clapping his hands, 'those dreadful assistants! Where have they got to?' Frieda hurried to the door. The teacher, noticing that K. was no longer available to talk to him, asked Frieda when they would move into the school. 'Today,' said Frieda. 'Then I'll come and inspect tomorrow morning,' said the teacher, waved a greeting and was about to go out through the door Frieda had opened for herself, but collided with the maids, who were already coming with their things to settle back into the room. He had to slip through between them — they would have given way to no one — and Frieda followed him. 'You're in a hurry,' said K., who this time was very pleased with them. 'We're still here, and you have to move in already?' They did not answer, only twisted their bundles in embarrassment; K. saw the well-known dirty rags hanging out of them. 'I suppose you've never washed your things,' said K. — not angrily, but with a certain affection. They noticed it, opened their hard mouths at the same moment, showed their fine, strong, animal teeth and laughed soundlessly. 'Come on, then,' said K., 'settle in; it's your room, after all.'
paras.uz: Shuningdek, afsuski, payqayapmanki, xatti-harakatingiz menga hali ko'p tashvish keltiradi; butun vaqt davomida siz men bilan — men bunga doim qarayman va deyarli ishonmayman — ko'ylak va ichtonda muzokara olib bordingiz.» — «Ha, — deb qichqirdi K. kulib va qarsak chalib, — dahshatli yordamchilar! Ular qayerda qolishdi?» Frida eshik tomon shoshildi; endi K. u bilan gaplashish uchun mavjud emasligini payqagan o'qituvchi Fridadan maktabga qachon ko'chib o'tishlarini so'radi. «Bugun», dedi Frida. «Unda ertaga ertalab tekshirgani kelaman», dedi o'qituvchi, qo'l silkitib xayrlashdi, Frida o'zi uchun ochgan eshikdan chiqmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin narsalari bilan xonaga yana joylashish uchun kelayotgan xizmatkor qizlarga to'qnash keldi. U hech kimdan chekinmaydigan ular orasidan sirg'alib o'tishga majbur bo'ldi, Frida uning ortidan bordi. «Shoshilyapsizlar-ku, — dedi bu safar ulardan juda mamnun bo'lgan K., — biz hali shu yerdamiz, sizlar esa allaqachon kirib kelishingiz kerakmi?» Ular javob berishmadi va faqat xijolat bilan tugunchalarini aylantirishdi, K. ulardan yaxshi tanish iflos lattalar osilib turganini ko'rdi. «Narsalaringizni hech qachon yuvmagan bo'lsangiz kerak», dedi K.; bu jahl bilan emas, balki qandaydir mehr bilan aytildi. Ular buni payqashdi, qattiq og'izlarini bir vaqtda ochishdi, chiroyli, kuchli, hayvonnikidek tishlarini ko'rsatishdi va ovozsiz kulishdi. «Qani, kelinglar, — dedi K., — joylashinglar, axir bu sizning xonangiz.»

paras.en: But when they still hesitated — their room probably seemed to them too much transformed — K. took one of them by the arm to lead her further in. But he let go at once, so astonished was the look of both, which, after a brief mutual understanding, they now no longer turned away from K. 'Now you've looked at me long enough,' said K., warding off some unpleasant feeling, took the clothes and boots that Frieda, timidly followed by the assistants, had just brought, and got dressed. He had always found incomprehensible — and did so again now — the patience Frieda had with the assistants. After a long search she had found them, who were supposed to be cleaning the clothes in the yard, peacefully at their lunch downstairs, with the uncleaned clothes squashed together on their laps; she had then had to clean everything herself. And yet she, who knew well how to rule common people, did not scold them at all; what is more, she told of their great carelessness in their presence as if it were a little joke, and even patted one of them lightly on the cheek, as if flattering him. K. meant to reproach her about it soon. But now it was high time to go. 'The assistants will stay here to help you move,' said K. They did not agree, of course; full and cheerful as they were, they would gladly have had a little exercise. Only when Frieda said: 'Of course you'll stay here,' did they give in. 'Do you know where I'm going?' asked K. 'Yes,' said Frieda.
paras.uz: Lekin ular hamon ikkilanishganida — ularning xonasi ularga haddan tashqari o'zgargandek tuyulsa kerak — K. ulardan birini olib kirish uchun qo'lidan ushladi. Lekin darhol qo'yib yubordi — ikkovining nigohi shunchalik hayratli ediki, ular qisqa o'zaro kelishuvdan keyin endi uni K.dan uzishmadi. «Endi menga yetarlicha uzoq qaradingizlar», dedi K. qandaydir noxush hissni haydab, Frida — orqasidan tortinib yordamchilar ergashib — hozirgina olib kelgan kiyim va etiklarni olib, kiyindi. Fridaning yordamchilarga nisbatan sabr-toqati unga doim, hozir ham tushunarsiz edi. Kiyimlarni hovlida tozalashlari kerak bo'lgan ularni u uzoq izlagandan keyin pastda tinchgina tushlik qilayotgan holda topgan, tozalanmagan kiyimlar tizzalarida g'ijimlangan holda turgan, keyin hammasini o'zi tozalashga majbur bo'lgan edi; shunga qaramay, oddiy xalqni yaxshi boshqarishni biladigan u ular bilan umuman urishmas, buning ustiga ularning huzurida ularning katta beparvoligi haqida go'yo kichik hazildek gapirar va hatto ulardan birining yuziga go'yo erkalagandek yengil shapatilardi. K. tez orada bu haqda unga tanbeh bermoqchi edi. Lekin hozir ketish vaqti allaqachon kelgan edi. «Yordamchilar ko'chishda senga yordam berish uchun shu yerda qolishadi», dedi K. Ular, albatta, bunga rozi emas edilar; to'q va quvnoq bo'lganlari uchun biroz harakat qilishni xohlashardi. Faqat Frida: «Albatta, shu yerda qolasizlar», deganidagina ko'nishdi. «Qayerga ketayotganimni bilasanmi?» — so'radi K. «Ha», dedi Frida.

paras.en: 'And so you're not holding me back any more?' asked K. 'You'll find so many obstacles,' she said, 'what would my word mean in that case!' She kissed K. goodbye, gave him — since he had had no lunch — a little parcel of bread and sausage she had brought up for him from downstairs, reminded him that afterwards he was not to come back here but go straight to the school, and accompanied him, her hand on his shoulder, out to the door.
paras.uz: «Va endi meni ushlab qolmaysanmi?» — so'radi K. «Sen shunchalik ko'p to'siqlarga duch kelasanki, — dedi u, — u holda mening so'zim nima ma'no anglatardi!» U K.ni xayrlashib o'pdi, u tushlik qilmagani uchun unga pastdan olib chiqqan non va kolbasali kichkina tugunchani berdi, keyin bu yerga emas, to'g'ri maktabga kelishi kerakligini eslatdi va qo'lini uning yelkasiga qo'yib, uni eshik oldigacha kuzatib chiqdi.

paras.en: At first K. was glad to have escaped the crush of maids and assistants in the warm room. It was freezing a little, too; the snow was firmer and walking easier. Only, of course, it was already beginning to grow dark, and he quickened his steps.
paras.uz: Avvaliga K. iliq xonadagi xizmatkor qizlar va yordamchilarning tiqilinchidan qutulganidan xursand bo'ldi. Buning ustiga biroz ayoz tushgan, qor qattiqroq, yurish osonroq edi. Faqat, albatta, allaqachon qorong'i tusha boshlagan edi va u qadamini tezlashtirdi.

paras.en: The Castle, whose outlines were already beginning to dissolve, lay still as ever. Never yet had K. seen the slightest sign of life there; perhaps it was not possible at all to make anything out from this distance, and yet the eyes demanded it and would not tolerate the stillness. When K. looked at the Castle, it sometimes seemed to him as if he were watching someone who sat there quietly gazing in front of him — not lost in thought and so shut off from everything, but free and unconcerned, as if he were alone and nobody were watching him; and yet he must have noticed that he was being watched, but it did not touch his calm in the least; and indeed — one did not know whether it was cause or effect — the watcher's gaze could not hold fast and slid off. This impression was strengthened today by the early dark; the longer he looked, the less he could make out, the deeper everything sank into twilight.
paras.uz: Chiziqlari allaqachon erib ketayotgan Qasr doimgidek jim yotardi; K. u yerda hali hech qachon hayotning eng kichik belgisini ko'rmagan edi; balki bu uzoqlikdan biror narsani ajratish umuman imkonsizdir, shunga qaramay, ko'zlar buni talab qilar va sukunatga chidashni istamasdi. K. Qasrga qaraganida, unga ba'zan go'yo xotirjam o'tirib, oldiga qarab turgan kimnidir kuzatayotgandek tuyulardi — o'yga botib, shu tufayli hamma narsadan ajralib qolgan emas, balki erkin va beparvo, go'yo u yolg'iz va uni hech kim kuzatmayotgandek; shunga qaramay u kuzatilayotganini payqashi kerak edi, lekin bu uning xotirjamligiga zarracha ta'sir qilmasdi va haqiqatan ham — bu sababmi yoki oqibatmi, bilib bo'lmasdi — kuzatuvchining nigohlari unga mahkamlana olmay, sirpanib ketardi. Bu taassurot bugun erta qorong'ilik tufayli yanada kuchaydi; u qanchalik uzoq qarasa, shunchalik kam narsani ajratar, hamma narsa shunchalik chuqurroq g'ira-shiraga cho'kardi.

paras.en: Just as K. reached the Herrenhof, still unlit, a window opened on the first floor; a young, fat, clean-shaven gentleman in a fur coat leaned out and then stayed at the window. He did not seem to answer K.'s greeting with even the slightest nod. Neither in the hall nor in the bar did K. meet anyone; the smell of stale beer was even worse than the last time — that sort of thing surely did not happen at the Bridge Inn. K. went straight to the door through which he had watched Klamm the last time and carefully pressed down the handle, but the door was locked. Then he tried to feel for the place where the peephole was, but the stopper was probably fitted so well that he could not find the spot this way, so he struck a match. At that he was startled by a cry. In the corner between the door and the sideboard, near the stove, a young girl sat huddled, staring at him in the flare of the match with eyes heavy with sleep that she could barely open. She was evidently Frieda's successor. She soon collected herself and switched on the electric light; the expression of her face was still angry, then she recognized K. 'Oh, the land surveyor,' she said with a smile, held out her hand and introduced herself: 'My name is Pepi.'
paras.uz: Aynan K. hali yoritilmagan «Herrenhof»ga yetib kelganida, birinchi qavatdagi bir deraza ochildi, mo'ynali palto kiygan yosh, semiz, soqoli silliq olingan bir janob tashqariga engashdi va keyin deraza oldida qoldi. U K.ning salomiga hatto eng yengil bosh irg'ash bilan ham javob bermagandek tuyuldi. Na dahlizda, na bufetda K. hech kimni uchratmadi; aynigan pivo hidi o'tgan safardagidan ham yomonroq edi — «Ko'prik yonidagi» mehmonxonada bunday narsa bo'lmasa kerak. K. darhol o'tgan safar Klammni kuzatgan eshik oldiga borib, tutqichni ehtiyotkorlik bilan bosdi, lekin eshik qulflangan edi; keyin tirqish bor joyni paypaslab topishga urindi, lekin tiqin, ehtimol, shunchalik yaxshi moslashtirilgan ediki, u bu tarzda joyni topa olmadi, shuning uchun gugurt chaqdi. Shunda bir qichqiriq uni cho'chitib yubordi. Eshik bilan bufet javoni orasidagi burchakda, pechka yonida bir yosh qiz bukchayib o'tirar va gugurt yorug'ida zo'rg'a ochilgan, uyqusiragan ko'zlari bilan unga tikilib turardi. Bu, aftidan, Fridaning o'rnini egallagan qiz edi. U tez o'zini qo'lga oldi, elektr chirog'ini yoqdi, yuzining ifodasi hali jahldor edi, shunda u K.ni tanidi. «Ha, janob yer o'lchovchi», dedi u jilmayib, unga qo'lini uzatdi va o'zini tanishtirdi: «Mening ismim Pepi.»

paras.en: She was small, red-cheeked and healthy; her abundant reddish-blonde hair was plaited into a thick braid and also curled all round her face. She wore a dress of shiny grey material, falling straight down, that suited her very badly; at the bottom it was gathered in, with childish clumsiness, by a silk ribbon ending in a bow, so that it hampered her. She asked about Frieda and whether she would be coming back soon — a question that bordered on malice. 'I was called here in a hurry,' she said then, 'just after Frieda left, because they can't just use anybody here. Until now I was a chambermaid, but it's not a good exchange I've made. There's a lot of evening and night work here; it's very tiring; I'll hardly be able to stand it; I'm not surprised Frieda gave it up.' — 'Frieda was very content here,' said K., to make Pepi aware at last of the difference between her and Frieda, which she was neglecting. 'Don't believe her,' said Pepi. 'Frieda can control herself as hardly anyone can. What she doesn't want to admit she doesn't admit, and you don't even notice that she has anything to admit. I've been serving here with her for some years now; we always slept together in one bed; but I'm not close to her; certainly she doesn't think of me any more today.
paras.uz: U kichkina, qizil yuzli, sog'lom edi, qalin, qizg'ish-sariq sochlari yo'g'on o'rimga o'rilgan, buning ustiga yuzi atrofida jingalak bo'lib turardi; unga juda kam yarashgan, silliq tushib turgan kulrang-yaltiroq matodan ko'ylak kiygan edi, pastda u bolalarcha epsizlik bilan bog'ich bilan tugallangan ipak lenta bilan tortib bog'langan edi, shuning uchun uni siqib turardi. U Frida haqida va u tez orada qaytib kelmaydimi, deb so'radi. Bu yovuzlikka yaqin turgan savol edi. «Meni, — dedi u keyin, — Frida ketgandan keyinoq bu yerga shoshilinch chaqirishdi, chunki bu yerda istalgan qizni ishlatib bo'lmaydi; men hozirgacha xona xizmatkori edim, lekin qilgan almashuvim yaxshi emas. Bu yerda kechqurun va tunda ish ko'p, bu juda charchatadi, men bunga zo'rg'a chidayman, Fridaning bundan voz kechganidan hayron emasman.» — «Frida bu yerda juda mamnun edi», dedi K. Pepini nihoyat u bilan Frida o'rtasidagi u e'tiborsiz qoldirayotgan farqqa e'tibor qaratish uchun. «Unga ishonmang, — dedi Pepi. — Frida o'zini hech kim osonlikcha qila olmaydigan darajada tuta biladi. Tan olishni istamagan narsani tan olmaydi va bunda uning tan oladigan biror narsasi borligini umuman payqamaysiz ham. Axir men bu yerda u bilan bir necha yildan beri xizmat qilaman, doim bir to'shakda uxlaganmiz, lekin u bilan yaqin emasman, u bugun meni allaqachon o'ylamasa kerak.

paras.en: Her only friend, perhaps, is the old landlady at the Bridge Inn, and that's telling too.' — 'Frieda is my fiancée,' said K., meanwhile looking for the place of the peephole in the door. 'I know,' said Pepi, 'that's why I'm telling you. Otherwise it would mean nothing to you.' — 'I understand,' said K. 'You mean I can be proud of having won such a reserved girl for myself.' — 'Yes,' she said, and laughed contentedly, as if she had won K. to a secret understanding about Frieda.
paras.uz: Uning yagona dugonasi, ehtimol, «Ko'prik yonidagi» mehmonxonaning keksa bekasidir, bu ham ko'p narsani anglatadi.» — «Frida mening qallig'im», dedi K. va yo'l-yo'lakay eshikdagi tirqish joyini izladi. «Bilaman, — dedi Pepi, — shuning uchun ham aytyapman. Aks holda bu siz uchun hech qanday ahamiyatga ega bo'lmasdi.» — «Tushunaman, — dedi K. — Siz men shunday yopiq qizni o'zimga og'dirganim bilan faxrlanishim mumkin, demoqchisiz.» — «Ha», dedi u va go'yo K.ni Frida haqida yashirin kelishuvga ko'ndirgandek, mamnun kuldi.

paras.en: But it was not really her words that occupied K. and distracted him a little from his search; it was her appearance and her presence in this place. Of course she was much younger than Frieda, still almost a child, and her clothes were ridiculous; she had evidently dressed according to the exaggerated ideas she had of the importance of a barmaid. And in her way she was even right to have these ideas, for the post, for which she was not yet suited at all, had probably fallen to her unexpectedly and undeservedly, and only provisionally; they had not even entrusted her with the little leather bag Frieda had always worn at her belt. And her alleged dissatisfaction with the post was nothing but conceit. And yet, despite her childish lack of understanding, she too probably had connections with the Castle; after all, if she wasn't lying, she had been a chambermaid. Without knowing what she possessed, she was sleeping her days away here; an embrace of this small, plump, slightly round-backed body could not, it was true, wrest that possession from her, but it could touch it and give one heart for the hard road. Then was it perhaps no different from Frieda? Oh yes, it was different. One had only to think of Frieda's look to understand that. K. would never have touched Pepi. And yet now he had to cover his eyes for a moment, so greedily was he looking at her.
paras.uz: Lekin K.ni band qilgan va uni izlashdan biroz chalg'itgan narsa aslida uning so'zlari emas, balki uning tashqi ko'rinishi va shu joyda borligi edi. Albatta, u Fridadan ancha yosh, hali deyarli bola edi, kiyimi esa kulgili edi; u, aftidan, bufetchi qizning ahamiyati haqidagi mubolag'ali tasavvurlariga mos ravishda kiyingan edi. Va o'ziga xos tarzda bu tasavvurlarga haqli ham edi, chunki u hali umuman mos kelmaydigan bu lavozim unga kutilmaganda va noloyiq ravishda, faqat vaqtincha nasib qilgan bo'lsa kerak; hatto Frida doim kamarida taqib yurgan charm sumkachani ham unga ishonib topshirishmagan edi. Uning lavozimdan go'yoki noroziligi esa manmanlikdan boshqa narsa emas edi. Va shunga qaramay, bolalarcha nodonligiga qaramay, uning ham Qasr bilan aloqalari bo'lsa kerak; axir, agar yolg'on gapirmayotgan bo'lsa, u xona xizmatkori bo'lgan edi; nimaga egaligini bilmagan holda u bu yerda kunlarini uxlab o'tkazardi, lekin bu kichkina, to'lacha, biroz bukchaygan tanani quchoqlash, to'g'ri, undan o'sha boylikni tortib ololmasdi, lekin unga tegib, og'ir yo'l uchun dalda berishi mumkin edi. Unda bu Frida bilan bo'lganidan farq qilmasmidi? Yo'q, farq qilardi. Buni tushunish uchun faqat Fridaning nigohini eslash kifoya edi. K. hech qachon Pepiga tegmagan bo'lardi. Shunga qaramay, endi u bir lahzaga ko'zlarini yopishga majbur bo'ldi — unga shunchalik ochko'zlik bilan qarayotgan edi.

paras.en: 'It needn't be on,' said Pepi, and switched off the light again. 'I only put it on because you frightened me so. What do you want here? Has Frieda forgotten something?' — 'Yes,' said K., and pointed to the door, 'in the room next door here, a tablecloth, a white knitted one.' — 'Yes, her tablecloth,' said Pepi, 'I remember — a lovely piece of work; I helped her with it. But it's hardly likely to be in that room.' — 'Frieda thinks so. Who lives here, then?' asked K. 'Nobody,' said Pepi. 'It's the gentlemen's room; the gentlemen eat and drink here — that is, it's meant for that, but most of them stay upstairs in their rooms.' — 'If I knew,' said K., 'that nobody was next door now, I'd very much like to go in and look for the cloth. But it's uncertain, you see; Klamm, for instance, often sits there.' — 'Klamm certainly isn't there now,' said Pepi. 'He's leaving straight away; the sledge is already waiting in the yard.'
paras.uz: «Yonib turishi shart emas», dedi Pepi va chiroqni yana o'chirdi, «men faqat siz meni juda qo'rqitganingiz uchun yoqdim. Bu yerda nima qilmoqchisiz? Frida biror narsani unutib qoldirdimi?» — «Ha», dedi K. va eshikni ko'rsatdi, «mana bu qo'shni xonada dasturxon, oq, to'qilgan.» — «Ha, uning dasturxoni, — dedi Pepi, — eslayman, chiroyli ish, men unga yordam berganman, lekin u bu xonada bo'lishi dargumon.» — «Frida shunday deb o'ylaydi. Bu yerda kim yashaydi?» — so'radi K. «Hech kim, — dedi Pepi. — Bu janoblar xonasi, bu yerda janoblar ichishadi va ovqatlanishadi, ya'ni bu shuning uchun mo'ljallangan, lekin ko'pchiligi tepada, o'z xonalarida qoladi.» — «Agar hozir qo'shni xonada hech kim yo'qligini bilganimda, — dedi K., — juda bajonidil kirib, dasturxonni izlardim. Lekin ishonchsiz-da; masalan, Klamm ko'pincha u yerda o'tiradi.» — «Klamm hozir u yerda emas, albatta, — dedi Pepi, — u hozir jo'nab ketadi, chana allaqachon hovlida kutib turibdi.»

paras.en: At once, without a word of explanation, K. left the bar; in the hall, instead of turning to the exit, he turned towards the inside of the house, and after a few steps he had reached the yard. How quiet and beautiful it was here! A square yard, bounded on three sides by the house, and towards the street — a side street K. did not know — by a high white wall with a large, heavy gate, open now. Here, on the yard side, the house seemed higher than at the front; at least the first floor was fully built out and looked more imposing, for it was surrounded by a wooden gallery, closed except for a small slit at eye level. Diagonally opposite K., still in the central block but already in the corner where the opposite wing joined it, there was an entrance into the house, open, without a door. In front of it stood a dark, closed sledge harnessed to two horses. Apart from the coachman, whom K., at that distance in the twilight, guessed at rather than made out, nobody was to be seen.
paras.uz: Darhol, bir og'iz izohsiz, K. bufetdan chiqdi, dahlizda chiqish tomon emas, uyning ichkarisi tomon burildi va bir necha qadamdan keyin hovliga yetib keldi. Bu yer qanchalik sokin va go'zal edi! To'rtburchak hovli, uch tomondan uy bilan, ko'cha tomondan esa — K. bilmagan bir yon ko'cha — katta, og'ir, hozir ochiq darvozali baland oq devor bilan chegaralangan. Bu yerda, hovli tomonda uy old tomondagidan balandroq ko'rinardi; hech bo'lmaganda birinchi qavat to'liq qurilgan va salobatliroq ko'rinardi, chunki uni ko'z balandligidagi kichik tirqishdan tashqari yopiq yog'och ayvon aylanib o'tgan edi. K.ning qiya ro'parasida, hali o'rta qismda, lekin allaqachon qarama-qarshi yon qanot tutashgan burchakda uyga eshiksiz, ochiq kirish joyi bor edi. Uning oldida ikki ot qo'shilgan qora, yopiq chana turardi. K. bu masofadan g'ira-shirada ajratishdan ko'ra ko'proq taxmin qilgan aravakashdan tashqari hech kim ko'rinmasdi.

paras.en: His hands in his pockets, looking round carefully, close to the wall, K. went round two sides of the yard until he reached the sledge. The coachman, one of those peasants who had been in the bar the other day, sunk in his fur, had watched him approach without interest, much as one follows the path of a cat. Even when K. was standing beside him and greeted him, and the horses too grew a little restless at the man emerging from the dark, he remained completely unconcerned. That suited K. very well. Leaning against the wall, he unpacked his food, thought gratefully of Frieda, who had provided for him so well, and meanwhile peered into the inside of the house. A staircase, turning at a right angle, came down and at the bottom was crossed by a low but apparently deep passage; everything was clean, whitewashed, sharply and straightly bounded.
paras.uz: Qo'llarini cho'ntagiga solib, ehtiyotkorlik bilan atrofga qarab, devorga yaqin yurib, K. hovlining ikki tomonini aylanib o'tib, chana yoniga yetdi. Aravakash — o'tgan safar bufetda bo'lgan dehqonlardan biri — mo'ynasiga cho'kib, uning yaqinlashayotganini befarq kuzatib turdi, xuddi mushukning yo'lini kuzatgandek. Hatto K. uning yonida turib salom berganida va qorong'ilikdan paydo bo'lgan odam tufayli otlar ham biroz bezovtalanganida ham u butunlay beparvo qoldi. Bu K.ga juda ma'qul edi. Devorga suyanib, u ovqatini ochdi, uni shunchalik yaxshi ta'minlagan Fridani minnatdorlik bilan esladi va shu orada uyning ichkarisiga mo'raladi. To'g'ri burchak bilan burilgan zina pastga tushardi va pastda uni past, lekin chuqur ko'ringan yo'lak kesib o'tardi; hamma narsa toza, oqlangan, keskin va to'g'ri chegaralangan edi.

paras.en: The waiting lasted longer than K. had thought. He had long finished his food; the cold was biting; the twilight had already become complete darkness; and still Klamm did not come. 'That may take a long time yet,' said a rough voice suddenly, so close to K. that he jumped. It was the coachman, who, as if awakened, stretched and yawned loudly. 'What may take a long time?' asked K., not ungrateful for the interruption, for the constant silence and tension had already become wearing. 'Before you go away,' said the coachman. K. did not understand him, but asked no further; he thought this was the best way to make the haughty fellow talk. Not answering, here in the darkness, was almost provoking. And indeed, after a little while, the coachman asked: 'Would you like some brandy?' — 'Yes,' said K. without thinking, too tempted by the offer, for he was shivering. 'Then open the sledge,' said the coachman. 'There are some bottles in the side pocket; take one, drink, and then hand it up to me. Getting down is too much trouble for me because of the fur.' It annoyed K. to perform such services, but since he had now got involved with the coachman, he obeyed, even at the risk of being surprised at the sledge by Klamm, perhaps.
paras.uz: Kutish K. o'ylaganidan uzoqroq davom etdi. U ovqatni allaqachon tugatgan edi, sovuq kesar, g'ira-shira allaqachon to'liq zulmatga aylangan edi, Klamm esa hamon kelmasdi. «Bu hali juda uzoq davom etishi mumkin», dedi birdan K.ga shunchalik yaqin bir dag'al ovozki, u cho'chib tushdi. Bu go'yo uyg'ongandek kerishib, ovoz chiqarib esnagan aravakash edi. «Nima uzoq davom etishi mumkin?» — so'radi K. xalaqit uchun noshukur bo'lmay, chunki doimiy sukunat va zo'riqish allaqachon jonga tegib qolgan edi. «Siz ketguningizcha», dedi aravakash. K. uni tushunmadi, lekin boshqa so'ramadi; bu tarzda kibrli odamni gapirtirish eng yaxshi yo'l, deb o'yladi. Bu yerda, zulmatda javob bermaslik deyarli g'ashga tegardi. Va haqiqatan ham, biroz o'tgach, aravakash so'radi: «Konyak istaysizmi?» — «Ha», dedi K. o'ylamasdan, taklifdan haddan tashqari vasvasaga tushib, chunki uni titroq bosgan edi. «Unda chanani oching, — dedi aravakash, — yon cho'ntakda bir nechta shisha bor, bittasini oling, iching va keyin menga uzating. Mo'ynam tufayli pastga tushish menga juda qiyin.» Bunday xizmatlar qilish K.ning jahlini chiqardi, lekin endi aravakash bilan aloqaga kirishgani uchun, hatto chana yonida Klamm tomonidan tutib olinish xavfiga ham qaramay, bo'ysundi.

paras.en: He opened the wide door and could have pulled the bottle straight out of the pocket fixed on the inside of the door; but now that the door was open, he felt such an urge to go inside the sledge that he could not resist; he wanted to sit in it just for a moment. He slipped in. The warmth in the sledge was extraordinary, and it stayed so although the door, which K. did not dare to shut, was wide open. One could not tell whether one was sitting on a seat, one lay so deep in blankets, cushions and furs; one could turn and stretch in every direction and always sink softly and warmly. Arms spread out, his head supported by cushions that were always ready, K. looked out of the sledge into the dark house. Why was it taking so long for Klamm to come down? As if dazed by the warmth after standing so long in the snow, K. wished that Klamm would come at last. The thought that in his present situation he had better not be seen by Klamm entered his mind only dimly, as a faint disturbance. He was supported in this forgetfulness by the behaviour of the coachman, who must have known he was in the sledge and left him there without even asking him for the brandy. That was considerate, but K. did want to serve him.
paras.uz: U keng eshikni ochdi va eshikning ichki tomoniga o'rnatilgan cho'ntakdan shishani darhol chiqarib olishi mumkin edi, lekin endi eshik ochiq bo'lgani uchun uni chananing ichiga shunchalik kuchli tortdiki, qarshilik qila olmadi — faqat bir lahza unda o'tirmoqchi edi. U ichkariga sirg'alib kirdi. Chanadagi iliqlik g'ayrioddiy edi va K. yopishga jur'at etmagan eshik lang ochiq bo'lsa ham, shunday qoldi. Kursida o'tiribsanmi-yo'qmi, bilib bo'lmasdi — adyollar, yostiqlar va mo'ynalar orasida shunchalik chuqur yotarding; har tomonga aylanish va cho'zilish mumkin edi, doim yumshoq va iliq cho'karding. Qo'llarini yoyib, boshini doim tayyor turgan yostiqlarga tirab, K. chanadan qorong'i uyga qaradi. Nega Klamm tushguncha bunchalik uzoq vaqt o'tyapti? Qorda uzoq turgandan keyin iliqlikdan go'yo mast bo'lib, K. Klamm nihoyat kelishini istadi. Hozirgi holatida Klammga ko'rinmagani ma'qul, degan fikr unga faqat noaniq, sekin bezovtalik sifatida yetib keldi. Bu unutuvchanlikda unga aravakashning xatti-harakati ham yordam berdi — u axir K.ning chanada ekanini bilishi kerak edi va uni u yerda qoldirdi, hatto undan konyakni ham talab qilmay. Bu hurmatli edi, lekin K. unga xizmat qilmoqchi edi-da.

paras.en: Clumsily, without changing his position, he reached for the side pocket — not in the open door, which was too far away, but behind him in the closed one; well, it made no difference, there were bottles in that one too. He took one out, unscrewed the cap and smelled it; he could not help smiling, the smell was so sweet, so flattering, like hearing praise and kind words from someone one loves very much, without knowing exactly what it is about and without wanting to know, happy only in the awareness that it is he who is speaking like that. 'Can this be brandy?' K. asked himself doubtfully, and tasted it out of curiosity. Yes, it was brandy, oddly enough, and it burned and warmed. How it changed as one drank it, from something that was almost only the bearer of a sweet scent into a drink fit for a coachman! 'Is it possible?' K. asked himself, as if reproaching himself, and drank again.
paras.uz: Og'ir harakat bilan, holatini o'zgartirmay, u yon cho'ntakka qo'l cho'zdi, lekin juda uzoqda bo'lgan ochiq eshikdagisiga emas, orqasidagi yopiq eshikdagisiga; xo'sh, farqi yo'q edi, unda ham shishalar bor edi. U bittasini chiqarib, qopqog'ini burab ochdi va hidladi; beixtiyor jilmayishga majbur bo'ldi — hid shunchalik shirin, shunchalik erkalovchi ediki, go'yo juda yaxshi ko'rgan odamingdan maqtov va yaxshi so'zlar eshitayotgandek, gap nima haqida ekanini aniq bilmay va bilishni ham istamay, faqat shunday gapirayotgan o'sha ekanini anglab baxtiyor bo'lgandek. «Nahotki bu konyak bo'lsa?» — o'zidan shubha bilan so'radi K. va qiziqishdan tatib ko'rdi. Ha, g'alati, bu konyak ekan, kuydirar va isitardi. Ichganda u qanday o'zgarardi — deyarli faqat shirin hid tashuvchisi bo'lgan narsadan aravakashlarga yarasha ichimlikka! «Bo'lishi mumkinmi?» — deb so'radi K. o'zidan go'yo o'zini ayblagandek va yana bir ho'pladi.

paras.en: Then — K. was just in the middle of a long gulp — it became light: the electric light came on, inside on the stairs, in the passage, in the hall, outside above the entrance. Footsteps could be heard coming down the stairs; the bottle slipped from K.'s hand, the brandy spilled over a fur, K. jumped out of the sledge — he had just managed to slam the door, which made a booming noise — when shortly afterwards a gentleman stepped slowly out of the house. The only comforting thing seemed to be that it was not Klamm — or was precisely that to be regretted? It was the gentleman K. had already seen at the first-floor window. A young gentleman, extremely good-looking, white and red, but very serious. K. too looked at him gloomily, but he meant himself by the look. If only he had sent his assistants here instead; they too would have understood how to behave as he had. The gentleman opposite him was still silent, as if he did not have enough breath in his over-broad chest for what had to be said. 'This is dreadful,' he said then, and pushed his hat back a little from his forehead. What? The gentleman probably knew nothing of K.'s stay in the sledge and already found something dreadful? That K. had penetrated as far as the yard, perhaps? 'How do you come to be here?' the gentleman asked, more quietly now, already breathing out, resigning himself to the inevitable. What questions! What answers! Was K. to confirm expressly to the gentleman himself that his path, begun with so many hopes, had been in vain? Instead of answering, K. turned to the sledge, opened it and fetched his cap, which he had forgotten inside. Uneasily he noticed the brandy dripping onto the running board.
paras.uz: Shunda — K. aynan uzun ho'plam bilan band edi — yorug' bo'ldi: elektr chiroqlari yondi — ichkarida zinada, yo'lakda, dahlizda, tashqarida kirish tepasida. Zinadan tushib kelayotgan qadam tovushlari eshitildi, shisha K.ning qo'lidan tushib ketdi, konyak bir mo'yna ustiga to'kildi, K. chanadan sakrab tushdi — eshikni endigina zo'rg'a yopib ulgurdi, bu gumburlagan shovqin chiqardi — shundan ko'p o'tmay uydan bir janob sekin chiqdi. Yagona yupatadigan narsa bu Klamm emasligi edi — yoki aynan bunga achinish kerakmidi? Bu K. birinchi qavat derazasida ko'rgan janob edi. Yosh janob, nihoyatda ko'rkam, oq va qizil yuzli, lekin juda jiddiy. K. ham unga ma'yus qaradi, lekin bu nigoh bilan o'zini nazarda tutardi. Qaniydi bu yerga yordamchilarini yuborgan bo'lsa; u qilgandek o'zini tutishni ular ham uddalagan bo'lardi. Uning ro'parasidagi janob hali jim edi, go'yo aytilishi kerak bo'lgan narsa uchun haddan tashqari keng ko'kragida yetarlicha nafas yo'qdek. «Bu dahshat», dedi u keyin va shlyapasini peshonasidan biroz orqaga surdi. Nima? Janob, ehtimol, K.ning chanada bo'lgani haqida hech narsa bilmasdi-yu, allaqachon nimanidir dahshatli deb topdimi? Balki K.ning hovligacha kirib kelganinidir? «Bu yerga qanday kelib qoldingiz?» — so'radi janob endi sekinroq, nafasini chiqarib, o'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan narsaga bo'ysunib. Qanday savollar! Qanday javoblar! Nahotki K. janobning o'ziga shuncha umidlar bilan boshlangan yo'li behuda ketganini alohida tasdiqlashi kerak bo'lsa? Javob berish o'rniga K. chanaga o'girildi, uni ochdi va ichida unutib qoldirgan qalpog'ini oldi. U konyak zina taxtasiga tomayotganini noqulay his bilan payqadi.

paras.en: Then he turned to the gentleman again. He no longer had any scruples now about showing him that he had been in the sledge; nor was that the worst thing. If he were asked — only then, of course — he would not conceal that the coachman himself had at least caused him to open the sledge. But the really bad thing was that the gentleman had surprised him, that there had no longer been enough time to hide from him and then wait undisturbed for Klamm; or that he had not had enough presence of mind to stay in the sledge, close the door and wait for Klamm there on the furs, or at least stay there as long as this gentleman was near. Of course, he could not have known whether Klamm himself might not be coming just then, in which case it would naturally have been much better to receive him outside the sledge. Yes, there had been a good deal to consider here; but now nothing at all any more, for it was over.
paras.uz: Keyin u yana janobga o'girildi; chanada bo'lganini unga ko'rsatishdan endi tortinmasdi, bu eng yomoni ham emas edi; agar so'rashsa — faqat shunda, albatta — aravakashning o'zi uni hech bo'lmaganda chanani ochishga undaganini yashirmoqchi emas edi. Lekin haqiqiy yomon narsa — janobning uni tutib olgani, undan yashirinib, keyin Klammni xalaqitsiz kutish uchun yetarli vaqt qolmagani yoki chanada qolib, eshikni yopib, u yerda, mo'ynalar ustida Klammni kutish yoki hech bo'lmaganda bu janob yaqin turgan paytgacha u yerda qolish uchun yetarlicha hozirjavoblik qilmagani edi. Albatta, u hozir Klammning o'zi kelmayotganini bila olmasdi, bunday holda uni chanadan tashqarida kutib olish, albatta, ancha yaxshiroq bo'lardi. Ha, bu yerda ko'p narsani o'ylash kerak edi, endi esa hech narsani, chunki hammasi tugadi.

paras.en: 'Come with me,' said the gentleman — not really commanding; the command lay not in the words but in a brief, deliberately indifferent wave of the hand that accompanied them. 'I'm waiting here for someone,' said K., no longer in hope of any success, but only on principle. 'Come,' said the gentleman again, quite unperturbed, as if to show that he had never doubted that K. was waiting for someone. 'But then I'll miss the person I'm waiting for,' said K., with a jerk of his body. In spite of everything that had happened, he had the feeling that what he had achieved so far was a kind of possession, which he was now holding on to only in appearance, it was true, but which he still did not have to surrender at just anyone's command. 'You'll miss him in any case, whether you wait or go,' said the gentleman — blunt in his opinion, but strikingly accommodating to K.'s train of thought. 'Then I'd rather miss him while waiting,' said K. defiantly; he would certainly not let himself be driven away from here by the mere words of this young gentleman. At that the gentleman, with a superior expression on his tilted-back face, closed his eyes for a moment, as if to return from K.'s lack of understanding to his own good sense, ran the tip of his tongue round the lips of his slightly open mouth, and then said to the coachman: 'Unharness the horses.'
paras.uz: «Men bilan yuring», dedi janob, aslida buyurmay — buyruq so'zlarda emas, balki ularga hamroh bo'lgan qisqa, ataylab befarq qo'l silkitishda edi. «Men bu yerda kimnidir kutyapman», dedi K. endi hech qanday muvaffaqiyatga umid qilmay, faqat tamoyil uchun. «Yuring», dedi janob yana butunlay xotirjam, go'yo K. kimnidir kutayotganiga hech qachon shubha qilmaganini ko'rsatmoqchidek. «Lekin unda kutayotgan odamimni o'tkazib yuboraman», dedi K. tanasini silkitib. Sodir bo'lgan hamma narsaga qaramay, u hozirgacha erishgan narsasi o'ziga xos boylik ekanini, uni endi faqat zohiran ushlab turgan bo'lsa ham, har qanday buyruq bilan topshirishi shart emasligini his qilardi. «Kutsangiz ham, ketsangiz ham, baribir uni o'tkazib yuborasiz», dedi janob — o'z fikrida keskin, lekin K.ning fikr yo'nalishiga hayratlanarli darajada yon bosgan holda. «Unda uni kutib turib o'tkazib yuborganim ma'qul», dedi K. qaysarlik bilan; bu yosh janobning shunchaki so'zlari bilan u bu yerdan haydalishga, albatta, yo'l qo'ymasdi. Shunda janob orqaga tashlangan yuzida ustunlik ifodasi bilan bir lahzaga ko'zlarini yumdi, go'yo K.ning tushunmasligidan yana o'z aql-idrokiga qaytmoqchidek, biroz ochilgan og'zining lablarini til uchi bilan aylantirib chiqdi va keyin aravakashga dedi: «Otlarni chiqaring.»

paras.en: The coachman, obedient to the gentleman but with an angry sidelong glance at K., now had to climb down in his fur after all, and very hesitantly — as if expecting not a counter-order from the gentleman but a change of mind from K. — began to back the horses with the sledge closer to the side wing, in which, behind a large door, the stable and coach house were evidently located. K. saw himself left behind alone: on one side the sledge moved away, on the other, along the way K. had come, the young gentleman — both very slowly, though, as if they wanted to show K. that it was still in his power to call them back.
paras.uz: Janobga itoatkor, lekin K.ga yomon yonlama qarab qo'ygan aravakash endi baribir mo'ynasida pastga tushishga majbur bo'ldi va juda ikkilanib — go'yo janobdan qarshi buyruq emas, K.dan fikr o'zgarishini kutayotgandek — otlarni chana bilan birga orqaga, katta darvoza orqasida otxona va arava saroyi joylashgan bo'lsa kerak bo'lgan yon qanot tomon surib bora boshladi. K. o'zini yolg'iz qolayotganini ko'rdi; bir tomonda chana uzoqlashardi, ikkinchi tomonda, K. kelgan yo'ldan yosh janob — lekin ikkalasi ham juda sekin, go'yo K.ga ularni qaytarib chaqirish hali uning qo'lida ekanini ko'rsatmoqchidek.

quiz.q: Who now works behind the bar instead of Frieda?

quiz.q: What does the coachman invite K. to do?

The gentleman has the horses unharnessed, so Klamm will not leave from there
