quiz.q: Who is Momus?
quiz.why_uz: Momus — Klammning qishloq kotibi (Vallabene uchun ham).

quiz.q: Does Klamm read the records, according to Momus?
o: No, he reads none at all
quiz.why_uz: Momus: Klamm hech bir bayonnomani o'qimaydi.

quiz.q: What is strange about Klamm's letter?
o: It praises surveying work K. has not done
quiz.why_uz: Xat K. hech qachon qilmagan o'lchash ishlarini maqtaydi.

chapters.title: 10. A night in the school
chapters.recap_uz: Barnabas Klamm xabarlarni kutmasligini, hatto ulardan g'ashlanishini aytadi. K. unga Klammga yangi, qisqa xabar beradi: shaxsan uchrashishga ruxsat so'raydi. K. uyga — maktabga qaytadi. Xona sovuq, o'tin shiyponi qulflangan; K. eshikni buzib, pech yoqtiradi. Ertalab o'qituvchi qiz Giza ularni to'shakda topib janjal qiladi, mushugi tufayli K.ning qo'lini tirnaydi. O'qituvchi shiypon buzilganini bilib, K.ni ishdan bo'shatadi, lekin K. faqat oqsoqolning bo'shatishini qabul qilishini aytib, ketmaydi.

paras.en: 'Look,' said Barnabas — and it seemed that, to defend his honour as a messenger, he was saying more than he should — 'Klamm isn't waiting for the news at all; he's even annoyed when I come. "More news again," he said once, and mostly he gets up when he sees me coming from a distance, goes into the next room and doesn't receive me. Nor is it laid down that I'm to come at once with every message; if it were laid down, I'd naturally come at once, but nothing is laid down about it, and if I never came, I wouldn't be reminded. When I bring a message, I do it of my own free will.'
paras.uz: «Qara, — dedi Barnabas va go'yo u chopar sharafini himoya qilish uchun aytish mumkin bo'lganidan ko'proq gapirayotgandek tuyuldi, — Klamm axir xabarlarni kutmaydi, men kelsam, hatto g'ashi keladi. «Yana yangi xabarlar», degan edi u bir marta; ko'pincha meni uzoqdan kelayotganimni ko'rsa, o'rnidan turib, qo'shni xonaga kirib ketadi va meni qabul qilmaydi. Har bir xabar bilan darhol kelishim kerakligi ham belgilanmagan; agar belgilangan bo'lsa, albatta darhol kelardim, lekin bu haqda hech narsa belgilanmagan va agar hech qachon kelmasam ham, menga eslatishmasdi. Xabar olib kelsam, buni o'z ixtiyorim bilan qilaman.»

paras.en: 'Good,' said K., watching Barnabas and deliberately looking away from the assistants, who by turns rose slowly behind Barnabas's shoulders as if out of a trapdoor and quickly vanished again with a light whistle imitating the wind, as though frightened by the sight of K. — they amused themselves like this for a long time. 'What it's like with Klamm I don't know; I doubt that you can make everything out exactly there, and even if you could, we couldn't improve these things. But carrying a message — that you can do, and that's what I ask of you. A very short message. Can you deliver it first thing tomorrow, and tell me the answer first thing tomorrow, or at least tell me how you were received? Can you do that, and will you? It would be very valuable to me. And perhaps I'll get an opportunity to thank you suitably — or perhaps you already have a wish now that I can fulfil.' 'Certainly I'll carry out the errand,' said Barnabas. 'And will you make an effort to carry it out as well as possible — hand it to Klamm himself, get the answer from Klamm himself, and at once, all at once, tomorrow, while it's still morning — will you?'
paras.uz: «Yaxshi», dedi K. Barnabasni kuzatib va yordamchilardan ataylab ko'zini olib; ular navbatma-navbat Barnabasning yelkalari ortidan go'yo yer ostidan chiqqandek sekin ko'tarilishar va go'yo K.ni ko'rib qo'rqib ketgandek, shamolga taqlid qilgan yengil hushtak bilan tezda yana g'oyib bo'lishardi — ular shu tarzda uzoq ko'ngil ochishdi. «Klammning huzurida qanday ekanini bilmayman; sen u yerda hamma narsani aniq ajrata olishingga shubha qilaman, ajrata olganingda ham, biz bu narsalarni tuzata olmasdik. Lekin xabar yetkazish — buni qila olasan va men sendan shuni so'rayman. Juda qisqa xabar. Uni ertaga ertalabdanoq yetkazib, ertaga ertalabdanoq menga javobni ayta olasanmi yoki hech bo'lmaganda qanday qabul qilinganingni aytib bera olasanmi? Buni qila olasanmi va qilishni xohlaysanmi? Bu men uchun juda qimmatli bo'lardi. Balki senga munosib minnatdorchilik bildirish imkoniyati ham topilar, yoki balki hozirdanoq men bajara oladigan biror istaging bordir.» «Albatta, topshiriqni bajaraman», dedi Barnabas. «Va uni iloji boricha yaxshi bajarishga, Klammning o'ziga topshirishga, javobni Klammning o'zidan olishga va darhol, hammasini darhol, ertaga, hali ertalabdanoq qilishga harakat qilasanmi?»

paras.en: 'I'll do my best,' said Barnabas, 'but I always do that.' 'Let's not argue about it any more now,' said K. 'This is the message: The land surveyor K. asks the Director to permit him to call on him in person; he accepts in advance any condition that might be attached to such permission. He is compelled to make this request because all intermediaries have so far failed completely; as proof he cites the fact that he has so far not carried out the slightest surveying work and, according to what the mayor has told him, never will; it was therefore with despairing shame that he read the Director's last letter; only a personal interview with the Director can help here. The land surveyor knows how much he is asking, but he will make every effort to make the disturbance as little noticeable to the Director as possible; he submits to any limitation of time, and he will also comply with any fixing, if considered necessary, of the number of words he may use in the interview; he believes he can manage with as few as ten. In deep reverence and extreme impatience he awaits the decision.' K. had spoken in self-forgetfulness, as though he were standing at Klamm's door talking to the doorkeeper. 'It's turned out much longer than I thought,' he said then, 'but you must deliver it by word of mouth; I don't want to write a letter — it would only go along the endless path of the files again.'
paras.uz: «Qo'limdan kelganini qilaman, — dedi Barnabas, — lekin men buni doim qilaman.» «Endi bu haqda boshqa bahslashmaylik, — dedi K. — Topshiriq mana bu: Yer o'lchovchi K. janob boshliqdan uning huzuriga shaxsan borishga ruxsat berishini so'raydi; u bunday ruxsatga bog'lanishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday shartni oldindan qabul qiladi. U bu iltimosga shuning uchun majburki, hozirgacha barcha vositachilar butunlay muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi; dalil sifatida u hozirgacha zarracha ham o'lchash ishini bajarmaganini va qishloq oqsoqolining aytishicha, hech qachon bajarmasligini keltiradi; shuning uchun u janob boshliqning so'nggi xatini umidsiz uyat bilan o'qidi; bu yerda faqat janob boshliq bilan shaxsiy suhbat yordam berishi mumkin. Yer o'lchovchi bu bilan qanchalik ko'p narsa so'rayotganini biladi, lekin u bu bezovtalikni janob boshliqqa iloji boricha kam sezdirishga harakat qiladi; u har qanday vaqt cheklovga bo'ysunadi, suhbatda ishlatishi mumkin bo'lgan so'zlar sonini — agar zarur deb topilsa — belgilashga ham yon beradi; u o'n so'z bilan ham uddalay olaman, deb hisoblaydi. Chuqur ehtirom va o'ta sabrsizlik bilan u qarorni kutadi.» K. o'zini unutib gapirgan edi, go'yo Klammning eshigi oldida turib, eshik qorovuli bilan gaplashayotgandek. «Bu men o'ylaganimdan ancha uzun bo'lib ketdi, — dedi u keyin, — lekin sen uni og'zaki yetkazishing kerak, men xat yozmoqchi emasman, u yana faqat hujjatlarning cheksiz yo'lidan ketardi.»

paras.en: So K. merely scribbled it down for Barnabas on a scrap of paper on one assistant's back, while the other held the light; but K. could already write it from Barnabas's dictation, for Barnabas had kept it all in his head and recited it with schoolboyish exactness, paying no attention to the assistants' wrong promptings. 'Your memory is extraordinary,' said K., and gave him the paper, 'but now, please, prove extraordinary in the other thing too. And the wishes? Have you none? It would — I'll say it openly — reassure me a little about the fate of my message if you had some.' At first Barnabas remained silent; then he said: 'My sisters send you their greetings.' 'Your sisters,' said K. 'Yes, the big, strong girls.' 'Both send you their greetings, but especially Amalia,' said Barnabas. 'It was she who brought me this letter for you from the Castle today.' Seizing on this piece of information above all others, K. asked: 'Couldn't she take my message to the Castle too? Or couldn't you both go, and each try your luck?' 'Amalia isn't allowed into the offices,' said Barnabas, 'otherwise she'd certainly be very glad to do it.' 'Perhaps I'll come to you tomorrow,' said K. 'Only you come first with the answer. I'll expect you at the school. Give my greetings to your sisters too.' K.'s promise seemed to make Barnabas very happy; after the farewell handshake he also touched K. fleetingly on the shoulder.
paras.uz: Shuning uchun K. buni faqat Barnabas uchun bir parcha qog'ozga, bir yordamchining orqasiga qo'yib, ikkinchisi yoritib turganda chizib yozdi; lekin K. uni allaqachon Barnabasning aytib turishi bo'yicha yoza oldi — u hammasini eslab qolgan va yordamchilarning noto'g'ri pichirlab aytib turishlariga e'tibor bermay, maktab o'quvchisidek aniq aytib berdi. «Xotirang favqulodda, — dedi K. va unga qog'ozni berdi, — endi esa, iltimos, boshqa narsada ham o'zingni favqulodda ko'rsat. Istaklar-chi? Senda yo'qmi? Ochiq aytaman: agar bo'lsa, xabarimning taqdiri borasida meni biroz tinchlantirgan bo'lardi.» Avvaliga Barnabas jim qoldi, keyin dedi: «Opa-singillarim senga salom yo'llashdi.» «Opa-singillaring, — dedi K., — ha, o'sha katta, baquvvat qizlar.» «Ikkalasi ham salom yo'llashdi, lekin ayniqsa Amaliya, — dedi Barnabas, — bugun bu xatni ham senga Qasrdan menga u olib keldi.» Hamma narsadan ko'ra shu xabarga yopishib, K. so'radi: «U mening xabarimni ham Qasrga olib bora olmaydimi? Yoki ikkalangiz ham borib, har biringiz omadingizni sinab ko'ra olmaysizmi?» «Amaliyaga idoralarga kirish mumkin emas, — dedi Barnabas, — aks holda u buni albatta juda bajonidil qilgan bo'lardi.» «Balki ertaga sizlarnikiga borarman, — dedi K., — faqat avval sen javob bilan kel. Seni maktabda kutaman. Opa-singillaringga mendan ham salom ayt.» K.ning va'dasi Barnabasni juda baxtiyor qilgandek bo'ldi; xayrlashuv qo'l siqishidan keyin u buning ustiga K.ning yelkasiga ham bir zum tegib qo'ydi.

paras.en: As though everything were now again as it had been when Barnabas first stepped in his radiance among the peasants in the taproom, K. felt this touch — smiling, admittedly — as a distinction. Grown gentler, he let the assistants do as they liked on the way back. He arrived home thoroughly frozen; it was dark everywhere, the candles in the lanterns had burned down; led by the assistants, who already knew their way about here, he groped his way into a schoolroom. 'Your first praiseworthy achievement,' he said, remembering Klamm's letter. Still half asleep, Frieda called from a corner: 'Let K. sleep! Don't disturb him!' So K. occupied her thoughts even when, overcome by sleepiness, she had not been able to wait up for him. Now a light was made; the lamp, however, could not be turned up very high, for there was only very little paraffin. The young household still had various shortcomings. The stove had been lit, it was true, but the big room, which was also used for gymnastics — the gymnastic apparatus stood about and hung from the ceiling — had already used up all the wood in stock and had, so K. was assured, been very pleasantly warm, but unfortunately had cooled right down again. There was indeed a large supply of wood in a shed, but this shed was locked, and the teacher had the key, and he permitted wood to be taken only for heating during lessons.
paras.uz: Go'yo endi hamma narsa yana Barnabas birinchi marta o'z jilosi bilan mehmonxona zalida dehqonlar orasiga kirib kelgan paytdagidek bo'lib qolgandek, K. bu tegishni — to'g'ri, jilmayib — sharaf sifatida his qildi. Yumshoqroq bo'lib qolgan K. qaytishda yordamchilarga xohlaganini qilishga yo'l qo'ydi. U butunlay muzlab uyga yetib keldi; hamma yoq qorong'i edi, fonuslardagi shamlar yonib tugagan edi; bu yerni allaqachon yaxshi biladigan yordamchilar boshlab borib, u paypaslab bir sinf xonasiga kirdi. «Sizlarning birinchi maqtovga loyiq yutug'ingiz», dedi u Klammning xatini eslab; hali yarim uyquda bir burchakdan Frida qichqirdi: «K.ni uxlatinglar! Uni bezovta qilmanglar!» Shunday qilib, K. hatto u uyquga yengilib, uni kuta olmagan paytda ham uning xayolini band qilardi. Endi chiroq yoqildi; to'g'ri, chiroqni yetarlicha kuchli qilib bo'lmasdi, chunki kerosin juda oz edi. Yosh xo'jalikda hali turli kamchiliklar bor edi. Pech yoqilgan edi-yu, lekin gimnastika uchun ham ishlatiladigan katta xona — gimnastika jihozlari atrofda turar va shiftdan osilib turardi — zaxiradagi barcha o'tinni allaqachon yutib yuborgan edi; K.ni ishontirishlaricha, xona juda yoqimli iliq bo'lgan, lekin afsuski, yana butunlay sovib ketgan edi. To'g'ri, shiyponda katta o'tin zaxirasi bor edi, lekin bu shiypon qulflangan, kaliti esa o'qituvchida edi va u o'tinni faqat dars vaqtida isitish uchun olishga ruxsat berardi.

paras.en: That would have been bearable if there had been beds to take refuge in. But in this respect there was nothing but a single straw mattress, commendably clean, covered with a woollen shawl of Frieda's, but without a feather quilt, and with only two coarse, stiff blankets that hardly gave any warmth. And even this poor straw mattress the assistants looked at covetously, though of course they had no hope of ever being allowed to lie on it. Frieda looked anxiously at K.; that she knew how to make a room, even the most wretched, homely, she had shown at the Bridge Inn, but here she had not been able to do more, being entirely without means. 'Our only room decoration is the gymnastic apparatus,' she said, laughing with difficulty through her tears. But as for the biggest shortcomings, the inadequate sleeping arrangements and heating, she promised with certainty to put them right the very next day, and asked K. only to be patient until then. No word, no hint, no expression suggested that she bore even the slightest bitterness towards K. in her heart, although, as he had to admit to himself, he had torn her away both from the Herrenhof and now from the Bridge Inn.
paras.uz: Agar qochib kirib olish mumkin bo'lgan to'shaklar bo'lganda, bunga chidasa bo'lardi. Lekin bu borada bitta somon to'shakdan boshqa hech narsa yo'q edi — u tahsinga loyiq darajada toza, Fridaning jun ro'moli bilan qoplangan, lekin parli ko'rpasiz va zo'rg'a isitadigan faqat ikkita qo'pol, qattiq adyol bilan. Hatto bu bechora somon to'shakka ham yordamchilar ochko'zlik bilan qarashardi, lekin unda yotishga hech qachon ruxsat berilishiga, albatta, umidlari yo'q edi. Frida K.ga xavotir bilan qaradi; u xonani — hatto eng nochor xonani ham — qanday qilib shinam qilishni bilishini «Ko'prik yonidagi» mehmonxonada isbotlagan edi, lekin bu yerda hech qanday imkoniyatsiz bo'lgani uchun bundan ortiq hech narsa qila olmagan edi. «Xonamizning yagona bezagi — gimnastika jihozlari», dedi u ko'z yoshlari orasidan zo'rg'a kulib. Lekin eng katta kamchiliklar — yetarli bo'lmagan uxlash joyi va isitish borasida u ertasi kunning o'zidayoq qat'iy tuzatishga va'da berdi va K.dan faqat shu paytgacha sabr qilishni so'radi. Birorta so'z, birorta ishora, birorta yuz ifodasi uning qalbida K.ga nisbatan zarracha ham alam borligini bildirmasdi, garchi K., o'ziga tan olishi kerak bo'lganidek, uni avval Herrenhofdan, endi esa «Ko'prik yonidagi» mehmonxonadan yulib olgan bo'lsa ham.

paras.en: For that reason, though, K. made an effort to find everything bearable — which wasn't so very hard for him, because in his thoughts he was walking with Barnabas and repeating his message word for word, not as he had given it to Barnabas, but as he believed it would sound before Klamm. Besides this, though, he was also sincerely looking forward to the coffee Frieda was making him on a spirit stove, and, leaning against the cooling stove, he followed her quick, much-practised movements as she spread the inevitable white cloth on the teacher's desk, set out a flowered coffee cup, and beside it bread and bacon and even a tin of sardines. Now everything was ready; Frieda too had not yet eaten but had waited for K. There were two chairs; K. and Frieda sat on them at the table, the assistants at their feet on the platform; but they never kept quiet, and even while eating they were a nuisance. Although they had been given plenty of everything and were far from finished, they got up from time to time to establish whether there was still much on the table and whether they could expect a bit more for themselves. K. paid no attention to them; only Frieda's laughter made him notice them. He covered her hand on the table caressingly with his own and asked quietly why she let them get away with so much, why she even accepted their bad behaviour in a friendly way.
paras.uz: Aynan shuning uchun K. hamma narsani chidasa bo'ladigan deb topishga harakat qildi; bu unga unchalik qiyin ham emas edi, chunki xayolan u Barnabas bilan birga yo'l bosar va o'z xabarini so'zma-so'z takrorlardi — uni Barnabasga topshirganidek emas, balki Klammning oldida qanday yangrashiga ishonganidek. Buning yonida esa u, to'g'ri, Frida spirt pilikdonida unga qaynatayotgan qahvani ham chin dildan kutardi va sovib borayotgan pechga suyanib, uning chaqqon, tajribali harakatlarini kuzatardi: u o'qituvchi stoliga muqarrar oq dasturxonni yoydi, gulli qahva piyolasini qo'ydi, yoniga non va cho'chqa yog'i, hatto sardina konservasini ham. Endi hammasi tayyor edi, Frida ham hali ovqatlanmagan, K.ni kutgan edi. Ikkita kursi bor edi; ularda stol yonida K. va Frida o'tirishdi, yordamchilar esa ularning oyoqlari ostida, minbarda; lekin ular hech qachon tinch turishmasdi, ovqatlanayotganda ham xalaqit berishardi. Har narsadan mo'l-ko'l olgan va hali tugatishdan ancha uzoq bo'lishsa ham, ular vaqti-vaqti bilan stolda hali ko'p narsa bormi va o'zlari uchun yana biror narsa kutishlari mumkinmi, shuni aniqlash uchun o'rinlaridan turishardi. K. ularga e'tibor bermasdi, faqat Fridaning kulgisi bilangina ularni payqadi. U uning stoldagi qo'lini erkalab o'z qo'li bilan yopdi va nega ularga shuncha narsani kechirayotganini, hatto ularning odobsizliklarini ham do'stona qabul qilayotganini sekin so'radi.

paras.en: In this way, he said, they would never be rid of them, whereas by treatment that was, so to speak, vigorous and really suited to their behaviour, one could succeed either in reining them in or — what was even more likely and also better — in so spoiling their job for them that they would finally run off. It didn't seem as though their stay here in the schoolhouse was going to be very pleasant; well, it wouldn't last long either, but one would hardly notice any of the shortcomings if the assistants were gone and the two of them were alone in the quiet house. Didn't she notice too that the assistants were growing more insolent day by day, as though it were really Frieda's presence that encouraged them, and the hope that K. would not take as firm a grip in front of her as he otherwise would? Besides, there might be quite simple means of getting rid of them at once without any fuss; perhaps Frieda even knew some, being so familiar with conditions here. And one would probably only be doing the assistants a favour by driving them away somehow, for the good life they were leading here wasn't much, and even the idleness they had enjoyed so far would stop here, at least in part, for they would have to work, while Frieda would have to spare herself after the agitations of the last few days, and he, K., would be busy finding a way out of their predicament.
paras.uz: Bu tarzda ulardan hech qachon qutulib bo'lmaydi, dedi u, holbuki qandaydir qattiqroq, ularning xatti-harakatiga haqiqatan mos keladigan muomala bilan yo ularni jilovlashga, yo — bu yanada ehtimolroq va yaxshiroq bo'lardi — ularga xizmatni shunchalik jonga tegdirishga erishish mumkinki, ular nihoyat qochib ketishadi. Bu yerda, maktab binosida qolish unchalik yoqimli bo'lmaydiganga o'xshaydi; xo'sh, u uzoq ham davom etmaydi, lekin agar yordamchilar ketsa va ular ikkalasi bu sokin uyda yolg'iz qolishsa, barcha kamchiliklarni deyarli sezmas edilar. Nahotki u ham yordamchilar kundan-kunga surbetroq bo'layotganini payqamayotgan bo'lsa — go'yo ularni aslida Fridaning borligi va K. uning oldida, aks holda qilganidek qattiq qo'l bilan tutmasligiga umid ruhlantirayotgandek? Aytgancha, ehtimol, ulardan darhol, hech qanday mashaqqatsiz qutulishning juda oddiy vositalari bordir, ehtimol, ularni hatto mahalliy sharoitlarni shunchalik yaxshi biladigan Frida biladi. Yordamchilarning o'zlariga ham, ularni qandaydir yo'l bilan haydab yuborsang, ehtimol, faqat yaxshilik qilgan bo'larding, chunki ular bu yerda yashayotgan farovon hayot unchalik katta emas, hatto hozirgacha rohatlanib kelgan dangasaliklari ham bu yerda hech bo'lmaganda qisman to'xtaydi, chunki ular ishlashga majbur bo'lishadi, holbuki Frida so'nggi kunlardagi hayajonlardan keyin o'zini ehtiyot qilishi kerak, u — K. esa ularning og'ir ahvolidan chiqish yo'lini topish bilan band bo'ladi.

paras.en: However, if the assistants were to go, he would feel so relieved that he would easily be able to do all the caretaker's work as well as everything else.
paras.uz: Ammo, agar yordamchilar ketsa, u o'zini shunchalik yengil his qiladiki, barcha boshqa ishlar qatori maktab qorovulining butun ishini ham bemalol bajara oladi.

paras.en: Frieda, who had listened attentively, slowly stroked his arm and said that all this was her opinion too, but that perhaps he was overestimating the assistants' bad behaviour. They were young lads, merry and a bit simple, in a stranger's service for the first time, released from the strict discipline of the Castle, and therefore constantly a little excited and astonished; and in this state they sometimes did foolish things, which it was natural to be annoyed about, but more sensible to laugh at. Sometimes she couldn't help laughing. All the same, she entirely agreed with K. that it would be best to send them away and be alone, just the two of them. She moved closer to K. and hid her face against his shoulder. And there she said, so indistinctly that K. had to bend down to her, that she knew no means against the assistants, though, and she was afraid everything K. had suggested would fail. As far as she knew, K. himself had asked for them, and now he had them and would keep them. It was best to take them lightly, as the light-minded folk they were; that was the best way to bear them.
paras.uz: Diqqat bilan tinglagan Frida uning qo'lini sekin siladi va bularning hammasi uning ham fikri ekanini, lekin u, balki, yordamchilarning odobsizliklarini baribir ortiqcha baholayotganini aytdi: ular yosh yigitlar, quvnoq va biroz sodda, birinchi marta begona odamning xizmatida, Qasrning qattiq tartibidan bo'shatilgan, shuning uchun doim biroz hayajonlangan va hayratda; bu holatda ular ba'zan ahmoqona ishlar qilishadi, ulardan g'ashlanish, albatta, tabiiy, lekin kulish oqilonaroq. Ba'zan u kulishdan o'zini tiya olmaydi. Shunga qaramay, u K. bilan butunlay rozi: eng yaxshisi ularni jo'natib yuborish va ikkovlon yolg'iz qolish bo'lardi. U K.ga yaqinroq surildi va yuzini uning yelkasiga yashirdi. Va o'sha yerda shunchalik tushunarsiz gapirdiki, K. unga egilishga majbur bo'ldi: u yordamchilarga qarshi hech qanday vositani bilmaydi va K. taklif qilgan hamma narsa barbod bo'lishidan qo'rqadi. Uning bilishicha, K.ning o'zi ularni talab qilgan, endi esa ular unda va u ularni saqlab qoladi. Eng yaxshisi — ularni yengiltak xalq sifatida, ular aslida shunday ham, yengil qabul qilish; shunda ularga eng yaxshi chidaysan.

paras.en: K. was not satisfied with the answer; half in jest, half in earnest, he said that she seemed to be in league with them, or at least to have a great fondness for them; well, they were handsome lads, but there was nobody one couldn't get rid of with a little goodwill, and he would prove it to her on the assistants.
paras.uz: K. javobdan qoniqmadi; yarim hazil, yarim chin bilan u, aftidan, u ular bilan til biriktirgan yoki hech bo'lmaganda ularga katta mehr qo'ygan ko'rinadi, dedi; xo'sh, ular chiroyli yigitlar, lekin ozgina xohish bilan qutulib bo'lmaydigan odam yo'q va u buni yordamchilar misolida unga isbotlab beradi.

paras.en: Frieda said she would be very grateful to him if he succeeded. Besides, from now on she would no longer laugh at them or speak an unnecessary word to them; it really was no small thing to be constantly watched by two men; she had learned to look at the two of them with his eyes. And indeed she gave a little start when the assistants now got up again, partly to inspect the food supplies, partly to get to the bottom of the constant whispering.
paras.uz: Frida, agar uddalasa, unga juda minnatdor bo'lishini aytdi. Aytgancha, bundan buyon u ularning ustidan kulmaydi va ular bilan ortiqcha bir og'iz ham gaplashmaydi; ikki erkak tomonidan doim kuzatib turilish haqiqatan ham arzimas narsa emas, u ikkalasiga uning ko'zlari bilan qarashni o'rgandi. Va haqiqatan ham, yordamchilar hozir yana — qisman ovqat zaxiralarini tekshirish, qisman to'xtovsiz pichirlashning tagiga yetish uchun — o'rinlaridan turganlarida, u biroz cho'chib tushdi.

paras.en: K. made use of this to spoil the assistants for Frieda; he drew Frieda to him, and close together they finished the meal. Now they should have gone to bed, and everyone was very tired; one assistant had even fallen asleep over his food, which greatly amused the other, and he wanted to get the master and mistress to look at the sleeper's silly face, but he didn't succeed; K. and Frieda sat up above, unresponsive. In the cold, which was becoming unbearable, they hesitated to go to bed too; finally K. declared that the stove must be lit again, otherwise it would be impossible to sleep. He hunted for an axe of some kind; the assistants knew of one and brought it, and now they went to the woodshed. After a short time the flimsy door had been broken open; delighted, as though they had never experienced anything so lovely, chasing and pushing each other, the assistants began carrying wood into the schoolroom. Soon there was a big pile there; the stove was lit, everyone lay down round it; the assistants were given a blanket to wrap themselves in, and it was quite enough for them, for it was agreed that one of them should always stay awake and keep the fire going. Soon it was so warm by the stove that the blanket wasn't needed at all; the lamp was put out, and, happy in the warmth and the quiet, K. and Frieda stretched out to sleep.
paras.uz: K. bundan Fridaning ko'nglini yordamchilardan sovutish uchun foydalandi, Fridani o'ziga tortdi va ular bir-biriga zich yopishib ovqatni tugatishdi. Endi uxlashga yotish kerak edi, hamma juda charchagan edi, bir yordamchi hatto ovqat ustida uxlab qolgan edi; bu ikkinchisini juda qiziqtirdi va u xo'jayinlarni uxlayotganning ahmoqona yuziga qarashga undamoqchi bo'ldi, lekin uddalay olmadi, K. va Frida tepada befarq o'tirishardi. Chidab bo'lmas darajaga kelayotgan sovuqda ular uxlashga yotishga ham ikkilanishdi; nihoyat K. yana pech yoqish kerak, aks holda uxlab bo'lmaydi, dedi. U qandaydir bolta qidirdi, yordamchilar bittasini bilishardi va olib kelishdi, endi o'tin shiyponiga yo'l olishdi. Qisqa vaqt ichida yengil eshik buzib ochildi; go'yo bunchalik go'zal narsani hech qachon boshdan kechirmagandek hayajonlanib, bir-birini quvlab, turtib, yordamchilar sinf xonasiga o'tin tashiy boshlashdi; tez orada u yerda katta uyum paydo bo'ldi, pech yoqildi, hamma pech atrofiga yotdi; yordamchilarga o'ranib olish uchun bitta adyol berildi, bu ularga butunlay yetarli edi, chunki ulardan biri doim uyg'oq qolib, olovni saqlab turishi kelishib olindi; tez orada pech yonida shunchalik iliq bo'ldiki, adyolga umuman ehtiyoj qolmadi; chiroq o'chirildi va iliqlik va sukunatdan baxtiyor K. va Frida uxlash uchun cho'zilishdi.

paras.en: When K. woke in the night at some noise and, in the first uncertain movement of sleep, groped for Frieda, he noticed that instead of Frieda an assistant was lying beside him. This — probably as a result of the irritability that being suddenly woken brings with it — was the greatest fright he had yet experienced in the village. With a cry he half rose and, beside himself, gave the assistant such a blow with his fist that he began to cry. The whole thing, by the way, was cleared up at once. Frieda had been woken because — at least so it had seemed to her — some large animal, a cat probably, had jumped onto her chest and then immediately run off. She had got up and was searching the whole room for the animal with a candle. One of the assistants had taken advantage of this to procure himself the pleasure of the straw mattress for a little while, for which he was now paying bitterly. But Frieda could find nothing — perhaps it had only been an illusion — and she came back to K.; on the way, as though she had forgotten the evening's conversation, she stroked the hair of the assistant, who was huddled up whimpering, to comfort him. K. said nothing about it; he only ordered the assistants to stop stoking, for, with almost all the wood they had gathered used up, it had already become overheated. In the morning everyone woke only when the first schoolchildren were already there, crowding curiously round the sleeping place.
paras.uz: Tunda K. qandaydir shovqindan uyg'onib, uyquning birinchi noaniq harakatida Fridani paypaslab izlaganida, Frida o'rniga yonida bir yordamchi yotganini payqadi. Bu — ehtimol, to'satdan uyg'otilishning o'zi keltiradigan asabiylik tufayli — u qishloqda hozirgacha boshdan kechirgan eng katta qo'rquv edi. Qichqiriq bilan u yarim ko'tarildi va o'zini yo'qotib, yordamchiga shunday musht urdiki, u yig'lay boshladi. Aytgancha, hammasi darhol oydinlashdi. Frida shundan uyg'ongan ediki — hech bo'lmaganda unga shunday tuyulgan edi — qandaydir katta hayvon, ehtimol mushuk, uning ko'kragiga sakrab chiqib, keyin darhol qochib ketgan. U o'rnidan turib, sham bilan butun xonani hayvonni izlab tintib chiqayotgan edi. Bundan bir yordamchi biroz vaqtga somon to'shakdan rohatlanish uchun foydalangan va endi buning uchun achchiq jazo tortayotgan edi. Frida esa hech narsa topa olmadi — balki bu faqat ko'zga ko'ringandir — u K.ning yoniga qaytdi, yo'lda esa go'yo kechki suhbatni unutgandek, bukchayib ingrab yotgan yordamchining sochini yupatib siladi. K. bunga hech narsa demadi; u faqat yordamchilarga pech yoqishni to'xtatishni buyurdi, chunki to'plangan deyarli butun o'tin sarflanib, xona allaqachon haddan tashqari qizib ketgan edi. Ertalab hamma faqat birinchi maktab bolalari kelib, qiziqib yotoq joyini o'rab olganlaridagina uyg'ondi.

paras.en: This was unpleasant, for as a result of the great heat — which, towards morning, had admittedly given way again to a sharp chill — they had all undressed down to their shirts, and just as they began to dress, Gisa the schoolmistress appeared in the doorway: a fair, tall, beautiful girl, only a little stiff. She was plainly prepared for the new caretaker and had probably also received instructions from the teacher, for already on the threshold she said: 'I can't tolerate this. That would be a fine state of affairs. You merely have permission to sleep in the schoolroom, but I have no obligation to teach in your bedroom. A caretaker's family lolling in bed until mid-morning — shame!' Well, there would be something to say against that, especially as regards the family and the beds, thought K., while he and Frieda — the assistants were no use for this; lying on the floor, they gaped at the schoolmistress and the children — hurriedly pushed up the parallel bars and the vaulting horse, threw the blankets over both and so made a small space in which, safe from the children's eyes, one could at least get dressed.
paras.uz: Bu noqulay edi, chunki katta issiqlik tufayli — u, to'g'ri, endi tongga yaqin yana sezilarli salqinlikka o'rin bergan edi — hamma ko'ylakkacha yechingan edi va aynan kiyina boshlaganlarida eshikda o'qituvchi qiz Giza paydo bo'ldi: sariq sochli, baland bo'yli, chiroyli, faqat biroz qotma qiz. U yangi maktab qorovuliga ochiqdan-ochiq tayyorlangan va, ehtimol, o'qituvchidan qanday yo'l tutish haqida ko'rsatmalar ham olgan edi, chunki ostonadayoq dedi: «Bunga chiday olmayman. Bu ajoyib tartib bo'lardi-da. Sizga faqat sinf xonasida uxlashga ruxsat berilgan, menda esa yotoqxonangizda dars berish majburiyati yo'q. Choshgohgacha to'shakda cho'zilib yotgan maktab qorovuli oilasi — tfu!» Xo'sh, bunga qarshi aytadigan gaplar bor edi, ayniqsa oila va to'shaklar borasida, deb o'yladi K., Frida bilan birga — yordamchilar bunga yaramasdi, ular polda yotib, o'qituvchi qizga va bolalarga anqayib qarab turishardi — shoshilinch ravishda qo'sh brus va gimnastika otini surib kelib, ikkalasining ustiga adyollarni tashlab, bolalarning nigohidan pana kichik joy hosil qilarkan; unda hech bo'lmaganda kiyinib olish mumkin edi.

paras.en: There was no peace for a single moment, though. First the schoolmistress scolded because there was no fresh water in the washbasin; K. had just been thinking of fetching the washbasin for himself and Frieda, and he gave up the idea for the time being so as not to irritate the schoolmistress too much; but the sacrifice was no use, for shortly afterwards there was a great crash. Unfortunately they had neglected to clear the remains of supper from the teacher's desk; the schoolmistress removed everything with her ruler, and it all flew onto the floor. That the sardine oil and the remains of the coffee ran out and the coffee pot was smashed to pieces need not concern the schoolmistress — the caretaker would of course tidy up at once. Not yet fully dressed, K. and Frieda, leaning against the parallel bars, watched the destruction of their small possessions; the assistants, who were evidently not thinking of dressing at all, peeped out between the blankets down below, to the great delight of the children. What hurt Frieda most, of course, was the loss of the coffee pot; only when K., to comfort her, assured her that he would go at once to the mayor and demand a replacement, and get it, did she pull herself together enough to run out of the enclosure, in nothing but her shift and petticoat, to fetch at least the cloth and save it from further dirt. And she managed it, although the schoolmistress, to frighten her off, kept hammering on the table with her ruler in a nerve-racking way.
paras.uz: Lekin bir lahza ham tinchlik yo'q edi: avval o'qituvchi qiz yuvinish tog'orasida toza suv yo'qligi uchun janjal qildi; K. endigina tog'orani o'zi va Frida uchun olib kelishni o'ylagan edi, o'qituvchi qizni haddan tashqari g'ashlantirmaslik uchun hozircha bu niyatdan voz kechdi, lekin voz kechish hech narsaga yordam bermadi, chunki ko'p o'tmay katta taraqa-turuq bo'ldi: afsuski, kechki ovqat qoldiqlarini o'qituvchi stolidan yig'ishtirishni unutib qo'yishgan edi; o'qituvchi qiz hammasini chizg'ich bilan supurib tashladi, hammasi yerga uchib tushdi; sardina yog'i va qahva qoldiqlari oqib ketgani, qahva idishi esa chil-chil singani o'qituvchi qizni tashvishlantirmasligi kerak edi — maktab qorovuli axir darhol tartibga keltiradi. Hali to'liq kiyinmagan K. va Frida brusga suyanib, kichkina mol-mulklarining yo'q qilinishini tomosha qilishdi; kiyinishni, aftidan, umuman o'ylamayotgan yordamchilar esa pastda, adyollar orasidan bolalarning katta zavqiga mo'ralab turishardi. Fridaga, albatta, eng ko'p qahva idishining yo'qolishi og'ir botdi; faqat K. uni yupatish uchun darhol oqsoqolning oldiga borib, o'rniga boshqasini talab qilishiga va olishiga ishontirgandan keyingina u o'zini shunchalik qo'lga oldiki, faqat ko'ylak va ichki yubka kiygan holda to'siqdan yugurib chiqdi — hech bo'lmaganda dasturxonni olib, uni yana ifloslanishdan saqlab qolish uchun. Bu unga muyassar ham bo'ldi, garchi o'qituvchi qiz uni cho'chitish uchun chizg'ich bilan stolga to'xtovsiz, asabni buzadigan darajada urib tursa ham.

paras.en: When K. and Frieda had dressed, they had not only to urge the assistants, who seemed dazed by events, to dress with orders and shoves, but in part even to dress them themselves. Then, when everyone was ready, K. allotted the next tasks: the assistants were to fetch wood and light the stove — but first in the other schoolroom, from which great dangers still threatened, for the teacher was probably already there. Frieda was to clean the floor, and K. would fetch water and tidy up generally; breakfast was not to be thought of for the time being. But in order to find out about the schoolmistress's mood in general, K. wanted to go out first; the others were to follow only when he called them. He made this arrangement partly because he didn't want the situation made worse from the start by the assistants' foolishness, and partly because he wanted to spare Frieda as much as possible; for she had ambition, he had none; she was sensitive, he was not; she thought only of the present little abominations, but he thought of Barnabas and the future. Frieda followed all his instructions exactly and hardly took her eyes off him. He had hardly stepped out when the schoolmistress called, amid the laughter of the children, which from then on never stopped at all: 'Well, slept your fill?' And when K. paid no attention, because it wasn't really a question, but made for the washstand, the schoolmistress asked: 'What have you done to my pussy?'
paras.uz: K. va Frida kiyinib bo'lgach, voqealardan go'yo gangib qolgan yordamchilarni faqat buyruqlar va turtkilar bilan kiyinishga undashgina emas, qisman hatto o'zlari kiyintirishlari ham kerak bo'ldi. Keyin, hamma tayyor bo'lgach, K. navbatdagi ishlarni taqsimladi: yordamchilar o'tin olib kelib, pech yoqishlari kerak, lekin avval boshqa sinf xonasida — u yerdan hali katta xavflar tahdid qilardi, chunki u yerda, ehtimol, o'qituvchi allaqachon bor edi. Frida polni tozalashi kerak, K. esa suv olib kelib, boshqa narsalarni tartibga keltiradi; nonushta haqida hozircha o'ylab ham bo'lmasdi. Lekin o'qituvchi qizning kayfiyatini umuman bilib olish uchun K. birinchi bo'lib chiqmoqchi edi, qolganlar esa faqat u chaqirgandagina ergashishlari kerak edi. U bu tartibni bir tomondan yordamchilarning ahmoqliklari tufayli vaziyat boshidanoq yomonlashishini istamagani uchun, ikkinchi tomondan esa Fridani iloji boricha ayamoqchi bo'lgani uchun o'rnatdi: chunki unda shuhratparastlik bor edi, unda yo'q; u sezgir edi, u emas; u faqat hozirgi mayda jirkanch narsalar haqida o'ylardi, K. esa Barnabas va kelajak haqida. Frida uning barcha ko'rsatmalarini aniq bajardi, undan deyarli ko'zini uzmadi. K. oldinga chiqishi bilan o'qituvchi qiz bolalarning — shu paytdan boshlab umuman to'xtamagan — kulgisi ostida qichqirdi: «Xo'sh, to'yib uxladingizmi?» K. bunga e'tibor bermay — chunki bu aslida savol emas edi — yuvinish stoli tomon yurganida, o'qituvchi qiz so'radi: «Mening mushugimga nima qildingiz?»

paras.en: A large, old, fleshy cat lay lazily sprawled on the table, and the schoolmistress was examining its paw, which was evidently a little hurt. So Frieda had been right after all: this cat hadn't exactly jumped on her — it could probably no longer jump — but it had crawled over her, been frightened by the presence of people in the otherwise empty house, hastily hidden itself, and in this unaccustomed haste hurt itself. K. tried calmly to explain this to the schoolmistress, but she grasped only the result and said: 'Well, yes, you've hurt her — that's how you've introduced yourselves here. Just look!' And she called K. up to the desk, showed him the paw, and before he knew it she had drawn a stroke across the back of his hand with the claws; the claws were already blunt, it was true, but the schoolmistress — this time without consideration for the cat — had pressed them in so hard that they did leave bloody weals. 'And now go to your work,' she said impatiently, and bent down to the cat again. Frieda, who had been watching from behind the parallel bars with the assistants, cried out at the sight of the blood. K. showed his hand to the children and said: 'Look, a wicked, treacherous cat did this to me.'
paras.uz: Stol ustida katta, qari, semiz mushuk dangasalik bilan cho'zilib yotardi, o'qituvchi qiz esa uning, aftidan, biroz shikastlangan panjasini ko'zdan kechirayotgan edi. Demak, Frida baribir haq ekan: bu mushuk, to'g'ri, uning ustiga sakramagan — chunki, ehtimol, endi sakray olmasdi ham — lekin uning ustidan emaklab o'tgan, odatda bo'm-bo'sh uyda odamlar borligidan qo'rqib, shoshib yashiringan va bu o'ziga odatiy bo'lmagan shoshilishda shikastlangan edi. K. buni o'qituvchi qizga xotirjam tushuntirishga urindi, lekin u faqat natijani tushundi va dedi: «Xo'sh, ha, uni shikastladingiz, bu yerga shu bilan o'zingizni tanishtirdingiz. Mana, qarang!» Va u K.ni o'qituvchi stoliga chaqirib, unga panjani ko'rsatdi va u nima bo'layotganini anglab ulgurmasidan, tirnoqlari bilan uning kaftining orqasidan chiziq tortdi; tirnoqlar, to'g'ri, allaqachon o'tmas edi, lekin o'qituvchi qiz — bu safar mushukni ayamay — ularni shunchalik qattiq botirdiki, baribir qonli izlar qoldi. «Endi ishingizga boring», dedi u sabrsizlik bilan va yana mushukka egildi. Yordamchilar bilan brus orqasidan tomosha qilib turgan Frida qonni ko'rib qichqirib yubordi. K. qo'lini bolalarga ko'rsatib dedi: «Qaranglar, buni menga yovuz, makkor mushuk qildi.»

paras.en: He didn't say it for the children's sake, of course; their shouting and laughter had already become so much a matter of course that it needed no further occasion or stimulus, and no word could penetrate or influence it. But since the schoolmistress too answered the insult only with a short sidelong glance and otherwise stayed busy with the cat — her first fury, then, seemed satisfied by the bloody punishment — K. called Frieda and the assistants, and the work began.
paras.uz: U buni, albatta, bolalar uchun aytmadi — ularning qichqirig'i va kulgisi allaqachon shunchalik odatiy bo'lib qolgan ediki, hech qanday qo'shimcha sabab yoki turtkiga muhtoj emas edi va hech qanday so'z uni yorib o'ta olmas yoki unga ta'sir qila olmasdi. Lekin o'qituvchi qiz ham haqoratga faqat qisqa yonlama nigoh bilan javob berib, qolgan vaqt mushuk bilan band bo'lgani uchun — demak, birinchi g'azabi qonli jazo bilan qondirilgandek tuyulgani uchun — K. Frida va yordamchilarni chaqirdi va ish boshlandi.

paras.en: When K. had carried out the bucket of dirty water, brought fresh water and was now starting to sweep the schoolroom, a boy of about twelve stepped out from a bench, touched K.'s hand and said something completely unintelligible in the great din. Then suddenly all the noise stopped; K. turned round. What had been feared all morning had happened. In the doorway stood the teacher; the little man was holding an assistant by the collar in each hand. He had probably caught them fetching wood, for in a mighty voice he cried, pausing after every word: 'Who has dared to break into the woodshed? Where is the fellow, so that I can crush him?' At that Frieda got up from the floor, which she was toiling to wash clean at the schoolmistress's feet, looked over at K. as though she wanted to draw strength from him, and said — and there was something of her old superiority in her look and bearing: 'I did it, teacher. I didn't know what else to do. If the schoolrooms were to be heated early, the shed had to be opened; I didn't dare fetch the key from you in the night; my fiancé was at the Herrenhof, it was possible that he'd stay there all night, so I had to decide on my own. If I've done wrong, forgive my inexperience; I've already been scolded enough by my fiancé when he saw what had happened.
paras.uz: K. iflos suvli chelakni olib chiqib, toza suv olib kelgach va endi sinf xonasini supura boshlaganida, taxminan o'n ikki yoshli bir bola partadan chiqib, K.ning qo'liga tegdi va katta shovqinda butunlay tushunib bo'lmaydigan bir narsa dedi. Shunda to'satdan butun shovqin to'xtadi, K. o'girildi. Ertalabdan beri qo'rqilgan narsa sodir bo'lgan edi. Eshikda o'qituvchi turardi; bu pakana odam har bir qo'li bilan bir yordamchini yoqasidan ushlab turardi; ehtimol, ularni o'tin olib kelayotganda tutib olgandi, chunki u qudratli ovoz bilan har bir so'zdan keyin to'xtab qichqirdi: «O'tin shiyponini buzib kirishga kim jur'at etdi? O'sha ablah qayerda, uni ezib tashlay?» Shunda Frida o'qituvchi qizning oyoqlari ostida yuvib tozalashga urinayotgan poldan qad ko'tardi, go'yo kuch olmoqchidek K.ga qaradi va nigohi va qomatida eski ustunligidan nimadir bor holda dedi: «Buni men qildim, janob o'qituvchi. Boshqa chorani bilmadim. Agar sinf xonalari erta isitilishi kerak bo'lsa, shiyponni ochish kerak edi; tunda kalitni sizdan olishga jur'at etmadim; qallig'im Herrenhofda edi, u tunni o'sha yerda o'tkazishi mumkin edi, shuning uchun o'zim yolg'iz qaror qilishim kerak edi. Agar noto'g'ri qilgan bo'lsam, tajribasizligimni kechiring; qallig'im nima bo'lganini ko'rganida meni yetarlicha koyidi.

paras.en: Indeed, he even forbade me to light the stove early, because he thought that by locking the shed you had shown you didn't want any heating before you came yourself. So it's his fault that there's no heating, but mine that the shed was broken open.' 'Who broke the door open?' the teacher asked the assistants, who were still trying in vain to shake off his grip. 'The gentleman,' said both, and, so that there should be no doubt, pointed at K. Frieda laughed, and this laugh seemed even more convincing than her words; then she began to wring out the cloth she had been washing the floor with into the bucket, as though her explanation had ended the incident and the assistants' statements were only an afterthought of a joke. Only when she had knelt down again, ready for work, did she say: 'Our assistants are children who, in spite of their years, still belong on these school benches. For I opened the door with the axe on my own towards evening; it was very simple; I didn't need the assistants for it, they would only have got in the way. But then, when my fiancé came in the night and went out to look at the damage and repair it if possible, the assistants ran out with him, probably because they were afraid to stay here alone, saw my fiancé working at the broken door, and that's why they're now saying — well, they're children.'
paras.uz: Ha, u hatto menga erta pech yoqishni ham taqiqladi, chunki u siz shiyponni qulflab, o'zingiz kelmaguningizcha isitishni istamasligingizni ko'rsatgansiz, deb o'yladi. Demak, isitilmagani uning aybi, shiypon buzib ochilgani esa meniki.» «Eshikni kim buzdi?» — so'radi o'qituvchi hamon uning changalidan behuda qutulishga urinayotgan yordamchilardan. «Janob», deyishdi ikkalasi va shubha qolmasligi uchun K.ni ko'rsatishdi. Frida kuldi va bu kulgi uning so'zlaridan ham ko'proq isbotlovchi tuyuldi; keyin u polni yuvgan lattasini chelakka siqa boshladi — go'yo uning tushuntirishi bilan hodisa tugagan va yordamchilarning ko'rsatmalari faqat keyingi hazil edi; faqat yana ishga tayyor holda tiz cho'kkandan keyingina dedi: «Bizning yordamchilarimiz — yoshlariga qaramay hali shu maktab partalariga tegishli bo'lgan bolalar. Gap shundaki, men kechga yaqin eshikni bolta bilan yolg'iz o'zim ochdim, bu juda oson edi, buning uchun yordamchilar kerak emas edi, ular faqat xalaqit berishardi. Lekin keyin tunda qallig'im kelib, shikastni ko'rish va iloji bo'lsa tuzatish uchun chiqqanida, yordamchilar ham u bilan birga yugurishdi — ehtimol, bu yerda yolg'iz qolishdan qo'rqqanlari uchun — qallig'imni buzilgan eshik yonida ishlayotganini ko'rishdi, shuning uchun endi shunday deyishyapti — axir ular bolalar.»

paras.en: The assistants, it is true, kept shaking their heads throughout Frieda's explanation, went on pointing at K. and strained to dissuade Frieda from her view by mute play of expression; but as they didn't succeed, they finally gave in, took Frieda's words as an order, and to a further question from the teacher they no longer answered. 'So,' said the teacher, 'you lied, then? Or at least accused the caretaker thoughtlessly?' They were still silent, but their trembling and their frightened looks seemed to point to a sense of guilt. 'Then I shall thrash you at once,' said the teacher, and sent a child into the other room for the cane. When he raised the cane, Frieda cried: 'But the assistants told the truth!' — threw the cloth into the bucket in despair, so that the water splashed up, and ran behind the parallel bars, where she hid. 'A lying lot,' said the schoolmistress, who had just finished bandaging the paw and took the animal onto her lap, for which it was almost too broad.
paras.uz: To'g'ri, Fridaning tushuntirishi davomida yordamchilar to'xtovsiz bosh chayqashar, K.ni ko'rsatishda davom etishar va jim yuz ifodalari bilan Fridani fikridan qaytarishga zo'r berishardi; lekin uddalay olmagach, nihoyat yon berishdi, Fridaning so'zlarini buyruq deb qabul qilishdi va o'qituvchining yangi savoliga endi javob berishmadi. «Xo'sh, — dedi o'qituvchi, — demak, yolg'on gapirdingizmi? Yoki hech bo'lmaganda maktab qorovulini yengiltaklik bilan aybladingizmi?» Ular hamon jim edilar, lekin titrashlari va qo'rqoq nigohlari aybdorlik hissini bildirayotgandek edi. «Unda sizlarni hozir savalayman», dedi o'qituvchi va bir bolani boshqa xonaga tayoq olib kelishga yubordi. U tayoqni ko'targanida, Frida qichqirdi: «Yordamchilar axir rost gapirishdi!» — umidsizlik bilan lattani chelakka shunday tashladiki, suv sachrab ketdi va brus orqasiga yugurib, o'sha yerda yashirindi. «Yolg'onchi xalq», dedi endigina panjani bog'lab bo'lgan va hayvonni tizzasiga olgan — u tizzaga deyarli sig'masdi — o'qituvchi qiz.

paras.en: 'That leaves the caretaker, then,' said the teacher, pushing the assistants away and turning to K., who all this time had been listening, leaning on his broom: 'this caretaker, who out of cowardice calmly allows others to be falsely accused of his own rascalities.' 'Well,' said K., who could see that Frieda's intervention had after all softened the teacher's first unbridled anger, 'if the assistants had been thrashed a little, I wouldn't have been sorry; if they've been spared on ten just occasions, they can pay for it once on an unjust one. But apart from that I'd have welcomed it if a direct clash between you and me, teacher, had been avoided; perhaps you'd even have liked that too. But since Frieda has now sacrificed me to the assistants —' here K. paused; in the silence Frieda could be heard sobbing behind the blankets — 'the matter must now of course be cleared up.' 'Outrageous,' said the schoolmistress. 'I entirely share your opinion, Fräulein Gisa,' said the teacher. 'You, caretaker, are of course dismissed on the spot for this disgraceful breach of duty; I reserve the punishment that is still to follow, but now take yourself out of the house at once with all your things. It will be a real relief to us, and lessons will at last be able to begin. So — quickly!' 'I'm not budging from here,' said K.
paras.uz: «Demak, janob maktab qorovuli qoldi», dedi o'qituvchi yordamchilarni itarib yuborib va butun vaqt davomida supurgiga suyanib tinglab turgan K.ga o'girildi: «Qo'rqoqligidan o'z qabihliklari uchun boshqalarni yolg'on ayblashlariga xotirjam rozi bo'ladigan mana shu janob maktab qorovuli.» «Xo'sh, — dedi K., Fridaning aralashuvi o'qituvchining birinchi jilovsiz g'azabini baribir yumshatganini payqab, — agar yordamchilar biroz savalanganida, men achinmasdim; agar ular o'nta adolatli holatda ayab qolingan bo'lsa, bir marta adolatsiz holatda jazosini tortishlari mumkin. Lekin bundan tashqari, men bilan siz, janob o'qituvchi, o'rtamizdagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'qnashuvdan qochilganida, men xursand bo'lardim; balki bu sizga ham yoqardi. Lekin endi Frida meni yordamchilarga qurbon qilganidan keyin… — bu yerda K. to'xtadi, sukunatda adyollar ortidan Fridaning hiqillab yig'layotgani eshitilardi, — endi, albatta, ishni oydinlashtirish kerak.» «Eshitilmagan gap», dedi o'qituvchi qiz. «Men sizning fikringizga butunlay qo'shilaman, Giza xonim», dedi o'qituvchi. «Siz, maktab qorovuli, bu sharmandali xizmat qoidabuzarligi uchun, albatta, shu zahoti ishdan bo'shatildingiz; hali keladigan jazoni o'zimga qoldiraman, hozir esa barcha narsalaringiz bilan darhol uydan yo'qoling. Bu biz uchun haqiqiy yengillik bo'ladi va dars nihoyat boshlana oladi. Xo'sh, tezroq!» «Men bu yerdan jilmayman», dedi K.

paras.en: 'You are my superior, but not the one who gave me the post — that is the mayor, and I accept notice only from him. But he surely didn't give me the post so that I should freeze here with my people, but — as you said yourself — to prevent rash acts of desperation on my part. To dismiss me suddenly now would therefore be directly against his intention; as long as I don't hear the opposite from his own mouth, I don't believe it. Besides, it is probably also to your great advantage if I don't comply with your thoughtless dismissal.' 'So you won't comply?' asked the teacher. K. shook his head. 'Think it over carefully,' said the teacher. 'Your decisions are not always the very best; think, for example, of yesterday afternoon, when you refused to be questioned.' 'Why do you mention that now?' asked K. 'Because it pleased me to,' said the teacher, 'and now I repeat for the last time: Out!' But when that too had no effect, the teacher went to the desk and conferred quietly with the schoolmistress; she said something about the police, but the teacher rejected it; finally they agreed. The teacher told the children to go across to his classroom, where they would be taught together with the other children. This change delighted everyone; with laughing and shouting the room was emptied at once, and the teacher and schoolmistress followed last.
paras.uz: «Siz mening boshlig'imsiz, lekin menga bu lavozimni bergan odam emassiz — u janob oqsoqol, men faqat uning bo'shatishini qabul qilaman. U esa menga bu lavozimni men bu yerda odamlarim bilan muzlab o'lishim uchun emas, balki — o'zingiz aytganingizdek — mening o'ylamasdan qiladigan umidsiz qilmishlarimning oldini olish uchun bergan bo'lsa kerak. Shuning uchun meni hozir to'satdan bo'shatish to'g'ridan-to'g'ri uning niyatiga zid bo'lardi; buning teskarisini uning o'z og'zidan eshitmagunimcha, bunga ishonmayman. Aytgancha, agar men sizning yengiltak bo'shatishingizga bo'ysunmasam, bu, ehtimol, sizning ham katta foydangizga bo'ladi.» «Demak, bo'ysunmaysizmi?» — so'radi o'qituvchi. K. bosh chayqadi. «Yaxshilab o'ylab ko'ring, — dedi o'qituvchi. — Sizning qarorlaringiz har doim ham eng yaxshi emas; masalan, kechagi tushdan keyingi vaqtni eslang, siz so'roq qilinishdan bosh tortgan edingiz.» «Nega buni hozir eslatyapsiz?» — so'radi K. «Chunki shunday xohladim, — dedi o'qituvchi, — endi esa so'nggi marta takrorlayman: Chiqing!» Lekin bu ham hech qanday ta'sir qilmagach, o'qituvchi o'qituvchi stoliga borib, o'qituvchi qiz bilan sekin maslahatlashdi; qiz politsiya haqida nimadir dedi, lekin o'qituvchi buni rad etdi; nihoyat ular kelishishdi: o'qituvchi bolalarga o'z sinfiga o'tishni buyurdi, u yerda ular boshqa bolalar bilan birga o'qitiladi. Bu o'zgarish hammani quvontirdi, darhol kulgi va qichqiriq bilan xona bo'shatildi, o'qituvchi va o'qituvchi qiz eng oxirida ergashishdi.

paras.en: The schoolmistress carried the class register, and on it the cat, quite apathetic in its plumpness. The teacher would have liked to leave the cat here, but the schoolmistress firmly rejected a hint to that effect, pointing to K.'s cruelty; so on top of all his annoyance K. saddled the teacher with the cat as well. This probably also influenced the last words the teacher addressed to K. at the door: 'The young lady is leaving this room with the children out of necessity, because you refractorily refuse to comply with my dismissal, and because nobody can demand of her, a young girl, that she should teach in the midst of your dirty family household. So you stay here alone and, undisturbed by the disgust of decent onlookers, can spread yourself out here as much as you like. But it won't last long, I guarantee you that!' With that he slammed the door.
paras.uz: O'qituvchi qiz sinf jurnalini va uning ustida semizligidan butunlay befarq mushukni ko'tarib borardi. O'qituvchi mushukni bu yerda qoldirishni xohlardi, lekin bu haqdagi ishorani o'qituvchi qiz K.ning shafqatsizligini ko'rsatib qat'iyan rad etdi; shunday qilib, K. barcha g'ashliklar ustiga o'qituvchining bo'yniga mushukni ham ortdi. Bu, ehtimol, o'qituvchining eshikda K.ga aytgan so'nggi so'zlariga ham ta'sir qildi: «Xonim bolalar bilan bu xonani noiloj tark etyapti, chunki siz qaysarlik bilan mening bo'shatishimga bo'ysunmayapsiz va hech kim undan — yosh qizdan — sizning iflos oilaviy xo'jaligingiz o'rtasida dars berishini talab qila olmaydi. Demak, siz yolg'iz qolasiz va odobli tomoshabinlarning jirkanishidan xalaqitsiz, bu yerda xohlaganingizcha yoyilib yotishingiz mumkin. Lekin bu uzoq davom etmaydi, bunga kafilman!» Shu bilan u eshikni qarsillatib yopdi.

quiz.why_uz: K. Klammdan shaxsan uchrashishga ruxsat so'raydi.

quiz.q: Who broke open the woodshed door?
